CLOSEST-EXISTING: swiss
NOVELTY: near-empty white grid canvas where tiny Swiss captions and two polaroids carry everything; song-card ("G.O.A.T") opens as a whisper, polaroids flip 3D between verses, and a comment-reply card is the finale.

# t41 — "cmiiw" white-grid Swiss minimal (accxpted)   (12.77 s, 720x720 1:1, 30 fps, ~95-100 BPM est., 7 micro-scenes, avg 1.8 s, ultra-sparse)

## Look
- Palette: white #fff, hairline grid #e8e8ec, black text; slate/periwinkle dots #8b93b8 + grey pills as only colour; one black inverted act. Photos in polaroids keep soft natural colour.
- Grade: gallery-flat, no grain/shadow except polaroid soft shadow; huge negative space (subject matter occupies <20% of frame most scenes).
- Texture: faint 6-col grid + micro captions in corners ("font: helvetica, coolvetica, roboto" style meta-notes), giant ghost outlined letters behind type acts.
- Fonts: Helvetica-like grotesk (Inter/Archivo) mixed roman + italic serif accents (Playfair Italic for quoted words); "So? if i" lockup = outline stroke vs solid italic mix.

## Timeline
0.0–2.0 | white; giant ghost "eat eat…" repeated text bleeds off top; small song card centre-top ("G.O.A.T / Eric Bellinger" + EQ dots) | ghost text slow pan; card fades | fade in | micro-caption types bottom | ov: dotted EQ row pulses | — | intro whisper
2.0–4.2 | grid canvas; tiny lyric fragments appear at scattered grid points (italic "/hai", name tag, serif word with black highlight bar growing behind it) | static canvas, elements pop at different x/y | hard cut (card gone) | type.per_letter tiny (14-18px): fragment 1 italic, fragment 2 stacks 2 lines, keyword gets black bar mask-reveal (scaleX 0→1, text flips white) | corner micro-notes static | type.mask_reveal bar | words on vocal, lots of air
4.2–6.2 | POLAROID ACT: grey bars top/bottom (letterbox), 2 polaroids centre flip/rotate among scattered periwinkle dots + grey capsule pills | polaroids rotationY flip 90→0, swap photo each flip (~0.8 s), drift x ±30 | trans.flip3d | tiny caption types below ("dhgituaja." style micro word) | ov dots/pills float parallax slow | photos: 3 hijab selfies cycle | flips on beat
6.2–8.2 | same "So? if i" lockup on WHITE, then INVERTS to black (same composition, white type, giant ghost "if it" behind) | ghost letters slow zoom 1→1.15 | trans.flash (invert, 1 f) | lockup: outlined "So?" + solid italic stacked words, static hold; micro lyric lines top-left & bottom-right (2 short lines each corner) | type.stroke_outline + solid mix | — | hold = chorus
8.2–10.2 | white; fake comment/thread card left (verified handle, date, 2 short comment lines type in) | card fades/slides | hard cut | comments type per-word 0.1 s; second comment indents in | polaroid act returns right edge blurred sliding in at end | — | —
10.2–12.77 | polaroids return centre (same selfie) with dot field, letterbox bars; then shrink/fade to tiny centred italic word on white; black fade | polaroid push slight; final scale down | flip3d in, fade out | final micro word types per-letter | dots persist | — | outro

## Techniques
- tag: new.swiss_micro_stage — whole edit staged on one white grid with micro-type (12-18px) placed at grid intersections; drama from placement/scale contrast, not size. build: fixed grid overlay div (linear-gradient lines), absolutely position each fragment by % coords; keep captions <20px.
- tag: type.mask_reveal (highlight bar) — black bar grows behind a serif keyword and text inverts to white. build: span with ::before scaleX tween + color swap at 50%.
- tag: ph.frame_card (polaroid flip) — polaroids (white border 10px/28px bottom) flip rotationY to swap photos, over floating dot/pill field. build: gsap rotationY with onRepeat swap src; dots = generated divs y drift yoyo.
- tag: new.ghost_type_bg — giant (300px+) outlined/repeated words at 6-10% opacity drift behind small type. build: absolute text stroke via -webkit-text-stroke, fill transparent, slow x/zoom.
- tag: trans.flash (invert act) — identical composition flips white→black 1 frame. build: toggle class inverting bg/color vars; no motion, cut on beat.
- tag: ui.chat (comment card) — social comment/reply lines as closing scene. build: small card, verified dot, lines type per-word.
- tag: new.song_card_micro — tiny album/song ID card with EQ dots as opening title. build: flex row, dots animate scaleY stagger repeat.

## What makes it look premium
- Restraint: 80% empty frame makes every 16px word land like a poster; most AMVs fill the frame, this weaponises whitespace.
- One repeating motif (polaroid + dots) returns 3× as verse/chorus punctuation.
- Meta micro-captions (font names, dates) fake an art-book colophon — very "designer" credibility.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: extend `swiss` with a `microStage` mode — the discipline is *scale*: hero type at 14-18px equivalent on a 1080 stage (≈50-64px at render, still small relative to frame), 80% empty. Ref is 12.8s; at 58s the danger is filling it up — add *time*, not elements: each micro-scene holds longer, polaroid act returns 3× as punctuation (intro/build/drop2). Seams: `"flash"` (invert act) + `"blur"`; most joins are bare kick cuts with `AE.fx("rgb",K,{amt:4})` — sparseness forgives hard cuts, but keep amvkit rule: land on kick.
- `intro: [songCardMicro, gridFragments]` — songCardMicro: giant ghost repeated word bleeds off top (stroke text 6% opacity, slow pan), tiny song card centre-top (title/artist + EQ dots scaleY pulse). gridFragments: fragments pop at scattered grid points (hairline grid #e8e8ec overlay), keyword gets black highlight bar (`AE.maskReveal` + colour invert at 50%).
- `build: [polaroidDots, invertLockup]` — polaroidDots: grey letterbox bars, 2 polaroids flip rotationY swapping photos ~0.8s (`AE.flipCard` loop), periwinkle dots #8b93b8 + grey pills float parallax. invertLockup: "So? if i"-style lockup (outline + solid italic mix) on white, then 1f invert to black with giant ghost behind, micro lines in corners.
- `brk: [invertLockupHold]` — the inverted lockup simply *holds* (ghost slow zoom 1→1.15). At 58s this is your break: near-nothing for 3s.
- `drop: [commentCard, polaroidDots]` — commentCard: fake comment/thread card left (verified handle, date, 2 lines type per-word, second indents), polaroid act slides in right blurred. Drop energy here = typing speed + flips on kicks (velo cam very low, `cam:{velo:.25}` — big camera would kill the aesthetic).
- `drop2: [gridFragments, polaroidDots, invertLockup]` — fragments advance, lockup returns white version.
- `outro: [microWord]` — polaroids shrink to tiny centred italic word on white (song title word or hook word), black fade.
- Palette: white, grid #e8e8ec, black, dots #8b93b8. Fonts: Inter/Archivo (grotesk), Playfair Italic (serif accents/lockup). `AE.base({glow:.04,rgb:.4,vignette:0,grain:.004})` — flattest look in the set.
- Post FX events: almost none — 1f invert is a CSS class toggle; `flash` amt .3 at invert only. Resist engine drop shake: override by keeping drop scenes' kicks sparse or accept tiny shake (set look, accept `AE.drop` — it will read as a glitch in this aesthetic; better: choose a song whose first drop lands at commentCard where a shake is tolerable).
- Assets: 10+ photos (polaroids cycle 3 selfies minimum), no cutouts.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: paradoxically the *tiny* fragments are the hero — italic/serif fragments at grid points, typed per-letter on vocal. The held lockup = hook (2-3 words). Highlight-bar keyword = the stressed word of that fragment.
- UI labels: micro-captions are the signature *label* layer: font names, dates, "kasih or wall"-style corner tags (use artist handle + date), song card title/artist, comment handle/date. These designer colophon labels are safe *because* they're visibly metadata (≤12px equiv, corners).
- Stickers/decorative: dots/pills (wordless), EQ dots, ghost repeated word — the ghost is a lyric word repeated as texture; use the hook word only, at ≤8% opacity.
- Comment card lines type conversational text — in our build use fragments (call/response) or artist/title references; don't invent fan comments with lyric-like lines.
- Whitespace rule: if a scene needs "more", add a grid-point fragment from the *same* sung line, never a new decorative sentence.

## Song
Track shown in opening card "G.O.A.T — Eric Bellinger" (TikTok "original sound - accxpted"); title "cmiiw". Tiny lyric fragments (2-3 words each) typed at grid points on the vocal; "So? if i" lockup is the held hook.

CLOSEST-EXISTING: osdream
NOVELTY: voice-note player cold-open (x2 as loop reprise), giant pink bubble lyric hand-built per letter, browser-window photo stack, and a pink circle-iris that wipes into an IG feed scroll — whole piece loops A→B→C twice.

# t38 — "i have no idea" pink grid-windows PMV (if: @raa)   (35.67 s, 960x720 4:3, 30 fps, ~109 BPM est., 8 scene-blocks ×2 loop, avg 2.2 s, dense in-scene pops)

## Look
- Palette: white + faint blueprint grid (#eef0f4 lines every ~48px) everywhere; bubblegum pink #f06ba8/#ef5da8 for type, chat bubbles, iris; dark charcoal player #20232a; photos warm car-selfie tones (terracotta/grey hijab).
- Grade: flat vector-UI look, near-zero grain; photos keep natural colour, slight warm filter; soft shadows 0 10px 30px rgba(180,80,130,.18) under windows/cards.
- Texture: grid paper, macOS/browser window chrome (traffic dots), IG UI, chat bubbles; black rounded-corner matte border frames whole video (like a captured window).
- Fonts: bubble/display pink lyric = rounded ultra-bold with inline squiggle letterforms (closest Google: Baloo 2 ExtraBold / Fredoka 700, custom-drawn); UI/captions = Inter/SF; chat = Inter.

## Timeline
0.0–4.0 | white void, small dark voice-note/call player centre (circular avatar, waveform ticks, timer 0:01→, video/mute/end buttons) | static, player scales .9→1 fade-in | fade in | tiny caption types per-word below player (2 short phrases sequential) | waveform bars animate, timer counts | — | —
4.0–8.0 | same player, caption keeps typing | static | — | caption words 0.15 s/word advance; timer 0:03→0:07 | red "end" button persistent | — | vocal = spoken/sung line captioned verbatim-ish (described, not transcribed)
8.0–11.5 | grid bg; giant pink lyric builds centre | cam slight push 1→1.05 | hard cut (player vanishes) | type.per_letter: first short word stamps in, then a 2-word hook assembles — big brush squiggle underlines draw stroke-by-stroke, second line overlaps first at -8° | letterforms scale 1.4→1 back.out(2), squiggle = SVG path dash draw 0.4 s | fx none | letters on syllables
11.5–13.5 | grid + lyric top; browser/photo windows stack bottom | windows slide up | — | lyric holds | ph.frame_card: 3 overlapping windows (black placeholder, X-close wireframe, then photos fill) pop stagger 0.15 s, rotate -3/0/3°; "01." tab tag | — | —
13.5–16.0 | windows zoom to FULL-BLEED photo sequence | cam.punch_face: window scale→full frame 0.3 s expo | trans.zoom_through | — | 3 close selfies hard-cut ~0.7 s each, push 1→1.1; white-window glitch frame between 2nd/3rd | fx.rgb_split tiny on glitch | cuts on beat
16.0–20.5 | grid; small profile card "raa 01." + chat rows build below | static | hard cut | card header types; message bars slide in L/R alternately (grey bar, pink arrow send buttons) stagger 0.3 s; "hecanbawal" handles | ov pink + icons pop | — | rows on phrase turns
20.5–21.5 | giant PINK CIRCLE iris expands from card centre → covers frame | scale 0→150% 0.5 s expo.inOut | trans.shape_iris (circle wipe) | — | iris solid #f06ba8 with thin white ring | — | beat drop
21.5–26.5 | white IG feed: story rings top, post cards scroll UP | vertical scroll (translateY -100% loop) | iris reveals | — | ui: IG post cards (same subject, 260 Likes rows) slide up continuously; new post enters bottom every ~1.2 s | — | —
26.5–30.5 | IG DM/chat screen white: pink bubbles left stack | static | hard cut | ui.chat: pink bubbles pop scale .7→1 stagger 0.25 s (4 bubbles, short phrases); dark reply bubble slides in right ~29.5 | pink + avatar header | — | bubbles on vocal
30.5–35.67 | LOOP reprise compressed: Photos-app pinwheel "still waiting…" blink (30.5–31.5) → pink lyric rebuilds (31.5–33.5) → windows→full-bleed photos (33.5–34.5) → profile card + pink iris starts again (34.5–35.67, cut mid-iris) | same | same | same | same assets, ~0.8× duration | — | loop point

## Techniques
- tag: new.ui.voice_note_player — fake call/voice-note card as cold open and caption stage. build: dark rounded rect, avatar circle, waveform = 40 divs random heights animated scaleY, timer via GSAP textContent snap, 3-button footer; caption line below typed per word.
- tag: type.per_letter (bubble-squiggle) — pink hook built from oversized rounded letters + hand-drawn squiggle strokes overlapping words. build: each word an SVG/text span scale 1.5→1 back.out(1.8) stagger 0.07; underline = SVG path strokeDashoffset draw 0.35 s, rotate whole lockup -4°.
- tag: ph.frame_card (browser windows) — overlapping app windows with placeholder X that fill with photos. build: .window divs (header bar + dots), gsap from y+80/rotate, then img opacity swap; numbered tab "01.".
- tag: trans.shape_iris (pink circle) — solid pink disc + white ring expands to wipe scenes; also mini target/spin variant before IG. build: div border-radius 50% scale 0→3 expo.inOut 0.5 s, or SVG circle r tween.
- tag: ui.ig_story / feed scroll — story rings row + endless post-card scroll. build: column of .post cards, gsap yPercent -50 repeat linear, duplicate set.
- tag: ui.chat — pink left bubbles vs dark right reply, pop/slide stagger. build: bubbles scale .6→1 back.out, transform-origin bottom-left/right.
- tag: new.loop_reprise — second half repeats A→C at ~0.8× speed, ends mid-transition for seamless TikTok loop. build: reuse same timeline, timeScale 1.2.

## What makes it look premium
- One accent colour (pink) + one bg (grid white) + one dark UI = instant brand system; every scene change uses a motivated UI object (window, iris, bubble).
- Photos enter as windows/cards first, then break full-bleed — scale contrast feels expensive.
- Loop reprise makes 35 s feel like a designed cycle, not a slideshow.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: extend `osdream` (grid-white variant) with `voiceNotePlayer`, `bubbleHook`, `browserWindows`, `igFeedScroll`. Whole stage inside a black rounded matte border (18px radius) like a captured window. Ref loops A→B→C ×2 in 35.7s; at 58s: pass 1 = intro/build/brk, pink iris into feed = drop, DM = build2, pass 2 reprise at 0.85× = drop2, end mid-iris under fade. Seams: `["zoom","iris","blur","whip"]` — iris is `AE.trans(...,"iris")`.
- `intro: [voiceNotePlayer]` (long — give it 2 scenes) — white void, dark player #20232a centre (avatar, waveform = 40 divs scaleY animated, timer counts via onUpdate, video/mute/end buttons), caption types per-word *below* player at 0.15s/word. Static camera; waveform + timer are the motion.
- `build: [bubbleHook, browserWindows]` — bubbleHook: grid bg (#eef0f4 lines 48px), giant pink lyric builds per letter scale 1.4→1 back.out, brush squiggle underlines SVG dash-draw, second line overlaps -8°. browserWindows: 3 overlapping windows slide up (placeholder X fills with photos stagger 0.15, rotate -3/0/3, "01." tab).
- `brk: [profileChatRows]` — small profile card ("name 01.") + message bars slide L/R alternately stagger 0.3, pink send arrows pop. Slow, chatty = break texture.
- `drop: [windowsFullbleed, irisToFeed]` — windowsFullbleed: window scales to full frame (punch), 3 close photos hard-cut ~0.7s each push 1→1.1, tiny `rgb` on one glitch frame. irisToFeed: pink circle #f06ba8 expands from card centre → IG feed: story rings top, post cards scroll up continuously (duplicate set, yPercent loop).
- `drop2: [dmChat, bubbleHook, browserWindows]` — dmChat: pink bubbles left pop stagger 0.25, dark reply slides right. Then reprise bubbleHook/windows at tighter timing.
- `outro: [irisLoop]` — pink iris starts expanding again, engine fade catches it mid-wipe; credit micro-line (artist handle) bottom.
- Palette: white/grid #eef0f4, pink #f06ba8/#ef5da8, dark #20232a, photo warm. Fonts: Baloo 2 ExtraBold (pink hook), Inter (UI/chat). `AE.base({glow:.12,rgb:.6,vignette:.12,grain:.008})`.
- Post FX events: `rgb` tiny on glitch frame, `zoomblur` on window punch, engine drop at irisToFeed; iris handled by seam.
- Assets: 20+ photos (windows, feed posts ×4+, DM avatar), player avatar crop, window chrome = CSS.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the giant pink bubble hook (2 short phrases) — built per letter on syllables, rebuilt identically in reprise. It's the sung refrain; feed from `CFG.lyrics` hook times. Caption under voice-note player = the *spoken/verse* line typed per word — also real lyric (or spoken intro transcript if the song has one; otherwise song title + artist as "caption" is cheating the surface — better: leave caption area as waveform only until first sung fragment).
- UI labels: timer, "video / mute / end", profile handle, "01." tab, IG like counts, "still waiting…" pinwheel text (system label, safe). DM bubbles = conversational fragments (lyric call/response).
- Stickers/decorative: squiggle underlines, pink arrows — wordless. Feed post captions: keep to handle + fragment or handle only.
- The matte border + grid make any centred text read as hero — no decorative centred words outside bubbleHook.

## Song
Original sound "it's a Wall / hecanbawal" (title "i have no idea", if: @raa). Spoken-then-sung vocal captioned under the player; pink hook (2 short phrases) is the sung refrain, rebuilt identically in reprise.

# k06 — "indo camp": liquid-splash iris in/out, sky-blue sticker cards with orbiting frame outlines, side-scrolling type track, split-screen cat payoff
STYLE-KEY: camcorder-liquid-splash-cards
CLOSEST-EXISTING: camcorder-t30
NOVELTY: opens and closes with a white liquid "splat" swirl (tentacle ink that spins out from centre to fill frame, reversed at the end — a bookend); mid-section is a chain of rounded photo cards that flip on Y between photos while 2 thin square outlines orbit/rotate around them; type rides a horizontal camera track (huge red words passing like a train) with hashtag pills.

(23.6 s, 1088x1088 1:1, 60 fps, ~128 BPM est. (beat ≈0.47 s), ~13 segments, ~0.55 cuts/s)

## Look
- HUD: Jasa-Edit camcorder preset.

## Techniques
- tag: new.liquid_splash_iris
  what: organic ink splat (centre-origin, 6–8 curved tentacles + droplets) spins ~120° while scaling 0→3 to fill frame; 0.9 s, expo.in. Reverse for outro (spins back to a dot over 1.2 s, expo.out). Bookends the edit.
  build: SVG blob path (or pre-rendered PNG sequence/lottie); `fromTo(splash,{scale:0,rotation:-60},{scale:3.2,rotation:60,ease:"expo.in",duration:.9})`; mask-image on the next scene for the reveal. Droplets = 10 dots on bezier paths.
- tag: new.orbit_outline_frames
  what: two thin (2 px) yellow square outlines around a photo card, each rotating continuously at different speeds/directions, scale 1.05/1.15 of card.
  build: 2 absolutely-positioned divs `border:2px solid #F5D84A`, `to(rot,{rotation:360,repeat:-1,ease:"none",duration:8})` and −360/12.
- tag: trans.flip3d (card photo swap)
  what: rounded card flips rotateY 0→180 in ~8 f with motion blur, photo swaps at 90°; outlines keep spinning (continuity).
  build: perspective 900px; `to(card,{rotationY:"+=180",duration:.25,ease:"power2.inOut"})`.
- tag: new.type_track_parallax
  what: camera tracks horizontally past enormous extruded red caps (≈2.5x frame width) with 3 layers at different speeds (small blue word slow, red caps fast, hashtag pills medium) then pulls back to show the full line.
  build: layers x tween with ratios 0.5/1.0/0.75, `power1.inOut` 1.6 s; then `#cam scale 2.2→.6 expo.inOut .5`.
- tag: new.avatar_ring_spin_in
  what: round avatar enters huge & inverted (rotation 180, scale 2) and spins/shrinks into a ring with blue arc accent, 0.5 s back.out(1.2).
- tag: ph.split_screen (top/bottom same-subject crops), trans.slit_bars, fx.dir_blur streak swipes, ov.stars, ui.chat, ui.rec_hud.

## What makes it look premium
- Constant secondary motion (orbiting outlines, bobbing stars) means no frame is static even on holds.
- Matched bookends (splash in/out) and directional continuity (everything exits the way the next thing enters).
- Hierarchy: tiny UI-ish labels vs. huge extruded words create scale drama during the track.

## Song
Original sound — Jasa Edit ("Typo - indo camp"). Word types per syllable; card flips and transitions on beats.

# q11 — Blue/white lyric-typography preset: Spotify lyrics screen -> banner -> polaroid+stars -> block-highlight kinetic type  (14.7s, 720x890 portrait, 30fps, 123 BPM, 4 shots, long continuous scenes)
STYLE-KEY: blue-white-spotify-lyric-iris
CLOSEST-EXISTING: swiss
NOVELTY: Iris opens straight into a fake lyric-player that camera-pulls into its own chrome, then a tumbling placeholder polaroid and a blue highlight-bar stack; swiss has the poster type but no player-as-scene or iris portal.
## Look
- Soft white radial-vignette bg (#fff centre -> #d9d9d9 edges); single hue electric blue/indigo (#4B5AE8 -> #2438D8 gradient) as fills; black/charcoal (#1a1a1a) type on white, white type on blue.
- Fonts: Montserrat Bold/ExtraBold (lyrics screen), condensed grotesk (Anton / Bebas Neue / League Gothic) for AWALNYA, KETAGIHAN, KU BILANG AMIN; thin script (Allura/Mrs Saint Delafield) "ku" and "ketagihan" for accent; outline-only duplicates.
- Decorations: 4-point sparkle stars (filled + outline), big filled triangle/star shapes, confetti dust dots, hand-drawn blue wave line.
## Timeline
0.00–0.5 | white vignette; blue dot appears at centre, scales 0->full-frame circle by ~0.7s (ease-out, 8 frames) | trans.shape_iris (in)

## Techniques
- tag: trans.shape_iris
  what: blue disc scale 0->1 from centre (and reverse); the disc content IS the next scene (clip-path circle)
  build: clip-path: circle(r at 50% 50%) tween r 0->120%, power3.out 0.25s.
- tag: ui.music_player / type.lyric_word_sync
  what: lyrics view, 3 visible rows with perspective tilt, others fade; top bar meta; current row bold & bigger
  build: HTML rows, rotateZ(-4deg) skewX; GSAP x translate -> marquee, blur ramps; filter blur(0-4px) by distance to active line.
- tag: type.mask_reveal / type.per_letter
  what: AWALNYA letters pop in one at a time inside a band mask; KETAGIHAN has letters flicker on behind a swooping stroke
  build: band div overflow hidden; letters yPercent 100->0 stagger .06; SVG path draw (stroke-dashoffset) used as reveal wipe.
- tag: ph.frame_card
  what: polaroid with "?" placeholder (user would slot photo) 3D tumbling, white 12px border, 8px drop shadow
  build: div rotateX/rotateY/rotateZ keyframes ±20deg, scale .5..1.5 over 8-12f per beat, back.out.
- tag: ov.stars / ov.sparkle
  what: filled + outline 4-point sparkles pop/scale 0->1.2->1, spin 45deg, blue; large triangle/star shapes behind polaroid; confetti dots drift
- tag: fx.dir_blur
  what: horizontal motion blur 30-60px on marquee type entering/exiting; vertical on polaroids passing (4 frames)
- tag: type.stack_blocks
  what: two-line stack with second line in solid blue bar (inverse colour), slides at different speeds
- tag: cam.pull
  what: lyric screen scales 1.8 -> 1 across 3.5s slow ease-in-out; chrome UI revealed at end
- tag: trans.zoom_out / new.line_collapse
  what: banner scaleY to 0 to a hairline then white
## What makes it look premium
Single-hue discipline + white vignette, motion blur on everything entering, 3D polaroid orbit with real depth, mix of heavy condensed + thin script type, every word change lands on a beat with a sparkle pop, a calm white rest + signature at the end.
## Song
"suara asli - Zey7 VTX" / Mejikuhibiniu (Tenxi, Suisei, Jemsii) lyric screen; sung female vocals; 123 BPM, A minor; scenes lengthened to long uninterrupted segments, word cuts on 0.5s.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas 1080x1350 (ref 720x890). Palette: white vignette `#FFFFFF→#D9D9D9`, blue `#4B5AE8→#2438D8`, ink `#1A1A1A`. Fonts: Montserrat ExtraBold (player), Anton (hero), Mrs Saint Delafield (script accent).
- `roles:{intro:[irisPlayer], build:[bandWord,polaroidOrbit], brk:[waveReveal], drop:[blockBar,polaroidOrbit], drop2:[bandWord,blockBar], outro:[signature]}`; seams `["iris","blur","whip","iris"]`.
- intro `irisPlayer(c)`: blue disc `clip-path:circle()` 0→120% 0.25s; 3 lyric rows rotateZ(-3deg), `AE.words(tl,rows,c.k,{style:"blur"})`; camera scale 1.8→1 over scene (cam.pull).
- build `bandWord(c)`: blue band scaleY in, hero via `AE.words(...,{style:"slam"})` + outline echo; `polaroidOrbit(c)`: `C(j)` placeholder card rotateX/Y ±20deg on kicks, `AE.sparkles` per word.
- brk `waveReveal(c)`: freeze polaroid, SVG wave path `AE.writeOn` 0.3s wipes to hero word revealed behind stroke + script overlay `AE.maskReveal`.
- drop `blockBar(c)`: `AE.blocks` 2 lines, line2 white-on-blue bar, x-drift marquee; drop2 reuses with colours swapped and photo `P(j)` inside polaroid.
- outro `signature(c)`: iris collapse to white, tiny centred credit fade 0.4s, hold.
- Helpers: AE.trans iris/blur, AE.words, AE.blocks, AE.sparkles, AE.pop, AE.maskReveal/writeOn, AMV.fit/extrude(6,blue).
- Post FX: `dirblur` on marquee entries/polaroid passes, `zoomblur` on iris, `rgb:4` on drop hits, constant soft glow; no grain.
- Assets: 4–6 photos (1 hero cutout optional), 1 placeholder polaroid texture, sparkle/star SVGs, wave path, CFG.words = full lyric lines for player + 6 hero words.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words (Anton, in band/bar): the 4–6 loudest sung words only, one per scene, slam/mask-revealed exactly on their vocal onset (use CFG.words timings, not kick grid alone).
- Player lines (Montserrat): full lines scroll in the fake player, word-highlight follows the vocal; this is the only place long text may live — it reads as UI, not caption.
- Script accents: single short words overlaid on the hero (contrast voice), never a second line.
- Decorative/safe: outline echo copies, sparkles, song-title metadata in player chrome (static, tiny) — safe anywhere since they carry no lyric timing.
- Unsafe: floating subtitles outside player/band; any text over the polaroid's photo area.

- No hard stops: every scene exits mid-motion (blur smear, swoop, slit, zoom-through), so cuts read as one camera move.

- Velocity-coupled blur on every move; expo-out landings with tiny overshoot.

Original sound — Jasa Edit (Indonesian DJ edit, "MBG"/"Kamu itu…" vocal). Letter pops on 8ths, scene changes on downbeats, cursor taps per beat.

- tag: ui.rec_hud

- tag: new.sticker_room_system

- tag: type.word_slam (sticker words)

- tag: ui.chat (planet room)

## What makes it look premium
- HUD + sticker vocabulary unify 5 colour rooms and 2 cat clips into one "preset" product.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: extend `camcorder` template directly (it already has REC HUD, beat colour cycle, bubble words). Add the `stickerRoom` system + cat payoff replaced by *subject* payoff (our builds use artist photos/clips, not meme cats — payoff = full-bleed portrait clips). 58s: rooms cycle intro/build, chat room as brk, purple stage at first drop, payoff at drop, rooms resume drop2, payoff 2 + HUD fade outro. Seams: `["flash","zoom","flip","blur"]` + HUD persistent above all (z-50, outside `#cam` so seams don't move it).
- `intro: [roomLavender, roomButter]` — roomLavender: lavender #c9bff2 + centre white glow, cyan sticker words slam word-by-word (`AE.words`), key word gets scribble ring (`AE.writeOn` circle), micro credit types under. roomButter: #fff3a0, sticker card `flipY` inside yellow ring, emoji confetti falls.
- `build: [roomChat, roomBlush]` — roomChat: navy #0e2233 planet curve, sent-photo card pinned top, sky bubbles stack; smear-respawn between bubble sets (`AE.fx("glitch",K)`). roomBlush: #ffd9e2, hearts float up (`AE.sparkles` variant with ♥ spans), red/yellow pill stickers pop sequentially.
- `brk: [roomWhiteBlue]` — grey cat-card equivalent → our version: portrait sticker card rocks -4°→+4° and shrinks as purple stage wipes up (mask wipe in-scene). Quietest room = break.
- `drop: [purpleStage, payoffClip]` — purpleStage: violet blobs #7b2ff7 top/bottom (border-radius organic), Anton yellow lines slam stacked line-per-kick, stars twinkle. payoffClip: full-bleed portrait, spin/zoom in (`AE.fx("spinblur")+zoomblur`), slow push, `AE.echo` ghost mid-clip, whip reframe.
- `drop2: [roomLavender, purpleStage, payoffClip]` — rooms repeat with later fragments + new photos in cards.
- `outro: [hudFade]` — clip blows to white→grey→black (`flash`+`exposure` events), HUD brackets/timecode fade last 0.5s.
- Palette: per-room (above) + HUD white/red #e8404f. Fonts: Baloo 2 ExtraBold (sticker words, white stroke), Anton (purple stage), Inter (chat/credit). `AE.base({glow:.22,glow_thr:.62,rgb:.7,vignette:.18,grain:.01})`.
- Post FX events: `zoomblur` 3f at room exits, `glitch` on chat respawn, `spinblur` into payoff, `dirblur` on whips, engine drops. HUD timecode via GSAP onUpdate on a text node — deterministic from timeline time.
- Assets: 30+ photos (sticker cards + payoff portraits; payoff wants motion-feel stills — use push+echo), emoji/star/heart spans (text glyphs fine).

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: every sticker word and purple-stage line is a sung fragment — rooms are phrase-sized: one room per lyric phrase, words land on their vocal times inside the room (`ctx.lyricTimes()`). Room change = phrase boundary, ideally on a kick.
- UI labels: HUD chrome (REC, FPS, timecode), the red micro-credit under lavender words (= song title — artist, a label, safe), chat bubble text is lyric-carried (bubbles = fragments). Sent-photo card has no text.
- Stickers/decorative: emoji confetti, hearts, stars, snow dots — wordless glyphs only. Pill stickers in blush room carry 1-2 sung words (they're mini hero words, not decoration).
- Payoff clips carry NO text except HUD — that's the point (visual reward). Don't caption them.

## Song
Original sound by Jasa Edit ("suara asli — jasa edit 10k", track credit line inside video names the DJ single). ~130 BPM est.; word pops, room changes and cat cuts land on the beat grid (HUD timecode confirms 60 fps timing).

## What makes it look premium
- Photos keep escaping their UI frames (pinned selfie, carousel duplicates), so screenshots feel dimensional.
- The A/A′ loop is musical: same chrome, new content — the viewer learns the system in pass 1 and enjoys variations in pass 2.
- Script-on-story and pill-panel scenes break the dark Spotify rhythm with white space.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: extend `osdream` with a Spotify skin pack (widget, lyric player, Liked Songs, pill panel, curve-mask story). Native ref is already a loop (A 0-25s, A′ 25-41s) — at 58s map A→intro/build/drop, A′→drop2 with swapped data; don't loop a third time, escalate instead (B&W outro exists in ref). Seams: engine default cycle; ref's hard cuts → `"zoom"/"flip"/"whip"` or flash-masked.
- `intro: [lockWidget, albumFlip]` — lockWidget: red-shelf wallpaper photo bg, big clock, Spotify widget + WhatsApp/IG notification pills stack (`gsap from y:-16 stagger .4`). albumFlip: polaroid `AE.flipCard` → selfie card + mini player.
- `build: [lyricPlayer, likedSongs]` — lyricPlayer: album left, lyric lines right scroll stepped per phrase, active line white (see text system), progress bar scaleX over scene. likedSongs: header types per letter (`AMV.chars`), rows stagger in, selfie pinned left overflowing frame.
- `brk: [pillPanel]` — outdoor photo left, white panel right fills with black pill rows (`AE.pill`+`AE.pillIn`, one sung word per pill, ↓/✓ icons between); side photo swaps per pill. Slowest scene — good brk.
- `drop: [storyGrid, curveStory]` — storyGrid: green mat bg, 3 tilted polaroids `AE.stack`, white text card with 3-line stack (`AE.blocks`). curveStory: oversized white circle masks crop 2 photos, gold script types across seam, then whole editor shrinks into desktop browser window (scale 1→.55, window chrome fades in).
- `drop2: [lyricPlayer, pillPanel, curveStory]` — engine re-calls with new photo offset + later lyric fragments; swap accent beige→white panel.
- `outro: [bwPhotos]` — B&W photos (`filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.1)`), whip between, black, tiny footer types (title — artist).
- Palette: shelf red #b01018, Spotify #121212, beige #cfc4b0, gold script #a07d2c, white. Fonts: Inter (UI), Great Vibes/Pinyon Script (story script), Inter ExtraBold (pills). `AE.base({glow:.14,rgb:.6,vignette:.2,grain:.012})`.
- Post FX events: `dirblur` on carousel/whip moments, `flash` low at cycle seam, engine drops; B&W outro via CSS filter not post grade (keep player scenes colour).
- Assets: 30+ photos incl. one pinned "selfie" hero reused in likedSongs/pillPanel, album-art polaroid = a photo card with handwritten year (use song year label), story-editor photos ×3.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: three carriers, all real lyric — (1) player lines: show 4-line window, active line = currently sung fragment, inactive = adjacent real fragments at 45%; highlight swap timed from `CFG.lyrics` times, not beats. (2) black pills: exactly one sung word per pill, revealed at its vocal time. (3) story card 3-line stack + gold script word: sung fragments.
- UI labels (safe): clock 13.18-style time, notification senders/previews — previews are 1-2 word *fragments of the lyric* in ref; if unsure use app-name + "now" only. Liked Songs rows: use real track titles of the artist (that's discography, not lyric) — safe and authentic.
- Stickers/decorative: handwritten year on album polaroid, story toolbar icons — wordless. The gold script is a lyric carrier (above), not decoration.
- Copyright/accuracy note: at most the fragments the vocal sings in that window; never fill the player with a full verse block "for texture" — inactive lines must be the actual neighbouring lines, dimmed.

## Song
"Blank Space" — Taylor Swift (per uploader title; preset audio is an original-sound re-upload). Lyric sync is via player highlight, pills and story text; only 2–3 words quoted per moment here. ~128 BPM; cuts, pill reveals and line highlights land on the 0.47 s grid.

## Techniques
- tag: type.per_letter (blur-rise)
  what: each glyph enters from ~15–30 px below (sometimes from random vertical offsets) with gaussian blur 8→0 px and opacity
  0→1 over ~4 frames, stagger 1 frame/letter. Exit: same in reverse L→R. This is the signature of the whole edit.
  build: SplitText chars; `gsap.from(chars,{y:()=>gsap.utils.random(10,30),filter:"blur(8px)",opacity:0,duration:.16,
  stagger:.04,ease:"power3.out"})`.
- tag: trans.zoom_out (punch-in subject)
  what: new cutout enters at 180–220% scale with heavy motion/zoom blur and lands at final size in 3–5 frames, sometimes with
  1 frame of inverted/dark smear.
  build: GSAP scale 2.1→1, duration .16, ease expo.out; post: zoom blur centred on subject on frames where |dscale|>0.1.
- tag: new.flip_swap
  what: on beat, the cutout AND its caption rotate 180° instantly (upside-down), swapped to an alternate expression image.
  build: `gsap.set(group,{rotation:180})` + image src swap on beat; new caption appears unrotated below.
- tag: trans.glitch / fx.glitch_blocks
  what: 3 frames of rectangular slices displaced horizontally (±30% W), dark/inverted, resolving into the next shot.
  build: 6–10 clip-path rect copies of incoming frame with random x offset, shrinking to 0 over 3 frames; OpenCV slice shift.
- tag: ph.frame_card (torn paper border)
  what: maid shots framed by a rough deckle/torn edge in blue-grey (~3% inset).
  build: SVG mask with turbulence-displaced rect (feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap) or PNG torn-edge frame overlay.
- tag: ui.chat (pill bubble)
  what: rounded blue (#4C8FD0) pill with white rounded sans, words appended; quick double-image flicker at 6.2.
  build: div border-radius 12px; words appended with opacity tweens; flicker = 2-frame duplicate offset 6px at 50% opacity.
- tag: trans.mask_wipe (diagonal wedge) + trans.card_slide
  what: white polygon with ~25° slanted edge sweeps R→L across ~8 frames carrying a tilted photo card.
  build: clip-path polygon animated; card div translateX 100%→0 with rotation 10°.
- tag: new.card_jitter (ph.zoom_crop_face variant)
  what: a small photo card snaps to a new rotation (−20…+30°), scale (1–2.2×), crop and aspect every 2–5 frames while the
  caption stays fixed; RGB-split flashes on some snaps.
  build: GSAP timeline of `set()` calls on 1/8 notes with random rotate/scale/clip-path inset; fx.rgb_split on 1 of 3 snaps.
- tag: fx.rgb_split — cyan/magenta/yellow offset copies 4–8 px on card snaps (7.4–9.2).
- tag: trans.whip (+fx.motion_blur, fx.dir_blur)
  what: next image enters as a giant directional smear (horizontal, vertical or diagonal) across 2–4 frames.
  build: translate ±120% → 0 in .12 s expo.out + post directional blur proportional to velocity.
- tag: new.squash_smear exit
  what: subject stretches vertically and drops out with vertical blur (11.4–11.55).
  build: scaleY 1→2.5, scaleX 1→0.6, y +40%, opacity 0 in 4 frames + vertical blur.
- tag: type.slide_bars / ov.sticker (navy pill labels)
  what: dark navy rounded pills with white text arranged stair-step diagonally; typed letter-by-letter with blurry
  placeholder glyphs; accent word "hati" red bold italic rotated −60°.
  build: absolutely-positioned pills; typing via scramble-ish blurred glyph then sharpen.
- tag: ph.mirror (flip on beat) — chibi sticker horizontal flips 15.8/16.1/16.4.
- tag: cam.pull snap — 12.7 instant reframe wider; 14.5 scale 1.3→1 blur pull.
- tag: fx.exposure_pulse (dark) — 3.65–3.75 image goes to near-black silhouette before the flip.
- tag: trans.hard_cut — to white text at 16.8 and black at 18.9.

## What makes it look premium
- Disciplined white negative space; each shot = 1 cutout + 1 lyric line, so the motion reads clearly.
- Every entrance has blur proportional to velocity (motion-blur discipline), even per letter.
- Typography changes per language/line (serif / pixel / pill / condensed / CJK) but keeps the same per-letter blur grammar.
- Card jitter on 1/8 notes gives energy without new footage.

## Song
Original sound "suara asli - Syahrandy Okt" — mashup of an English R&B/pop line ("I see you lookin', got that little cute
thing… let the games begin… I'm feelin' the heat… cuz I chose you first baby, gonna love you back") + Indonesian lines
("lihat mata kamu", "asalkan bisa jaga hati") + Mandarin ("Ni xian shuo ai wo" 你先说爱我, "我就肯定永远爱你").
All captions are word/syllable-synced; cuts land on bar downbeats (~2.2 s).

## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas 1080x1080, white `#FFFFFF`. Palette per character: navy `#2E3A8C`/periwinkle `#A9B4F5`/cyan `#28D3F0`, yellow `#F7E04A/#F5E820`, red `#E8344A`. Fonts: Cormorant Garamond Light (serif lines), Silkscreen (pixel line), Nunito ExtraBold (pill), Oswald (condensed), Noto Sans SC (CJK line).
- `roles:{intro:[textOnly], build:[chibiLine], brk:[cardJitter], drop:[duoPills,mirrorSticker], drop2:[chibiLine,cardJitter], outro:[textHold]}`; seams `["blur","whip","glitch","flash"]`.
- intro `textOnly(c)`: centred serif line, per-letter blur-rise (chars y+20 blur8→0 stagger 0.04); exit letters blur-out L→R.
- build `chibiLine(c)`: cutout `C(j)` punch-in scale 2.1→1 expo.out 0.16 + `AE.defocusIn`; caption per-letter under it; beat flip variant `gsap.set(group,{rotation:180})` + expression swap.
- brk `cardJitter(c)`: small photo card snaps rot −20..30deg/scale 1–2.2 every 1/8 note (`AMV.rng` sets), caption static below — freeze the type, move the card.
- drop `duoPills(c)`: duo cutout whip-in, navy pills `AE.pillIn` stair-step diagonal, accent word rotated −60deg in red; `mirrorSticker(c)`: sticker flips scaleX on kicks.
- outro `textHold(c)`: white, one CJK/grey line blur-in per char, hold, hard cut black.
- Helpers: AMV.chars/type, AE.defocusIn, AE.pill/pillIn, AE.pop, AE.trans glitch (slice copies), AE.stickerCSS.
- Post FX: `zoomblur` on punch-ins, `dirblur` on whips/squash exit, `rgb:6` on 1-in-3 card snaps, `glitch` 3f at scene joins; no grain/vignette.
- Assets: 5–7 character/subject cutouts (2 expressions each), 2 photo cards, torn-edge frame PNG, pill/dot SVGs.

## Lyric/text system
- One line per shot, centred under/beside the cutout, per-letter blur-rise synced to syllables (stagger ≈1 frame/letter at 25fps).
- Font = language/voice switch: serif (soft lines), pixel (playful), pill bubble (spoken aside), condensed (hook), CJK face (final line). Colour follows character palette, not a global lyric colour.
- Pill labels: short fragments typed inside navy pills as a second voice; accent word rotated in red.
- Stickers: mini pixel/anger marks on the cutout — reactive, untexted.
- Decorative/safe: repeated tiny prior line left behind subject after whip (echo of last line, small). Unsafe: two full lines on screen together (except duo pills); text over faces.

Implement as data-driven scene fns called by role, *not* a literal timeline clone — `AE.film` assigns roles; keep relay order inside each role pool. Seams: `["zoom","flash","blur","whip"]`.

- Strobe/spin-blur flurries land on the drum fills, then calm lyric screen gives breathing room.

"Gak Gak, Gak Kuat" (DJ-style remix; tag "suara asli – Dlzy X'z – paid edit bio"). Lyric screen uses words from the sung line (3–4 words per line). rea: 148 BPM C major; text pills/slams hit on half-beats (≈0.2 s); only 33% of cuts exactly on beat since many are micro-flashes.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas 1080x1080. Palette: white `#F3F3F3`, lilac `#8B63E6/#B79CFF`, pink-magenta gradient `#FF3D8D→#C92BD8`, mustard `#F2D66B`, teal `#4FD0C4`. Fonts: Lilita One (puffy hero), Baloo 2 ExtraBold (pills/lyrics).
- Ink-splat bookends: SVG blob mask scale 0→4 (in) / reverse (out) as first intro and outro scene.
- `roles:{intro:[inkTitle], build:[browserPills], brk:[polaroidSticker], drop:[karaokeScroll], drop2:[browserPills,strobeGirls], outro:[inkOut]}`; seams `["flash","blur","whip"]`.
- intro `inkTitle(c)`: speedlines pulse, hero slam from x−140 rot−18 scale1.6→1 back.out, ring `AE.writeOn` around it, brush underline sweep, second word drops above.
- build `browserPills(c)`: photo into browser card (dots, radius 18px, grid-paper bg), pill `AE.pillIn` over face, cursor PNG tap (scale .85 + click burst), pills replace per beat sliding opposite ways.
- brk `polaroidSticker(c)`: polaroid rot 8deg shrink 100→78%, sticker words slam, doodle loop draw-on.
- drop `karaokeScroll(c)`: player header + lyric stack — words pop y14 blur4→0, finished lines scale .65/y−70/opacity .6, bottom masked by teal bar (mask-image gradient).
- drop2 `strobeGirls(c)`: two photos alternate with white-wash frames on beats, then spin/zoom-blur flurry on drum fills (0.1–0.2s swaps).
- Helpers: AE.pill/pillIn, AE.words, AE.pop, AE.sparkles, AE.writeOn, AE.strobe.
- Post FX: `wave` warp 3f on drop2 photo, `spinblur/zoomblur` flurry, `flash` white frames, glow on outro credit.
- Assets: 5 portraits, cursor PNG, ink blob SVGs, doodle/star SVGs, grid-paper CSS.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero slams (puffy Lilita): 1–2 word questions/exclamations, slam + ring + underline in intro; repeated as sticker near polaroid.
- Pills on browser photo: one short label per beat, clicked by cursor, replaced sliding opposite — labels comment on the photo, timed to beats not syllables.
- Karaoke stack (drop): full lines word-by-word (words y+blur in), lines shrink up, teal bar masks the bottom — the only long-text scene, placed after halfway.
- Player header/UI text static. Outro credit = creator name glow.
- Decorative/safe: doodles, stars, speedlines. Unsafe: pills over eyes/face centre (offset to lower third), karaoke before drop, any text during strobe flurry.

The words of the title are used as story caption (3 words), map labels (Ramai sepi / Ini milik / Bersama) and "kita sama2 takkan kemana" caption — lyric-sync is by UI element, roughly on phrase boundaries; rea says 106 BPM F major, only 45% of cuts land exactly on a beat (the micro cuts are free). ## Build recipe (58s) - Canvas 1080x810 (4:3) or centre-crop 9:16. Palette: UI grey `#ECEBE9`, iOS blue `#2F7BF5`, black UI acts; photos carry colour. Fonts: Inter (UI), Anton (story captions/masthead), Cormorant Italic (serif line), Mrs Saint Delafield (signature). - `roles:{intro:[storySquircle], build:[finderAct,albumsAct], brk:[strobeBurst], drop:[mapsAct,storyAct], drop2:[pinterestAct,placeCard], outro:[signatureOut]}`; every seam `AE.trans blur` (crossblur) unless strobe/flash. - intro `storySquircle(c)`: story chrome over group photo, caption per-letter; photo shrinks to squircle (clip-path round 12% + scale .55) on black, spin-out swap per kick. - build `finderAct(c)`: desktop, 2-line typed title + selection box/cursor, folders/thumbs drop in; `albumsAct(c)`: Photos window, album slot cards slide, count badge ticks (`AMV.frames` counter). - brk `strobeBurst(c)`: 8 B&W letterboxed photos 0.1s each (`AE.strobe {bw:true}`), last 2 smeared — the only hard cuts. - drop `mapsAct(c)`: map PNG zoom 1→3 into label (label = text, swaps per beat), pins `AE.pop` stagger; `placeCard(c)`: bottom sheet slides up with photo grid. - drop2 `pinterestAct(c)`: masonry grid rotateZ −12deg diagonal pan; `storyAct` reprise with caption locked while photos swap on white flashes. - outro `signatureOut(c)`: darkened crowd photo, signature `AE.writeOn` + glow, credits column fade, to black. - Helpers: AMV.type/chars/frames, AE.strobe, AE.pop, AE.maskReveal/writeOn, AE.trans blur. - Post FX: crossblur 20px on all seams, `dirblur` in strobe tail, `flash` 1f between story photos, desat+contrast in strobe/finale (grade bw). - Assets: 12–16 group photos (8 strobe-ready), map screenshot, UI window/chrome SVGs, photobooth strip, newspaper texture. ## Lyric/text system - Lyric is delivered ONLY as UI elements, each on phrase boundaries: story caption (per-letter), desktop title (typed + selection box), map labels (swap per beat while zooming), search typing, place-card name. - Locked-caption device (drop2 story): caption stays fixed while photos swap under it on white flashes — text persistence vs photo change is the hook. - Badges/counts are numeric storytelling (album counts tick up), not lyrics. - Masthead + signature outro: one big condensed word over photo, then script signature write-on — title, not lyric. - Decorative/safe: folder names, file labels, credits column. Unsafe: any centred subtitle; if a line can't be made into a UI element, cut it.

## Timeline

## Techniques
- tag: type.behind_subject (3 z-slots)
  what: background layer (blue gradient) → words "OUT/IN/THE/6" → head cut-out PNG → "I'M" on top. Words placed so the head edge clips 20-40% of letters — the occlusion IS the depth cue. Head breathes 1.0→1.04 while words stay → parallax.
  build: DOM order bg, wordsBack, subjectCutout (rembg), wordsFront. GSAP scale subject 1→1.04, wordsBack 1→1.01, wordsFront 1→1.07 over 1 s (different rates = parallax).
- tag: new.banner_strip_stack
  what: photo slices on tilted strips (rotate ±6-10°, slight rotateX 15°) slide in alternately with drop shadow, each carrying a condensed italic word; strips at different z, move at different speeds.
  build: N divs with background-image of different photos, clip to strip, GSAP x from ±120% stagger .12 s expo.out; box-shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35).
- tag: type.3d_space (curved drum line)
  what: lyric lines bend around a convex cylinder and rotate past camera with horizontal smear.
  build: per-word spans with rotateY(i*6°) translateZ(R) on preserve-3d drum; post dir_blur.
- tag: ui.music_player / ui.chat / ui.app_window(maps)
  what: native iOS chrome used as word stages (lyric becomes bubble text / map subtitle).
- tag: type.lyric_word_sync (minimal single word, emoji substitution).

## What makes it look premium
- Occlusion of type by real hair edge reads as genuine 3D with zero 3D software.
- Tight iOS-native design language; transitions always blurred, never plain cuts.

## Build recipe
- Port: `iphone` family scene `behindHead` (cut-out + 3 z-slot words), `bannerStack`, `drumLine`, `mapsPin`. Seams `["zoom","whip","card"]`.

## Lyric/text system
- Title words in z-slots around subject; verses as drum lines; quiet bars single words + emoji.

## Song
Original sound naughtyyjuan (Drake "National Treasures" style rap). ~140 BPM est.

## What makes it look premium
- Camera is a real "dolly across a tabletop": each whip has speed ramp (ease inOut) + directional blur + landing micro-settle, never a linear slide.
- Real-photo texture: paper whites, polaroid drop shadows, dappled sunlight; overlays move independently of the polaroids (parallax).
- Text: personalised handwriting that writes itself; 3 different type voices (marker, script, typed).

"memories" (original sound – ყαrz | MC9; sung female vocal, ~138 BPM F major). Text beats are sparse: "21th" (0.0), "terimakasih" (5.6–7.0), "katanya" (9.6) = the first 3 words of the lyric hook; then purely musical whips. rea notes 44% of cuts on beat; SFX: pop at 0.1/1.0/1.8/2.7 s, click at 4.5/5.4 s.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920. Palette dusty teal #8fb0b4, paper #f2f0ea, ink brown #6b2f26, pin red #a31d2c, mustard #e6a800, copper #c9774b. Fonts: Reenie Beanie (marker numerals/words), Mrs Saint Delafield (signature), Special Elite (typed line), Cormorant Garamond 600 (captions). Look `{glow:.3,glow_thr:.68,rgb:.6,vignette:.26,grain:.03,grade:"warm"}`. This is the existing `scrapbook` template - extend it, do not rebuild.
- Assets: 30+ photos (the wall eats them), 0-1 cutouts, paper texture + leaf-shadow layer (built-in `AE.leafShadow`). Early scenes use black "?" polaroids - generate them as empty `.pol` cards with a "?" caption, no asset needed.
- Scene functions (names match the template so pools can be shared):
  - `intro: [intro1]` - macro pull: giant handwritten NAME at scale 5 blur 10px -> 1 (AE.ease.velo .8s) over the wall at scale .42, name fades up/out at scene end.
  - `build: [envelope, grass]` - envelope: red envelope flap rotationX opens, polaroid slides out, script caption mask-reveals. grass: golden scrapbook, `AE.stack` two taped photos, frosted `AE.pill` lyric label, `AE.parallax` fg bokeh k=2.6.
  - `brk: [notebook]` - lined page, `AMV.type` typed line with caret feel, signature `AE.maskReveal` over it, `AE.focus` rack to the polaroid at scene end. Slowest scene - it is the break.
  - `drop: [wallRun, line]` - wallRun: 3000x4300 wall, `whipTo()` per kick (dirblur 120-140 at peak velocity, landings on `c.k`); line: two clothesline ropes, polaroids swing sine yoyo, track trucks -380px per kick.
  - `drop2: [panels, wallRun, strobePol]` - panels: 3 torn strips + hero polaroid + red brush heart `AE.writeOn` + `AE.face` pushes on later kicks; strobePol: `AE.strobe({every:3})` then `AE.fan`.
  - `outro: [outro]` - wall at dusk (dark overlay .45), handwritten thanks + NAME write-on, slow pull.
- Seams/post: template seams `["whip","blur","whip","flash","blur","whip","zoom","blur","whip","iris","whip","blur","flash","whip"]`. Post: dirblur only inside whipTo, no rgb except strobePol snare accents. SFX pops on write-ons if SFX=1.
- Helpers: `AE.leafShadow` in EVERY scene (it is the signature - never skip), `AE.stack/fan/strobe/focus/parallax/pill/pillIn/writeOn/maskReveal`, `AMV.type`.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the handwritten NAME and the script signature line are the heroes - they write on over 0.9-1.2s, starting on the vocal phrase, ~4 frames per letter. Only ONE handwritten hero per scene.
- Lyric pills: frosted serif pills (`AE.pill`) carry the actual sung fragment for that scene - appear on the word's time (`c.at(n)` / lyricTimes), soft scale .9->1, never more than one pill visible per photo cluster.
- UI labels: polaroid captions ("us", a heart, a date) are decorative - 1-2 words from CFG, safe anywhere on the white polaroid border (bottom strip only, never over faces). The "?" placeholders must stay empty until the drop swaps them for real photos.
- Typed line: the Special Elite typed line in `notebook` is a lyric fragment typed at vocal speed; keep it to the scene's words only. Safe decorative zones: wall whitespace between polaroids (the big marker word), envelope front, outro centre. Unsafe: over the hero polaroid's face area and over the signature while it is writing.

# r3 — iPhone-UI loop edit: IG story -> camera -> photo picker -> share sheet, typed text per screen (16.7s, 1:1 720x720, 20fps, 123 BPM, loop period ~3.9s = 8 beats, ~0.9 cuts/s)
STYLE-KEY: iphone-typed-loop-escalation
CLOSEST-EXISTING: iphone
NOVELTY: A single cut-off typed sentence travels across story/camera/picker/share-sheet in an 8-beat loop that only adds ghosts/blur per pass; iphone has the screens but not loop-escalation or sentence-across-screens.
## Look
- Pure screen-recording look: black IG story editor, white iPhone camera viewfinder (grid + HDR + shutter), light-grey iOS photo picker + share sheet. Selfie footage is warm, slightly soft; UI is crisp.
- Text: thin grotesk (Inter / SF-like, ~14-18 px at 720), white on black or black on light sheet; typed one char at a time, ends with a hyphen "-" (cut-off sentence).
- Post: later loops get progressive ghost/echo + directional motion blur (frame-blend 2-3 copies, ~6-14 px smear on whips), light RGB ghosting on text. No grain, no grade.
## Timeline (loop A 0-4.0, loops B/C/D start ~4.4 / 8.3 / 12.2, tail 16.1-16.7)
0.0-0.5 | black | none | hard cut in | tiny centred text types "wya?" char by char (~0.1s/char) | - | - | sentence starts on 1st beat
0.5-1.0 | IG story editor: 4 white-border polaroid cards floating in 3D on black, right tool column (Aa/sticker/music/draw), bottom "Your story / Close Friends" pills | cards drift + rotate slowly (parallax, ~3-6 deg) | cut | "my" types lower-left at 0.9 (SFX click 0.9s) | - | on beat
1.0-1.9 | same story; cards keep floating; later loops add a cyan scribble-sparkle sticker on the cards | slow drift | 1.9: selfie card swipes in from the right edge (card-slide, 0.15s) | - | -
1.9-2.7 | iPhone camera viewfinder, smiling selfie, grid lines, HDR, shutter ring | static handheld sway | 2.1-2.2 white/beige block wipes top->down (shutter flash as 2 stacked rects, 0.1s) | - | beat 2.1
2.5-2.65 | camera mode picker slides (vertical bars + yellow mode label) | - | - | - | -
2.7-3.4 | black | - | smear cut | "close to my-" types char by char, baseline wobbles (slight rotate 1-2 deg, sine y ~2px) then hyphen | - |
3.4-3.9 | photo picker: 3 photo cards behind vertical blind/lenticular bars, "Options >" | lenticular bar blur fades to sharp over 0.3s | whip-ish blur-in | - | -
3.9-4.4 | share sheet (AirDrop/Messages/Mail row + "Add to Album") | - | - | "where you-" types at left, "Add to Album" below | - | loop restarts on beat
4.4+ | repeats A with echo: each repeat adds ghost copies of text (offset 1-3 px, 30-50% opacity) and heavier blur on every cut; last repeat only reaches share sheet text at 16.1, black at 16.5
## Techniques
- tag: ui.app_window / ui.iphone_camera / ui.iphone_share_sheet
  what: pixel-faithful iOS screens used as "scenes": story editor, camera, picker, share sheet. Each ~0.4-0.9s.
  build: HTML divs styled like iOS (rounded sheet, blur backdrop-filter, SF font stack); one scene per section; hard cut between; shutter = two white rects wiping 0.1s.
- tag: type.typewriter
  what: text types one char at a time (0.08-0.12s/char, steps ease), no caret, sentence ends mid-word with "-". Text is placed ON the UI (over the story, in the share sheet) not in a caption layer.
  build: GSAP timeline per char opacity 0->1 with stagger 0.1; sprinkle +-2px y jitter and 1deg rotate per char; use a tiny delay between chars for a swing feel.
- tag: ph.frame_card
  what: polaroid cards floating in a 3D tilt on black (IG "photo stickers"); slow orbit drift.
  build: 4 absolutely positioned cards with rotateX/Y/Z 3-8deg yoyo sine (4-6s), perspective:800px, box-shadow.
- tag: trans.card_slide
  what: next screen enters from the right edge as a flat card (0.15s, ease-out), then fills frame.
  build: x: 100% -> 0, power3.out 0.15s.
- tag: fx.motion_blur / ph.echo_trail
  what: loops 2-4 add 2-3 ghost frames (frame-blend) and directional smear on whips.
  build: post pass: ffmpeg tmix/minterpolate-like blend or OpenCV accumulate of last 3 frames with weights 0.5/0.3/0.2.
- tag: new.loop_escalation
  what: same 8-beat sequence repeats 4x; each repeat only adds one new element (sticker, ghost, blur) so it feels like it builds while staying cheap.
  build: one scene timeline called 4 times with a `level` param controlling ghost count / blur px / sticker visibility.
## What makes it look premium
Believable UI detail (grid, HDR icons, pills), text that is typed ON the UI so it reads as a real message in progress, strict 8-beat loop with tiny escalation, and echo blur only on transitions.
## Song
Original sound / stock-style bed, 123 BPM C major, 4 click SFX (0.9, 8.7, 9.6s) coincide with text pops. Lyrics are a cut-off sentence typed across screens (fragments only).

## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas 1080x1080. Pure iOS look: black story editor, white camera, light-grey sheets. Font: Inter (SF-like) 14–18px at 720 scale. No grade/grain.
- Loop engine, not linear roles: build one 8-beat cycle `cycle(level)` and call it for intro/build/drop/drop2 with level 0→3; brk = black typed beat; outro = final cycle truncated to black.
- `cycle(l)`: [blackType → storyFloat → cameraSnap → blackType2 → pickerBars → shareType]; each screen 0.4–0.9s, `AMV.scenes` hard cuts.
- storyFloat: 4 polaroid cards perspective 800px, rotateX/Y 3–8deg sine drift (`AE.wiggle`), right tool column + bottom pills (HTML chrome); selfie card slides in last beat (`AE.trans` card x100→0 .15s).
- cameraSnap: viewfinder chrome (grid/HDR/shutter), shutter = 2 white rects wipe 0.1s on kick, mode strip slides.
- blackType screens: `AMV.type` per char 0.1s, ±2px y jitter + 1deg rot per char, sentence fragments placed ON the UI (never centred captions); end fragments with hyphen.
- pickerBars: photo cards behind vertical blind bars, blur→sharp 0.3s; share sheet slides up.
- Escalation per level: +1 ghost copy of text (offset 1–3px, 30–50%), +blur on cuts, +1 sticker on cards (level≥1).
- Helpers: AMV.type/chars/scenes, AE.wiggle, AE.echo (ghost frames), AE.trans whip for picker.
- Post FX: frame-blend echo (0.5/0.3/0.2 last-3-frames) growing per level, `dirblur` 6–14px on whips, light `rgb` on text ghosts; nothing else.
- Assets: 4–5 selfie photos (same subject), iOS chrome SVG set, 1 sticker.

## Lyric/text system
- One cut-off sentence is the whole lyric system: typed per char (0.1s) across screens — fragment ends on black, next fragment inside the next UI. Never show the complete sentence at once.
- Text lives ON UI surfaces (over story cards, inside share sheet), small Inter, white-on-black or black-on-sheet; baseline wobble ±2px/1deg sells hand-typing.
- Click SFX + pop coincide with fragment starts (beat 1 of each screen).
- Ghost echoes in later loops are the same fragments offset — repetition, not new text.
- Decorative/safe: all iOS chrome labels. Unsafe: centred captions, completing the sentence, or typing during camera snap (shutter beat stays clean).

# q19 — "Vintage-TV + AI-still lyric preset" (white flash / green light-leak transitions)   (20.8 s, 960x720 4:3, 30 fps, ~106 BPM beat 0.566 s, 10 shots, avg 2.1 s, 0.5 cuts/s)

NOVELTY: Retro TVs, cloud skywriting and AI stills unified only by white blow-out + lime leak transitions and a two-tier script/subtitle system; vintage has the grade but not the leak-as-transition or skywriting.

Subtitle line (always bottom-centre, ~9 px tall at 960 w) = tiny sans (Inter 11px) gold, typed line-by-line.

## Timeline
0.0–0.5 | 3 olive-green retro TVs on cream; camera starts extremely close on the left TV (fills frame) and pulls back | cam.pull ~4x→1x in 0.5 s ease-out | in: hard cut | — | left TV shows snow/ghost figures, middle red, right grey-brown (screens play tiny loops) | slight motion blur on pull | —
0.2–1.5 | title "Merry Christmas I Miss You" writes on (script, left→right, ~1.3 s) under the TVs | TVs slowly shrink 100→88% | | type.handwritten | — | — | —
1.6–2.9 | hold: TVs + title, very slow push 2% | | | | | |
2.9–3.4 | ghost fade → white bloom (whole frame +100% exposure) | | trans.flash_white (0.5 s, 8–9 frames ramp) | | fx.exposure_pulse | | lands ≈ cut 3.33
3.3–4.7 | blue-sky scene, tree branch lower-left, yellow sun-blob dots drifting; cloud-letters "SO" (3.3) then "WHAT" (3.7) grow in (scale 0.7→1, opacity, slight perspective tilt -10°) | slow push-in | in: from white (fade) | type.3d_space (letters are 3D cloud puffs) | yellow bokeh dots | | word every ~0.4 s (≈1 beat)
4.0–4.7 | "IF I" bottom-left / "CAN'T" right appear | | | fade+scale | | | beats 4.0, 4.5
4.6–5.1 | white-out again (right side first) | | flash_white | | exposure | | cut 4.47–5.1
5.1–7.6 | Polaroid pile on table (overhead), slight rotation; green leak at right edge for first 0.3 s then fades; heavy vignette | cam.push 4% + slow roll ~2° | in: green/white light-leak sweep R→L (5.1–5.4) | — | vignette, soft blur edges, tilt-shift (top and bottom out of focus) | | cut 5.1
7.6–7.9 | ghost crossfade of same pile (reframed) | slight whip | crossdissolve 0.3 s | | | | 7.8 cut
8.0–12.8 | same pile close-up reframed (different pile area, photos tilted), gold subtitle typed bottom "And you pick up the phone" (8.4–10.1) | slow push + drift | | subtitle line fades in 0.3 s | | | cut 7.8
12.8–13.1 | white sweep + green leak | | trans.light_leak | | | | cut 12.87
13.0–15.0 | mountain/train-window shot: first fullscreen, then black TV-style rounded window frame closes in (13.3) leaving black margins; script "and I use" (white, 13.5) then "This Holiday" (scarlet, 13.7–14.6) written-on over the scenery | window scale 100→88% | | type.handwritten, two colours | grass + clouds parallax drift | | cut 12.87; subtitle "And I use this holiday" gold
15.0–15.4 | white + lime leak out | | flash/light_leak | | | | cut 15.37
15.4–19.2 | antique mirror + roses scene; torn parchment on top (burnt edges), crimson roses bottom-left; subtitle "to make my way to your ghost"; very slow push 6% | | | | dust motes | | cut 16.03 (shot change within same scene: mirror reframe)
19.2–19.5 | heavy blur dissolve to extreme-blur version | | trans.crossblur | | | |
19.5–20.8 | blurred dark mirror scene + tiny white script signature (name, centre) fades in, whole frame fades to black at 20.8 | | | | | | outro

## Techniques
- tag: trans.flash_white + new.trans.light_leak
  what: 4 of 5 scene changes are "white blow-out + lime-green vertical light bar entering from the right edge and moving left" (≈0.3–0.5 s). Exposure rises to pure white, then next scene fades down from white.
  build: overlay div with linear-gradient(to left, #7cff2a 0%, transparent 35%) + a pure-white layer; GSAP opacity 0→1→0 over 12 frames; blendMode screen; plus translateX(60%→-20%) of the green bar. For the post pass: add a screen-blended gradient frame with random offsets.
- tag: cam.pull / cam.push (macro start)
  what: opens extremely close on one TV (scale ~4x) and pulls back to reveal all 3 in 0.5 s; every later shot is a 3–6% push with 1–2° roll.
  build: gsap.fromTo(stage,{scale:4,x:..},{scale:1,duration:.5,ease:'power3.out'}); later gsap.to(stage,{scale:1.05,rotation:1.5,duration:shotLen,ease:'none'}).
- tag: type.handwritten
  what: signature title writes on left→right in ~1.3 s; scarlet "This Holiday" overlaps the white script and is written one word after.
  build: SVG text → outlined paths from a script font; animate stroke-dashoffset or a mask-image linear-gradient wipe moving left→right; two colours = two layers.
- tag: type.3d_space (cloud skywriting)
  what: "SO", "WHAT", "IF I", "CAN'T" are 3D cloud puffs seen in perspective, one word per beat (~0.4 s apart), fade out with the white-out.
  build: pre-rendered PNG of text with cloud texture (blur + noise displacement) → gsap.from scale .7/opacity 0, rotationX 20°, stagger .4. Or Three.js text with a cloud material (heavy).
- tag: fx.vignette + tilt-shift
  what: left/right darkened, top/bottom blurred on all the still scenes (makes AI stills look like macro photography).
  build: radial-gradient overlay mix-blend multiply + CSS mask on a blurred duplicate (filter blur 6px, mask linear-gradient top/bottom).
- tag: ui.window_frame (new) — scenic still is dropped inside a rounded black TV/train-window frame at 13.3 (scale 100%→88%) tying back to the retro TV motif.
- tag: lyric subtitle bar (new.type.subtitle) — tiny gold line at bottom, line-by-line, simple fade; keeps the big script text free for emotion.

## What makes it look premium
- Strong colour-world per scene (cream TVs, sky blue, sepia polaroids, train-window teal, mirror crimson) – each scene a distinct "set" but unified by warm soft light.
- Transitions are all the same family (white + green leak), so the piece feels designed, not random.
- Macro push-in on every still (never static), vignette + tilt-shift for depth, script text that "writes" rather than pops.
- Two-layer typography: big emotional script + tiny gold subtitle.

## Song
"Merry Christmas I Miss You" (Alex Crichton edit, tag MCIMY) — rea: 106 BPM A minor, 33% of cuts on beat; scene length ≈ 4 beats–8 beats (2.3–4.7 s). The skywriting words ("SO WHAT IF I...") follow the sung words one by one; subtitle gold line mirrors the vocal line, scarlet "This Holiday" lands on the sung phrase.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas 1080x810 (4:3). Palette: cream `#F1EDE6`, olive `#7E8A3C`, sky teal, sepia, crimson; accent gold `#E0B050`, scarlet. Fonts: Mrs Saint Delafield (title/script), Great Vibes (mid script), Inter tiny (subtitle).
- One transition family for whole film: white blow-out + lime leak bar R→L.
- `roles:{intro:[tvReveal], build:[skyWords,polaroidPile], brk:[windowScene], drop:[polaroidPile,mirrorScene], drop2:[skyWords,windowScene], outro:[blurSignature]}`; seams all `["flash"]` + leak overlay.
- intro `tvReveal(c)`: 3 retro-TV frames (photos inside screens), camera scale 4→1 0.5s, title `AE.writeOn` under, slow push 2%.
- build `skyWords(c)`: sky photo, cloud-text PNGs (pre-rendered, blur+noise) scale .7→1 per word on kicks; `polaroidPile(c)`: overhead pile photo push 4% + roll 2°, vignette + tilt-shift (blurred top/bottom duplicate mask).
- brk `windowScene(c)`: scenic photo, black rounded window frame scales 100→88%, white script then scarlet script write-on over it.
- drop = longer holds of pile/mirror scenes (push 6%), subtitle line per line; drop2 re-crops same photos tighter (reframe, not new assets).
- outro `blurSignature(c)`: crossblur to blurred scene, tiny script signature fade, to black.
- Helpers: AE.writeOn/maskReveal, AE.focus/defocusIn, AE.trans flash, AMV.type for subtitle.
- Post FX: exposure `flash` + green leak gradient (screen blend, translateX 60→−20%), vignette/tilt-shift in-scene, soft bloom; no grain beyond dust.
- Assets: 5 scenic/AI stills, 3 TV-screen mini photos, 4 cloud-word PNGs, parchment texture.

## Lyric/text system
- Two-tier system: (1) big emotional script — title + 1 short phrase per scene, written on L→R (writeOn), scarlet for the hook phrase; (2) tiny gold subtitle bottom-centre, one full line at a time, simple fade, mirrors the vocal line.
- Skywriting words: one sung word per beat as cloud PNGs in the sky scene — hero words, but textured as objects.
- The subtitle carries information; the script carries emotion. Never put the same words in both tiers simultaneously (ref offsets them by a beat).
- Decorative/safe: TV-screen mini loops, dust, parchment. Unsafe: bold sans captions — only script + tiny sans allowed; keep subtitle ≤ ~9px at 960w equivalent.

## What makes it look premium
- Every lyric word lives inside a believable device UI, so cuts feel like switching apps, not slides.
- Consistent pink/white/blue system + star/scribble vocabulary across 5 different "screens".
- Ghost-dissolve portrait reward after the flat UI acts; seamless loop structure (end = start energy).

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: extend `y2k` template — add `digicamStage`, `pillColumn`, `phonePortal` scenes. Ref is a 32s seamless loop (A + A′ reprise); at 58s: A→intro/build/brk, drop = second device cycle with new photos, drop2 = phone+portrait reprise *escalated* (bigger pushes), outro = logotype card. Seams: `["zoom","flip","whip","blur","glitch"]`; ink splash is an in-scene overlay, not a seam.
- `intro: [digicamLCD, igPost]` — digicamLCD: silver camera body (CSS chrome + diagonal glare gradient) rotate -8°→+4°, LCD holds `P(0)`, bubble words slam per syllable (`AE.words`), stars `AE.sparkles`. igPost: IG post replica, bubble letters cascade down right edge (per-letter spans, stagger 0.08), mini-grid slides in.
- `build: [playerCard, pillColumn]` — playerCard: solid pink card, 3 wavy-baseline lyric lines marquee x -40px/s, progress bar + pause glyph. pillColumn: portrait card + 2 blue pills duplicated ×4 as a column, camera pans down continuously, pills `AE.pop` per beat.
- `brk: [digicamText]` — ink splash wipe in (SVG dash-draw 0.25s), digicam returns: LCD first shows a 1-word text state, scribble oval draws (`AE.writeOn`), then LCD swaps to photo. Stillness of device rock ±3° only.
- `drop: [phonePortal, ghostPortrait]` — phonePortal: phone mockup rotateY 60°→0 (perspective wrapper), settles, pushes scale→1.6 until screen dissolves to full portrait. ghostPortrait: portrait + 40% offset ghost copy drifting (`AE.echo`-like manual stack), slow push.
- `drop2: [digicamLCD, pillColumn, ghostPortrait]` — new photos/words, phonePortal again with stamped words behind phone.
- `outro: [logoCard]` — ink splash to black, glowing lowercase logotype (= artist/handle) fades centre.
- Palette: pink #f49ac1/#f7a8c4, pill blue #2d9cdb, silver #d9d9de, white. Fonts: Baloo 2 ExtraBold (bubble, white stroke via text-shadow stack), Inter (UI). `AE.base({glow:.2,glow_thr:.65,rgb:.5,vignette:.15,grain:.008})`.
- Post FX events: `dirblur` on vertical whip out of pillColumn, `glow` pulses on word slams in drop, `zoomblur` at phonePortal landing; splash/flash via DOM.
- Assets: 25+ photos (2 hero portraits for ghost dissolves), camera/phone bodies = CSS builds (no PNG needed), star/scribble SVGs.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: bubble slams on/around devices = sung words, one per beat/syllable from `CFG.lyrics` (`AE.words` times = `ctx.lyricTimes()`). LCD text state in brk = the hook word only.
- UI labels: player header, IG like/comment counts, camera UI icons, logotype outro — functional/static, safe. Player marquee lines ARE lyric (3 real fragments scrolling) — don't substitute slogans.
- Stickers/decorative: stars, scribble oval, pink grid-pattern shapes — wordless. Blue chat pills: each pill = a sung fragment (they're chat-carried lyric like t25); grey reply bubble = next fragment.
- Safe decorative text: only device chrome ("OK", REC dot, battery) and the end logotype. Any pink bubble word anywhere will be parsed as lyric — no filler bubbles.

## Song
Original sound by creator ᴀʟᴏʀᴀᴍᴢ {ʜ.ᴘ} ("suara asli", preset loop track, ~128 BPM est.). Lyric words drive every device swap; word pops land on beats, portraits land on phrase ends.

- tag: ov.sparkle — blue 4-point star (SVG) bursts scale 0→1.3→1 rotate 45° on stressed syllables. build: reuse one symbol, spawn at letter positions.
- tag: ui.chat — black phone with yellow rim; grey left / blue right bubbles type text; used as intro-outro bracket. build: phone div, bubble divs, per-char type.

## What makes it look premium
- Nothing ever sits still: even "empty" beats have grid, watermark and a typing annotation.
- Strict 3-colour + black-bar system across 14 phrases = instantly recognisable preset identity.
- Letter scatter/assemble + camera travel makes cuts unnecessary; energy comes from typography itself.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: pure typography — no photos needed except optional chat avatar. Closest template `kinetic3d` is 3D-extruded; this ref is *flat* 2D on a travelling white canvas, so build as a new lightweight scene family inside a kinetic3d fork or standalone: one persistent `.grid` layer (dot grid via radial-gradient background-image, 28px tile + hairline crosses) that never cuts; a `#world` wrapper GSAP pans/pushes between phrase stations (this is the "camera"). Seams: use `seamAt` → `"none"` for most (motion is continuous), `"zoom"` only into the phone coda and final word. 58s expansion: ref is 17s of ~14 phrases — at 58s you need ~40 phrase stations; cycle station types, don't invent new ones.
- `intro: [buildWord, annotate]` — buildWord: hero word letters `AMV.chars` + gsap from {scale:1.6,rotation:±20,y:30} stagger 0.05 `AE.ease.land`; yellow hill blob (border-radius 50% div) grows bottom. annotate: tiny italic cue types beside it.
- `build: [stackWords, censorHit, scatterAssemble]` — stackWords: 2 words `AE.words(...,{style:"slam"})` yellow over blue + arrow glyphs `AE.pop`. censorHit: black bar scaleX behind word (`AE.maskReveal` dir left on a black div) + sparkle burst `AE.sparkles`. scatterAssemble: letters start scattered/rotated, assemble on the kick.
- `brk: [phoneChat]` — black phone (yellow rim) rises `AE.stack from:"bottom"`, bubbles type the vocal fragment; whole world scales down behind it. This is the freeze moment — keep it at the engine's brk slot.
- `drop: [rotateWord, pushThrough, stackWords]` — rotateWord: word rotates -8°→3° with bar wipe + triangle stickers; pushThrough: camera scale 1→1.8 through a letter + `AE.fx("zoomblur",K,{amt:.45})`; every kick = new word slam (engine velo cam does the snap — set `cam:{velo:.5,hand:0}`).
- `drop2: [outlineWord, strikethrough, scatterAssemble]` — outlineWord: thin-outline wide word draws per letter + heavy slam below; strikethrough: blue/yellow strokes + wavy ribbons (SVG paths), letters blur-scatter out.
- `outro: [phoneChatFinal]` — back in phone, last bubble's word scales out toward camera, fade to white (engine fade + `flash` event low amt).
- Palette: white #fff, yellow #ffd21a, blue #1e8fe8, black #111, grid #dbe4f0. Fonts: Baloo 2 ExtraBold (hero), Montserrat Thin Italic (outline word), Inter Italic (annotations/watermark). `AE.base({glow:.05,rgb:.5,vignette:0,grain:.004})` — keep it flat; premium = cleanliness.
- Post FX events: `dirblur` only on the 2-3 fastest world pans, `zoomblur` on pushThrough + drop hits (engine). No grain/glow bloom.
- Assets: 0 photos required; optional 1 avatar for chat. All decoration is SVG (squiggles, arrows, sparkles, triangles).

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: EVERY hero word is a real sung word — this template is unusable without `CFG.lyrics`. One word (max 2) per station, letters land so the *last letter* hits the kick/vocal onset: schedule station at `lyricTime - nLetters*0.05`. Use `AE.lyric3d`? No — flat: `AE.words` slam + per-letter spans. If a vocal word is long (>8 chars) use the outline-word station (thin font fits).
- UI labels: the tiny italic annotations ("-slow", "-slide") are *stage directions*, not lyrics — safe, keep them lowercase italic blue, ≤14px equivalent, and never let them form a phrase. Watermark = creator/artist handle bottom-centre, static.
- Stickers/decorative: arrows, squiggles, sparkles, triangles, hill blob — wordless only. The phone chat bubbles in brk/outro DO carry lyric (they're the vocal line as messages) — same lyrics feed, typed per char.
- Unsafe: inventing English words to fill stations. If lyrics run out (instrumental drop), repeat the *hook word* as outline echo at 25% opacity or run scatter/assemble on the previous word — never new text.

## Song
Original sound (uploader/zeemo), English sung vocal; every hero word is lyric-synced (text described, not transcribed — max 2–3 words legible per moment). ~136 BPM; letter landings, bar slides and sparkles hit the 0.44 s grid.

- tag: ph.frame_card (polaroid board)

- tag: new.board_camera_travel
  what: instead of cutting between boards, one oversized board (200–300% stage size) is panned/pushed under a fixed camera; new polaroid clusters enter by camera move, giving a physical desk feel. Pushes 4–12% per segment, pans 100–200 px.
  build: .board{width:260%;height:260%} inside overflow-hidden stage; GSAP timeline of x/y/scale/rotation(-1..1deg) keyframes per segment, ease power1.inOut 1.5–3 s; segments above marked "board travel" are these moves, not cuts.
- tag: type.typewriter (caption strip)
