## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920; acts: white vignette, dark UI #23242a, teal player #3c6a87, white Pinterest, black DM, saturated finale. Fonts: Syne 800 (tracked lines, letterspacing .12em), Inter (UI), Inter italic 700 (DM caption). Tea-leaf/brand sticker = one recurring SVG sticker that travels between scenes. Look `{glow:.35,glow_thr:.68,rgb:.6,vignette:.25,grain:.03,grade:"cool"}`.
- Assets: 20+ photos of the SAME subject set (cohesion is the trick - reuse the same 6 photos as avatar/post/grid/DM/finale), clover/heart stickers = text glyphs or SVG. Finale needs photos that work full-bleed.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [titleLines]` - 3 lines appear per syllable (`AE.words` per-letter drop variant or local spans, 2-3f/letter, 3px shadow), brand sticker pops and slides corner-to-corner as lines land; slow push.
  - `build: [avatarBubbles, igPost]` - avatarBubbles: circular avatars with rings + name pills slide/pop in, keypad circles drift as depth props, cluster orbits with 3D tilt, zoom THROUGH the centre avatar. igPost: photo shrinks into a glass IG card rotY -20, comment chips type one by one, red heart pops and shrinks into the like icon; blue message bubbles then slide in and marquee in opposing rows.
  - `brk: [lyricPlayer]` - Spotify-style player: 3 lyric rows (crisp active centre, blurred neighbours), each row marquee-scrolls at its own speed/direction, stack shifts up one row per phrase. Calm, UI-true - this is the break.
  - `drop: [pinterestDM]` - Pinterest: search types (`AMV.type`), masonry of the same photos pops staggered, clover stickers sprinkle; crossblur to DM: caption top, photo bubble rises from the input bar, sent/reply bubbles slide.
  - `drop2: [fullFinale]` - chat card blur-zooms out INTO full-bleed photos: cuts per kick, push 3-5% per shot; treatments rotate - wave warp (feDisplacement), diagonal white wedge wipe, 2-4f b/w flash, zoomblur seams.
  - `outro: [markFade]` - last photo desaturates + vignette, black, brush creator mark fades in with glow, out.
- Seams/post: `seams:["flash","zoom","blur","blur","zoom"]`. Post: crossblur between UI acts (blur is the glue), wave/zoomblur only in the finale, `AE.impact` never - finale energy is cuts + push, accents on snares as glow.
- Helpers: `AMV.type, AE.pop, AE.fx`; local vignette builders + lyric-marquee rows.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero lines: intro lines and player rows carry sung fragments (2-3 words), word-timed. In the player, only the CENTRE row is the current line; top/bottom rows are previous/next at blur 3-6px + 50% - they may show adjacent lyric lines because blur marks them as context, but never style them crisp early.
- Marquee rows: a row may scroll its own fragment repeatedly (loop within the row) - safe because it is the same fragment; do not scroll a different line's words through the active row.
- UI labels: name pills, comment chips, DM bubbles, search text are messages - write them as CFG chat hooks (2-4 words), typed on UI beats, NOT as lyric subtitles. The DM photo-bubble label is a CFG caption.
- Stickers: clovers/hearts/brand leaf carry no words (brand sticker may keep its 2-word CFG name). Decorative text safe zones: Pinterest captions under cards, DM header. Unsafe: finale photos get NO text except the outro mark - text there breaks the payoff; avatar name pills must stay names, not lyrics.

## Techniques
- tag: type.word_slam + new.type.sticker_outline — blue text with 3 px cream outline + 2 px offset shadow, lands with scale 1.3->1 (4 frames, back.out) and ±3° rotation; tick-burst lines (5 short strokes) radiate on landing.
  build: -webkit-text-stroke:6px #e3cfa5 with paint-order:stroke fill; gsap.from scale 1.3, rotation random(-6,6), duration .13, ease back.out(2).
- tag: type.wave — per-letter y-hop (20 px) stagger .04.
- tag: ov.sticker — emoji (thinking face), banknotes, suitcase, plane, flag as flat PNG/emoji; bounce-in with overshoot; they act as punctuation.
- tag: trans.glitch — 2-frame rgb_split (±12 px) + horizontal dir_blur 40 px between phrases. build: post pass.
- tag: new.trans.pixel_iris — mosaic-blocked circle grows then reveals next scene through hole.
- tag: new.fx.twirl — OpenCV remap swirl, angle 0 -> 6 rad -> 0 over 8 frames at board centre.
- tag: new.fx.tone_flip — alternate cool/sepia LUT every beat on a static board (cheap energy).
- tag: cam.push — slow 6% push on act 2; cam.dutch on vertical word stack.
## What makes it look premium
- Strict 2-colour type system (blue on cream) so 15 different sprites never feel messy.
- Every phrase has a small physical gag (X, drop, wave, plane) that arrives 1-2 frames after the word lands.
- Act 2 contrast: static cutout with only camera + colour flips => reward after the busy act 1.
## Song
original sound (suara asli - Ryo chan); text is lyric-synced to a fast vocal (word per 0.2-0.4 s). Not transcribed here.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920. Act 1 cream #f4e9d4 + electric blue #3c4bf0 with cream outline #e3cfa5; act 2 newspaper grey halftone + sepia #c8a47a / blue-grey flips. Fonts: Anton (fat words, `-webkit-text-stroke:8px #e3cfa5; paint-order:stroke fill` + offset shadow), Archivo Black (one line), Bangers (board title over chest). Look `{glow:.3,glow_thr:.7,rgb:.8,vignette:.2,grain:.03,grade:"warm"}`.
- Assets: 12+ photos, 1 hero cutout (`c.C(0)`, the board subject), emoji/object sprites as PNG/text glyphs (thinking face, banknote, suitcase, plane, flag, arrows), newspaper board = CSS (halftone radial dots + serif headline + microtext columns + thumbnail stack). Torn notebook page = CSS.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [stickerWords]` - words land scale 1.3->1 in 4f (back.out 2) with tick-burst (5 short SVG strokes radiate); per-letter bounce under; torn page slides in, red X draws over it (stroke-dash .25s), page exits.
  - `build: [spriteGags]` - each phrase gets ONE gag 1-2f after the word: falling outlined numerals/words (gravity + bounce), thinking emoji grows onto the word, banknote floats, letters hop in an arch (`type.wave`: y -20px stagger .04), suitcase pushes the word, plane flies through it. 2-frame rgb smear between phrases.
  - `brk: [spinStack]` - words build a rotated vertical stack (90/270/330deg) that rotates like a rolling cube (dutch +-20deg), pixel cursor hand moves toward it; pixel-disc iris (mosaic circle grows, then reveals through the hole) exits. Slower, bigger - the break.
  - `drop: [newsBoard]` - hero cutout over the newspaper board, comic title across the chest, slow push 6%; the ONLY motion is tone flips (sepia <-> blue-grey LUT swap) on kicks + a 2f mirrored-text glitch once. Restraint after act 1 chaos is the drop design.
  - `drop2: [boardTwirl]` - same board: twirl warp once (8f, angle to ~6rad and back - post `AE.fx("wave")` approx or CSS SVG swirl), diagonal split-tone wipe (half sepia/half blue, hard line slides), tone flips continue per kick.
  - `outro: [sepiaOut]` - board settles sepia, blur dissolve, end. No card.
- Seams/post: `seams:["glitch","glitch","iris","cut"]`. Post: rgb+dirblur smears (2f) between act-1 phrases, tone flip is a CSS filter state toggled on kicks (not a post event), twirl approximated by `AE.fx("wave",t,{amt:...})` - flag it as the one effect to verify in fxpost.
- Helpers: `AE.pop, AE.fx`, local wave-hop letters + tick burst; `AE.stickerCSS` for the cutout.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: fat blue sticker words, ONE phrase (1-3 words) at a time, each word lands on its syllable and the gag lands 1-2 frames LATER (word first, joke second - reversing this reads as random).
- Sprites replace words sparingly: an emoji may sit ON a word but may not substitute for a sung word more than once per film; the subtitle-less viewer must still be able to read every phrase.
- UI labels: newspaper headline/microtext are texture - keep microtext illegible (<=20px, low contrast). The board's comic title is the subject's NAME (CFG), not a lyric.
- Decorative text safe zones: cream margins, torn page (CFG sketch words ok, crossed by the X), board thumbnail captions. Unsafe: no text during the pixel-iris or twirl frames; act-2 board gets no new words at all - only the name, or the calm breaks.

- Pills/labels rotate and bounce with overshoot every beat, never linear.
- Photo act reuses the same type language (stroke + tape) so the transition from type to clip feels continuous.
- Glitches arrive in clusters just on beats then rest: mosaic, mirror, RGB, slit, liquify - 5 different FX used once or twice each.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920 (source 1:1 - rebuild 9:16, white stage taller). Act 1 white #ffffff + ink black, dot accents cyan #43c3f0 / magenta #e020e0 / lime #6cff3a; act 3 warm photo grade. Fonts: Lilita One (bubble words, 2px stroke), Archivo Black (tape labels, white with black stroke), tape teal #3fb8c0. Look `{glow:.25,glow_thr:.72,rgb:.7,vignette:.2,grain:.02,grade:"anime"}`.
- Assets: 15+ photos (selfie-style close crops punch best), media-player window = HTML (grey bevel + title + controls), glyph props = SVG "!" "?" in the bubble font. Cutouts 0.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [glyphBurst, pillType]` - ink dots burst (12 dots, random velocity), "!" drops with bounce; bubble words pop per letter with a glyph tumbling out of a letter; colour dot cycles fill every 3 frames beside the word (beat marker).
  - `build: [pillStack]` - pill outline draws (border via clip/SVG dash .15s) while letters type 2f/char inside; "you"-style emphasis word scales 1.4 + fill invert; pills morph width, sprout "!!", stack and scale/rotate as a group, slide off with dirblur.
  - `brk: [mediaWindow]` - photo slides in rotated 15deg into the media-player window tilted 5deg; teal tape labels slide in per line; window holds, slow push. The window settling = break.
  - `drop: [tapePunch]` - window flies off, zoom to face (`AE.face` punch), outlined hero words rotate across the face, tape boxes per syllable, 2x2 tile-duplicate for 3 frames, eye zoom, stacked stretched words (scaleY 2.5) under a rotating photo card.
  - `drop2: [clipGlitch]` - full-bleed photo/clips with the 5-glitch rotation, ONE per kick cluster: mosaic (downsample 12px, 2f), mirror edge + b/w 3f, rgb split 8px + echo ghosts, vertical slit strips +-30px, liquify wave warp 3f - then rest. Never two glitches on the same kick.
  - `outro: [pillOut]` - black cut, tiny pill types the last hook, second pill pops below, both rotate 20deg and zoom off left; hard end on white (fade optional - source hard-cuts, keep a .3s fade for 58s).
- Seams/post: `seams:["cut","whip","zoom","cut"]`. Post: glitches are post events - mosaic/liquify need fxpost support; approximate mosaic with a CSS pixelated snapshot div, liquify with `AE.fx("wave",t,...)`, rgb via `AE.fx("rgb",t,{amt:8})`, slit via `AE.trans(...,"slit")`.
- Helpers: `AE.pop, AE.blocks` (customised), `AE.face`, `AE.fx`; local pill component (measured width tween) + glyph props.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: bubble words in pills are the lyric - one fragment (1-3 words) per pill, letters land per syllable. The pill DRAWING starts a beat early so the first letter lands on the vocal.
- Emphasis: the filled/inverted word inside a pill is the stressed sung word only. Colour dot is a beat marker, never text.
- Tape labels: on photos, tape lines carry the sung fragment in Archivo caps, one line per syllable group, tilted with the photo. They must sit on cheek/forehead/hair areas found by `faces.js` offsets - never across eyes (except the one deliberate glasses-crossing hero, once).
- UI labels: window title/controls are CFG decor. Decorative text safe zones: white margins everywhere, pill tails, photo card white borders. Unsafe: glyph props must stay glyphs (no letters), and the clip-glitch act is text-free except tape labels on the FIRST kick of each cluster.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Engine: `AE.film(tl,{roles:{intro:[scDeskTitle],build:[scLightningGrid,scFieldChrome,scScriptCards],brk:[scHeartDoubt],drop:[scWhiteWorld,scSakuraStack],drop2:[scRingStage,scFilmStrips],outro:[scCursiveFinale]},seams:["whip","zoom","spin","flash","glitch"],look:{glow:.65,grain:.18},cam:{hand:5,velo:.75},bg:"#000"})`; stage 768x576. Verified vs contact sheet: desk title, lightning couple, white world, yellow-ring stage, film strips, cursive finale all present.

Wide chrome Montserrat/Anton extruded (`AE.word3d`), Bebas condensed, Mr Dafoe/Allura script finale, spaced small caps for credit strips, serif italic accents.
- intro: `scDeskTitle(c)` white word slides from right, magenta glossy word follows (`AE.word3d` pal magenta), camera pulls out, 4 thumbnail cards pop at corners (`AE.stack` tilt 9).
- build: `scLightningGrid(c)` couple plate on grid floor, lightning SVG zigzags draw .2s, condensed stack bottom-right; `scFieldChrome(c)` low dolly, 3D words rise from ground plane (rotateX 70deg layer), DOF foreground blur; `scScriptCards(c)` handwritten word `AE.writeOn`/mask-reveal over tilted cards, light rays (`AE.rays`).
- brk: `scHeartDoubt(c)` red torn-heart mask frames the cutout, glowing red word rises, chrome word tumbles out, black-floor chrome stack settles with scribble circles above; hold still .5s into the gap.
- drop: `scWhiteWorld(c)` invert the palette: black extruded words fly past on white with checker flags + ground shadows, one per .8s, zoom-blur whips; `scSakuraStack(c)` parallax plates, two phrases stack/overlap (`AE.blocks`).
- drop2: `scRingStage(c)` yellow ring HUD arc draws .3s around the slam word (SVG dashoffset + glow), camera pans between two characters as 3 short words pop around the ring; gold shard burst; `scFilmStrips(c)` iris from black, film-strip frames rotate/dutch, stacked words cross the strips. Outro: `scCursiveFinale(c)` black, white script writes on with red echo layer behind, wave ribbon, flare + dust, slow L->R drift, fade.
- Helpers/post/assets: reuse `AE.word3d/lyric3d`, `AE.blocks`, `AE.stack`, `AE.rays`, `AE.writeOn`, `AE.maskReveal`, `AE.scramble` (credit strips), `AE.impact`; post events: radial/dir blur 3-6f on EVERY seam, flash-white at chapter changes only, rgb split only on the scramble/neon build words, shatter burst once in build. Assets: 8 photo plates, 3 cutouts, desk + grid + white-world CSS sets, lightning/ring SVGs, film-strip frame, dust sprites.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: one extruded word per vocal hit (`c.lyricWords()/lyricTimes()` into `AE.lyric3d` stops or `AE.words` slam); two-word stacks only in build/drop chapter middles. Script finale words write at phrase speed, not per kick.
- UI labels: the two bottom credit strips are the only non-lyric text; render with `AE.scramble`, keep at bottom 6%, and only during build - remove before drop so the ring stage is clean.
- Stickers/decorative: scribble circles, checker flags, thumbnail cards and serif-italic side words are decorative; safe at frame edges and on plates, never centre. Ghost/echo script (red layer) must duplicate the current hero word only.

## What makes it look premium
- Inverse colour logic: apps provide all colour, photography stays B&W — bubbles and pins glow against the grey class photo.
- The 2.5 s metronome loop is hypnotic and obviously intentional; verbatim repetition reads as design, not laziness, because lyric data advances each pass.
- B&W hallway video coda breaks the UI world with real motion at the exact moment the loop would tire (21.6), then snaps back for a loopable fade.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: extend `osdream` (album skin) + new `karaokeGrey`, `pinboardPop` scenes; photography stays B&W in CSS. Ref's power is the exact 2.5s metronome — at 58s keep sub-scene duration locked to `4 × beat` of the chosen song (compute from beats.js, don't hardcode 2.5s): structure = album intro, then [karaoke→pinboard→bubbles] ×2 (drop/drop2), IG post as bridge, B&W video coda outro. If no B&W clip available, coda = slow B&W photo push with handheld. Seams: hard rhythm — use `"flash"` low amt or `"none"`+`AE.fx("rgb",K,{amt:5})` so cuts stay metronomic; engine velo cam OFF for karaoke/pinboard (set cam velo only on bubble scenes).
- `intro: [albumPage]` — Spotify dark #121212, collage album art, title types per-letter, green controls row, 5 track rows reveal stagger 0.25, page micro-push.
- `build: [karaokeGrey, pinboardPop]` — karaokeGrey: flat grey #8a8a8a, 3 stacked copies of current line (white 1 / ghost .35 offset -30px / giant blurred ghost scale 2.2), words type on, stack drifts left -40px/s, mini player bar fixed bottom. pinboardPop: red pin logo #e60023 scales 300%→12% corner, black board, tilted photo pins pop stagger 0.12, search pills + bottom nav fade last.
- `brk: [igPost]` — dark IG post of hero photo, caption types; the one-off bridge — place it at brk so the loop "breathes".
- `drop: [photoBubbles, karaokeGrey, pinboardPop]` — photoBubbles (core): B&W hero photo full-bleed push 100→106%, blue bubbles #2f7df6 pop onto subjects in reading order scale .5→1 back.out ~0.55s apart.
- `drop2: [photoBubbles, karaokeGrey, pinboardPop]` — same fns, lyric/bubble words advance, new hero photo.
- `outro: [bwCoda]` — B&W hallway clip (or photo + `AE.handheld`) 3-4s, then 2 frames of bubble photo reprise, fade black mid-bubble.
- Palette: Spotify #121212/#1ed760, karaoke grey #8a8a8a, Pinterest black/#e60023, bubble blue #2f7df6, all photos B&W. Fonts: Inter (Spotify/IG), Poppins Bold (karaoke). `AE.base({glow:.1,rgb:.5,vignette:.25,grain:.03})`.
- Post FX events: minimal — `rgb` ticks on sub-scene cuts, `glow` tiny on bubble pops; the metronome is the effect. Engine drop hit only at first photoBubbles entry.
- Assets: group/class photos strongly preferred (bubbles pin to *people*), 15+ B&W-convertible photos, album art = 4-photo collage made in-scene, optional B&W clip for coda.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: karaoke line is hero — current sung line types word-by-word; ghost layers are the *same* line (echo, not different text). Bubbles: 1-2 sung words per bubble, placed near people, in vocal order. Album title/track rows = real song/album titles (labels). IG caption = fragment typed per char.
- UI labels: play counts, search pills ("For you / All / Short video" — platform labels, safe), nav icons, mini player time. Pinterest pins carry no text.
- Stickers/decorative: pin logo only. No decorative words anywhere — the grey stage makes any text read as karaoke lyric.
- Loop discipline: when cycle repeats, only lyric data advances; identical timing is mandatory. If fragments run out, bubbles stop and photo holds — don't recycle earlier words as if new (karaoke ghosts already provide repetition).

## Song
"Ribuan Memori" — Lomba Sihir (per Spotify album scene in-video; caption "ribuan memori - ib: azcarter"). ~97 BPM; sub-scene cuts on a strict 2.50 s grid (≈4 beats), bubble/row pops on the 0.62 s beat. Lyric fragments shown 1–2 words per bubble/layer; do not reproduce beyond per-moment fragments.

## What makes it look premium
- The 3D scene is photoreal with prismatic flares + rack focus — each move starts out of focus and lands sharp.
- Each chapter has its own palette and layout idiom (flat-lay, 3D, bubble, UI page, showreel), connected by cameras that travel THROUGH things (leaves, screen, iris).
- Every text line has a distinct gesture (script write-on, inflated letters, scramble, typed with cursor, counter), but all land on beats.

## Song
"original sound – Qiyowative // Motion Designer" (portfolio, tag "NO AI WAS USED"). rea: 178 BPM F major (felt ~89), 32% of cuts on the beat; SFX hits: click 6.9 s, whoosh 15.6 s ("That"), pop 19.7 s, click 21.1 s ("STANDS OUT"). No lyrics; type text is the designer's own copy.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920, chapter palettes: cobalt #1f5de8 + lime, pastel bubble (sky/peach/pink), white + orange #f08a24, purple #9b2cf0, mustard sidebar #f5c04a, charcoal outro. Fonts: Inter (UI lines), Space Grotesk 700 (purple chapter), Syne 800 (inflated-word fallback), Mrs Saint Delafield (script accents). Look `{glow:.4,glow_thr:.65,rgb:.6,vignette:.2,grain:.02,grade:"anime"}`.
- Assets: 30+ photos, 2 cutouts, 4-5 app-icon stickers (draw as rounded-square divs with 2-letter monograms - do NOT ship real app logos), leaf/bokeh foreground PNG, paper-plane + cursor SVGs. No 3D renders: the "desk" is 6-8 depth-sorted photo layers.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [flatlay]` - blue desk flatlay behind blurred leaf foreground; rack focus in (`AE.defocusIn` 1.2s), script + bold title pops, icon stickers `AE.pop` on beats.
  - `build: [deskParallax, bubbleWord]` - deskParallax: layered scene, `AE.parallax` k .4-2.4 + whip between two framings; bubbleWord: inflated hero word via `AE.word3d` with gradient face, letters squash-stretch per letter (scaleY 1.4->.9->1, stagger .06) over a pastel sky.
  - `brk: [scramblePage]` - white page: `AE.scramble` resolves a question line, rainbow conic ring pulses x3 behind it (CSS), word swaps on card-slide seams at .35s hits. Slow down the last swap - this is the break.
  - `drop: [purplePage, reelSidebar]` - purplePage: tag + marquee strip (300px/s) + thumbnail collage + counter 24->100 rolling (.1s ticks, easeOut) - build the page by stacking blocks per kick. reelSidebar: FIXED mustard sidebar (script title + bullet list) while the right 65% swaps a photo every kick (hard cuts, `AE.face` push alternating).
  - `drop2: [cursorLine, reelSidebar]` - cursorLine: b/w portrait + cursor types a line, final words become violet outline with 2px jitter; then reelSidebar again with new photos and a star-blob morph (scale/rotate a 4-point star div into the logo mark).
  - `outro: [logoType]` - charcoal/grey smoke gradient, logo mark left, name types per char (typewriter), tagline fades, brighten to white over the last 1.2s.
- Seams/post: `seams:["blur","whip","zoom","iris","cut"]`; iris = clip-path circle at chapter changes. Post: zoomblur on through-screen/leaf whips, pixel-mosaic once (`AE.fx("glitch")` is NOT mosaic - do the mosaic as a CSS canvas snapshot or skip to spinblur), prismatic streak = `AE.rays` with rainbow gradient at low opacity on parallax scenes.
- Helpers: `AE.scramble, AE.word3d, AE.parallax, AE.defocusIn/focus, AE.pop, AE.sparkles, AE.rays`, local counter + marquee.

## Lyric/text system
- There are no sung lyrics in the source - ALL text is CFG copy (title, tagline, skill lines). For a song version: hero words = the drop's sung word via `AE.word3d`/slam, ONE per scene, timed to `c.lyricTimes()`; chapter copy stays decorative.
- UI labels: sidebar bullets, counter label, marquee and page headers are set dressing - they must be written from CFG (role/skill words), never from the lyric, and kept small/edge-anchored so a hero word never competes with them.
- Stickers: icon stickers and the plane/cursor are punctuation; they may carry 1-2 letter monograms only, no words.
- Decorative text safe zones: marquee strip (repeating CFG title), sidebar list, thumbnail captions. Unsafe: the counter number must stay a number (do not swap in a lyric word), and the scramble page may only scramble CFG copy - scrambling a lyric word reads as a glitch error, not design. If the song has vocals, keep vocals to hero slots in drop/drop2 and let intro/build stay copy-driven.

- Palette per set: rust red #a03c31 portrait wall; halftone grey #cfcfcf; ID-card beige #e8dcc0; desk wood; dusty pink #d9a7a0 with lip cutouts; saturated locker red #c0161c. Ink black, navy #232a6b, red #d33 type.
- Grade: radial spotlight (bright centre, dark vignette edges) on most sets; halftone dot texture on greys; light grain.
- Persistent chrome: top-left red/black masthead badge, top-right 4 colour chips, tiny credit line bottom, thin red baseline — present in nearly every set.
- Fonts: Anton/Bebas Neue condensed black for stacks, italic serif for one red word, script signature bottom-right on the selfie set.

## Techniques
- tag: new.masthead_chrome — fixed top bar: badge left, 4 calibration chips right, credit line bottom; sits above every set so 6 different backgrounds read as one magazine. build: one absolutely-positioned HTML layer reused per scene, z-top, never animated except a 2 px beat pulse.
- tag: new.face_slices — face photo duplicated into 3 horizontal strips (eyes / nose / mouth) via clip-path inset; strips offset x ±10–30 px and re-align on beats while type stacks around. build: 3 divs same bg-image, background-position per strip, GSAP x tweens.
- tag: ph.halftone — grey sets use radial-dot background (CSS radial-gradient, size 6 px) + dotted-outline display word. build: background layer + -webkit-text-stroke word.
- tag: ph.frame_card (ID/desk) — beige ID card with portrait window, ruled fields and round stamp; desk set is a real flat-lay photo with added polaroids. build: card div with grid fields; stamp = rotated bordered circle text.
- tag: type.stack_blocks / type.word_slam — condensed words land one per beat scale 1.35→1, 0.18 s power4.out, alternating black/red/navy and left/right placement around the subject. build: GSAP from scale/y, keep a layout map per set.
- tag: ov.sticker (lips/logo) — lip cutouts tile the pink set (absolute, random rotate, slight float y ±6 px loop); graffiti oval is an SVG scribble draw-on. build: repeated img/SVG, dash draw.
- tag: fx.rgb_split / trans.slit_bars — 3-frame RGB channel offset on slams; 2-frame vertical black slit bars as a mid-set glitch. build: post pass channel shift; bars = black divs scaleY flash.

## What makes it look premium
- The masthead/chips/credit system turns stock-y photos into a designed editorial series.
- Each set invents a new layout for the same type behaviour (slam + stack), so it never feels like one template looped.
- Spotlight vignette + halftone + slices give print texture that flat AMV slides lack.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: 16:9 ref → 9:16: masthead chrome becomes top bar (badge left, 4 chips right) full width; each "set" restages vertically (portrait card top, type stack bottom). Extend `editorial` template (it already has Swiss cover + filmstrip) with these scene fns rather than a new template. Seams: mostly engine `"zoom"/"whip"`; the ref's bare hard cuts become `AE.trans(...,"flash")` with low amt or seam `"none"`+`AE.fx("rgb",K,{amt:6})` — per amvkit rule, hard changes land on kicks with a 1-3f FX mask.
- `intro: [rustWall, halftoneType]` — rustWall: rust bg #a03c31, graffiti oval SVG draw (`AE.writeOn`), portrait `P(0)` bottom, hero word slam right with `AE.fx("rgb",K)`. halftoneType: halftone dot bg (radial-gradient 6px), typewriter word centre, outlined word slides behind subject (`type.behind_subject`: photo z above word).
- `build: [spotCollage, faceSlices, idCard]` — spotCollage: 3 mini cards `AE.stack` top, italic red word types, condensed stack `AE.blocks` beside portrait. faceSlices (signature): same photo in 3 clip-path strips offset ±15px, words slam around on kicks (`AE.words` around the slices). idCard: beige ID card (portrait window + ruled fields + round stamp), slow push; fields = neutral labels only (see below).
- `brk: [deskFlatlay]` — desk photo pan 12%, two-line condensed phrase slams; longest hold in the piece, let it sit at brk.
- `drop: [faceSlices, lipWall, lockerPop]` — lipWall: pink #d9a7a0 + lip sticker tiles floating (`AE.sparkles`-style spawn but lip emoji/PNG, yoyo drift), outline words pulse. lockerPop: red locker bg #c0161c, cutout `C(0)` white outline (`AE.stickerCSS`) centre, words build L/R with echo ghost (`AE.echo`).
- `drop2: [halftoneType, faceSlices, lockerPop]` — same fns, `photoStep` rotates photos, accent order rotates black→red→navy.
- `outro: [logoBlack]` — black, graffiti oval redraws (`AE.writeOn`), flips once, tiny credits (title/artist), fade.
- Palette: rust #a03c31, halftone #cfcfcf, ID beige #e8dcc0, pink #d9a7a0, locker #c0161c, navy #232a6b, red #d33, ink #111. Fonts: Anton (stacks), Playfair Italic (the one red word), Inter (masthead/credits). `AE.base({glow:.12,rgb:.8,vignette:.4,grain:.02})` + spotlight vignette per set.
- Post FX events: `rgb` on every slam (amt 6-10, 0.2s), `glitch` 3f mid-faceSlices, `dirblur` into deskFlatlay, engine drop hits.
- Assets: 15+ photos, 2 cutouts (locker + halftone-behind-subject), lip sticker PNGs (or repeated emoji), desk flat-lay can be a photo bg.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the condensed stacks and slams are syllable-synced vocal words — feed from `CFG.lyrics`, one word per kick via `AE.words` times = `ctx.lyricTimes()`. The big off-white slam in intro = first hook word. Never stack invented words: a 5-word stack = 5 consecutive sung words.
- UI labels: masthead ("FOR THE CULTURE"-style badge → replace with artist/song label), colour chips, bottom credit line, ID-card fields (NAME / CLASS / NO — form labels, static). These are set dressing and safe at any size *except* they must not look like a lyric line — keep them ≤ caption size, uppercase micro-type.
- Stickers/decorative: graffiti logo (wordless oval scribble — do not put a word in it), lip tiles, stamps. The script signature bottom-right = artist name only.
- Unsafe zone: the pink outlined words on lipWall and the word behind subject read as lyric — they must be sung words too. Decorative-only text lives in the masthead/ID fields.

## Song
Original sound (Raf The Creator), English rap vocal; words slam per syllable/beat (described, not transcribed). ~122 BPM; most cuts and slams land on the 0.49 s grid, ID/desk sets hold 2 beats for contrast.

# q09 — Swiss-poster "bento/UI-card" typography preset, 2 palette loops (blue -> terracotta)  (21.0s, 720x900, 30fps, 92 BPM, 11 shots, ~0.5 cuts/s)
## Look
- White paper bg, flat single-hue brand colour: periwinkle blue (#668CCB-ish) loop 1, terracotta/brick (#B86B5D-ish + dark brown #5A3328) loop 2. Same layout, colours swapped = "preset recolor".
- Type: Neue Haas/Helvetica Bold tight-tracked (closest Inter Tight / Archivo bold, -4% tracking) for "Breathe" and "GO / FREE / YOUR VIBE / STOP"; italic serif (Playfair/Instrument Serif) for "Gorgeous * Women", "He can bawall"; tiny sans captions and pill tags.
- Flat vector arrows, asterisk-burst glyph, selection-box handles (corner squares) around "FREE" like a design-tool selection. No grain.
- Photos: one cutout (hijab girl, scissored with white sticker edge) on coloured rounded rect; one full-bleed colour photo; one selfie video in a story card.

## Techniques
- tag: new.preset_recolor
  what: whole composition re-themed by swapping 2 CSS vars (accent + deep tone); cutouts unchanged
  build: HyperFrames :root{--accent;--deep}; run same timeline twice.
- tag: trans.shape_iris
  what: coloured circle scales 0->1.4 with a thin white inner stroke ring and 2 diagonal hairlines (X) that spread; fills the screen = scene change; mirror on reveal
  build: SVG circle r tween 12f power3.out + two line elements scale; clip-path circle() on next scene.
- tag: type.mask_reveal
  what: each headline word revealed by a solid coloured block wiping across (block covers, then retracts) ~6f; words are replaced in place (What's that -> Supposed -> to be)
  build: span overflow hidden + inner translateX; block div scaleX 0->1->0 with transform-origin swap.
- tag: type.stack_blocks
  what: GO / FREE[box] / YOUR / VIBE stacked flush-left, each word lands one beat apart (~0.5s) with 20px y slide + 6f fade; arrows rotate cycle
  build: GSAP stagger .5, arrow glyph rotation steps 0/45/90... ease "steps(8)".
- tag: ph.cutout_sticker / ph.frame_card
  what: girl cutout over rounded colour rectangle, head overlapping top edge (pop-out); photo scenes in an app-like rounded card with close X, dots, name badge
  build: PNG cutout absolutely positioned above a div border-radius 14px.
- tag: ui.chat / ui.music_player
  what: Spotify-lyrics share card (album art, 2 lyric lines in dark chips, Spotify mark) hovering over triple "Breathe" with soft drop shadow (blur 20, y 8)
  build: HTML card + box-shadow; "Breathe" x3 with gradient fade on top/bottom copies.
- tag: type.typewriter
  what: caption "reminiscing all the good times daily" appears word by word (~0.15s/word) with last word fading in; progress bar under it
- tag: cam.push
  what: slow 105->112% scale across 1.5-3s on full-bleed photo; story video card scales .6->1 on entry
- tag: ov.sticker (selection box)
  what: 1px outline with 4 corner squares around "FREE" (design-tool selection), placed after word lands
## What makes it look premium
Strict 2-colour system + hairlines, micro-type captions as texture, pill tags/ tiny UI details, structure of overlapped cutout + rounded rect, mask-reveal word swaps on beat instead of fades, loop recolor shows system thinking.
## Song
"suara asli - hecanbawal" (original sound; sung breathe lyrics "try and pull that..."). 92 BPM; cuts mostly at ~0.5s multiples (every 15 frames) and a scene change roughly every 5.5 s.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Engine: `AE.film(tl,{roles:{intro:[scPosterA],build:[scPhotoCard,scStackWords,scColourBlock],brk:[scStoryCard],drop:[scLyricCard,scPosterA2,scStackWords2],drop2:[scColourBlock2,scLyricCard2],outro:[scIrisOut]},seams:["iris"],seamAt:()=>"iris",look:{glow:.25,grain:0},cam:{hand:2,velo:.4},bg:"#fff"})`; stage 720x900. Verified vs contact sheet: blue pass then terracotta pass of the identical sequence, iris in/out, triple-word lyric card all present.
- The loop is code, not editing: define CSS vars `--accent/--deep` on the stage; pass 1 blue #668CCB, pass 2 terracotta #B86B5D + deep #5A3328. Same scene functions run twice; only `c.P(j)` photos and lyric data advance. Fonts: Inter Tight/Archivo Bold -4% tracking; Playfair/Instrument Serif italic accents; Inter for pills/captions.
- intro: `scPosterA(c)` colour iris shrink-reveal (ring + hairline X), cutout rises on rounded accent rect (head overlaps top edge), serif tag, headline slides in, pill tags fade under.
- build: `scPhotoCard(c)` full-bleed photo slow push 105->112%, app card pops (close X, serif line, dots), accent headline + arrow bottom-left, name badge lower-right; `scStackWords(c)` white stage, stacked words land one beat apart (20px y + 6f fade), one word gets selection handles (1px outline + corner squares), arrow glyph cycles 8 directions steps(8); `scColourBlock(c)` accent block rises from bottom with giant cropped headline, cutout slides from right, slow push.
- brk: `scStoryCard(c)` portrait card scales .6->1 (8f) centre-white, caption types word-by-word (.15s/word) with progress bar under; quietest scene, no iris inside.
- drop: `scLyricCard(c)` accent rect grows from a thin vertical line (scaleX 0->1, 8f) into a share card with 2 lyric lines in dark chips; behind it the same word x3 stacked (top/bottom faded, y offset); then `scPosterA2/scStackWords2` rerun with `--accent` swapped at D1 (hard swap on the iris, not a fade).
- drop2: `scColourBlock2/scLyricCard2` in terracotta with new photos; keep every duration identical to pass 1 (+/-0.1s) - the verbatim repeat is the preset's selling point. Outro: `scIrisOut(c)` ring+X iris wipes to flat accent, hold 1s (loop point).
- Helpers/post/assets: reuse `AE.maskReveal` (block wipe per word), `AE.blocks`, `AE.pop` (badges/handles), `AE.trans` iris, `AE.sweep` once on the lyric card; post events: none beyond iris - no grain, no blur, no rgb; premium here is flatness. Assets: 2 cutouts (white sticker edge), 3 photos, 1 portrait video-card photo, arrow/asterisk SVGs, share-card DOM.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the stacked poster words and the giant cropped block headline; one word per beat from `c.lyricTimes()`, revealed by block mask-wipe (`AE.maskReveal`, 6f) in place - words replace each other inside the same poster, so keep a max of 4 hero words visible.
- UI labels: serif italic tags, pill tags, badge names and card captions are fixed editorial dressing (set in code, not synced); the story-card caption and share-card lines are the only typed lyric surfaces, word-by-word from `c.lyricWords()`.
- Stickers/decorative: the triple-stacked word behind the lyric card must repeat the card's current word; arrows, asterisks, hairlines and selection handles are wordless and safe everywhere. No decorative words in drop2 - pass 2 must read as the same poster re-coloured, not new text.

## Techniques
- tag: type.3d_space
  what: every lyric word is placed IN the scene — on a shirt, in a speech bubble, on a floor, as a sign, as voxel letters on
  grass. Text receives scene perspective and is occluded by subjects.
  build: HTML: per-word div in a CSS 3D layer (`transform: perspective(900px) rotateX(55deg)` for floor text), GSAP
  `fromTo({scale:0},{scale:1,ease:"back.out(2)",duration:.12})` on each word's timestamp; foreground subject cutout layer
  above for occlusion (type.behind_subject).
- tag: type.typewriter / type.per_letter
  what: words reveal 1 letter per ~2 frames (at 30 fps), sometimes word-at-a-time; letter pops without easing.
  build: SplitText chars, `gsap.set(char,{opacity:1})` stagger 0.033 s; lowercase last letter visible mid-type ("NEVEr").
- tag: trans.slit_bars (new.biome_bars_match)
  what: 8–12 vertical opaque bars of the NEXT scene's dominant colour, random widths (2–15% W), slide/expand L→R over
  ~6–8 frames, revealing next scene behind them; subject position held constant across cuts (match cut). Repeated every
  beat 11.5–15.6 (8 times).
  build: SVG/DIV group of rects with random widths, GSAP scaleX 0→1 from left with stagger 0.01 then scaleX 1→0 from right,
  swap bg image at midpoint. Colour = sampled avg of incoming frame.
- tag: ui.chat (speech bubble) + new.bubble_pop
  what: pixel speech bubble scales in with overshoot (4 frames), text types word-by-word, bubble scales to 50% and pops out
  (2 frames). Pill bubbles per word ("YOU", "&", "ME") placed over each character.
  build: SVG bubble path; GSAP scale 0→1.1→1 back.out; text words added on lyric times; exit scale→0 power2.in 0.07 s.
- tag: ph.frame_card (polaroid) + new.card_unfold
  what: paper folds out of chest (2-panel 3D unfold, rotateY 90°→0 over ~8 frames), becomes polaroid with caption; inside
  is a desaturated rainy flashback with its own lyric words; then crumples.
  build: two halves with `transform-origin:left` rotateY 90→0; inner image `filter:grayscale(.6) brightness(.7)` + rain
  overlay; crumple = scale to 0.2 + rotate + clip-path blob.
- tag: new.trajectory_words
  what: thrown object with dashed arc trail; each lyric word spawns along the arc ("THROW IT IN THE TRASH").
  build: SVG path with stroke-dasharray drawn by GSAP MotionPath; words positioned at path progress points.
- tag: cam.pull (mega reveal)
  what: 2.7 s pull-back turning the walkway into a heart drawn in the sky (shape reveal), ending in a glow pulse.
  build: scale 4→1 on container, expo.inOut; heart outline SVG stroke-dashoffset draw synced to pull.
- tag: trans.shape_iris / trans.zoom_through (heart tunnel)
  what: concentric rainbow heart ribbons rush toward camera (~0.7 s) then open onto a top-down scene.
  build: 6–8 heart SVG outlines at staggered scales animated scale 0.2→6, different stroke colours; mask reveal next layer.
- tag: ph.strobe_montage (environment strobe)
  what: same composition, background re-skinned every 3–6 frames through 7 colourways; subjects locked.
  build: cutout subject constant; bg layer swaps images or hue-rotate steps (0/40/300/260/220/120°) on 1/16 notes.
- tag: type.3d_extrude
  what: chunky voxel letters with orange/yellow side faces ("FEEL LIKE SUN", "SO"), assemble from flying blocks.
  build: CSS layered text-shadow stack (10 × 1px offsets in darker tone) + per-char scale/blur-in; particle squares converge.
- tag: new.crane_floors
  what: continuous downward crane through a stacked cutaway building, a different room + lyric per floor (~0.8 s each).
  build: tall vertical strip of panels, GSAP y translate with steps on beats (power2.inOut 0.3 s) + hold.
- tag: new.letters_fall
  what: "FALLING" — letters detach and tumble down individually with rotation (≈1 s), on the word "falling".
  build: SplitText chars; GSAP y +400, rotation random ±90, stagger 0.06, ease power2.in.
- tag: ov.hearts / ov.sparkle / ov.music_notes
  what: rising red pixel hearts, falling petals, music notes, 4-point sparkles throughout.
  build: particle layer of sprites, y −200 over 1.5 s, fade, random x.
- tag: trans.crossblur (environment swap under continuous subject) — 9.6–10.8 night pier → snow.
- tag: trans.flash_black — 1.3 s fade to black at 36.2.
- tag: fx.glow_bloom — on lanterns, sun, neon text, heart outline.

## What makes it look premium
- Every word lives inside the world (perspective, occlusion, material) instead of a subtitle layer.
- Long continuous camera moves (pull-back to heart, crane through floors) hide cuts; the slit-bar run keeps subjects
  locked in frame so 8 cuts in 4 s read as one shot.
- Strict colour storytelling per section and repeated motifs (bubble "WHAT YOU SAY?" day vs night).
- Literal lyric staging (THROW → throw, FALLING → letters fall, ON MY SKIN → words grow from ground).

## Song
"this is what falling in love feels like" — JVKE (TikTok sound "原聲 - ICE"). Every lyric word is synced to its sung
syllable; letter-typing follows syllable length; the slit-bar run is on quarter notes (~0.5 s).

## Build recipe (58s)
- ADAPTATION ONLY (ref is rendered 3D, no photos): rebuild as CSS-3D photo diorama in 1080x1080. Palette per biome sampled from `P(j)`; base sunset `#F7A56B/#7A3B69`, neon pink `#FF4FA3`, plum outline `#3A1F46`. Fonts: Silkscreen (pixel caps), VT323 (thin room text).
- `roles:{intro:[bubbleWalk], build:[biomeBars], brk:[heartPull], drop:[floorCrane,lettersFall], drop2:[biomeBars,bubbleWalk], outro:[fadeBlack]}`; seams `["slit","zoom","blur"]` — most joins are camera moves, not seams.
- intro `bubbleWalk(c)`: layered photo scene (bg/mid/subject cutouts `C(j)`), speech bubble `AE.pop` back.out, words added at vocal times inside bubble; pill words over heads + hearts `AE.sparkles`.
- build `biomeBars(c)`: subjects locked centre, 8–12 vertical bars of next scene colour sweep L→R (`AE.trans slit`), bg swaps at midpoint; word types per letter (`AMV.chars` stagger 0.033).
- brk `heartPull(c)`: scale 4→1 pull-back, heart outline SVG stroke draws with pull, glow pulse on landing kick.
- drop `floorCrane(c)`: tall strip of 5 room panels, y-step per beat, floor words `rotateX(55deg)`; `lettersFall(c)`: hero word chars y+400 rotation ±90 stagger 0.06 on its kick.
- outro: hearts rise, `flash` to black 1.3s.
- Helpers: AE.lyric3d/word3d for sign words, AE.parallax, AE.pop, AE.sparkles, AE.writeOn (heart), AE.strobe for biome re-skin run.
- Post FX: `glow` on neon/lanterns, `zoomblur` on heart tunnel, no grain; DOF via blur on far layers.
- Assets: 6–8 scenic photos + 2 subject cutouts reused throughout, heart/bubble SVGs, pixel heart/note sprites, 7 colourway bg variants (can be hue-rotated duplicates).

## Lyric/text system
- Every text element is diegetic and vocal-synced: bubble text types word-by-word as sung; pill words pop over heads on their syllable.
- Placement types rotate: bubble → pills → shirt print → polaroid interior → trajectory words → floor text → 3D sign → falling letters. Same phrase may repeat in a new placement (day/night reprise).
- Per-letter typing follows syllable length (fast words type faster); keep pixel font at all sizes for unity.
- UI labels: only creator watermark + polaroid caption — static, faint.
- Decorative/safe: hearts/notes/petals particles (no text). Unsafe: any non-diegetic subtitle bar — it would break the world; if lyrics unknown, use bubble placeholders with CFG.words.

- Engine: `AE.film(tl,{roles:{intro:[scEmojiIntro,scNotesHook],build:[scNotesPan,scDmBadges,scPostCaption],brk:[scSlamCard],drop:[scArtistCard,scChatTilt],drop2:[scPolaroidSwirl,scNotesReturn],outro:[scDmFade]},seams:["iris","zoom","whip","blur","flash"],seamAt:(c,p)=>c.role==="brk"?"flash":"zoom",look:{glow:.55,grain:0},cam:{hand:5,velo:.5},bg:"#fff"})`; stage 960x720 (scale x1.125 for 1080x810). Verified vs contact sheet: emoji/Notes/DM/artist-card/chat/polaroid sequence and the verbatim Notes return are all present.
- Palette/fonts: white #FFFFFF, emoji gold #F2B533, red #D63A2F, IG dark #1C1A1A/#262424, cream #E8E4D6, olive #6E8A4E, accent red #C8282D, lime #D8F0A0, periwinkle #7B83F0, pink #D4A0A8/tan #C9A27E. UI Inter; slams Anton/Oswald 700; italic display Archivo Black; body Poppins ExtraBold; intro bubble Rubik Bubbles/Chewy.
- intro: `scEmojiIntro(c)` per-letter bubble title (stagger .066, back.out) -> emoji rises in front (`type.behind_subject`) -> letters tint #D63A2F and tumble out; `scNotesHook(c)` gold radial vignette, emoji swap behind motion, `AE.trans(...,"iris")` shrink frame into the avatar circle, clock-wipe inside it, first note types.
- build: `scNotesPan(c)` one wide IG-Notes world div, camera pans avatar-to-avatar (8f ease-in-out) then pulls to full tray; `scDmBadges(c)` push+`AE.focus` into inbox, five glowing count badges pop on kicks; `scPostCaption(c)` post-footer UI, slow pan+3deg roll, caption types.
- brk: `scSlamCard(c)` letterbox band, `AE.blocks` 3 stacked words each with random 3D tilt slam; 2-frame invert flash on the last two kicks (`AE.impact` frames:2) then a small scale-pulse line. Freeze last .4s.
- drop: `scArtistCard(c)` pull from extreme crop with dutch to -8deg, red speech panel `card_slide` in from right, outline display text behind subject (`-webkit-text-stroke`), lime label grows; `scChatTilt(c)` iMessage plane rotateX 25deg/rotateZ -8deg, bubbles send with overshoot, brief blur on send.
- drop2: `scPolaroidSwirl(c)` iris-grow from tiny polaroid, stretch-in words (scaleX .3/scaleY 2 -> 1 in 3f), conic swirl bg rotating 30deg/s with per-beat hue step, second polaroid swings foreground (`AE.stack`/`AE.fan`), pale star behind; then `scNotesReturn(c)` rack-focus Notes loop with scramble text swaps + 4f glitch-block avatar swap. Outro: `scDmFade(c)` DM + badges reprise at 70% scale, pull, fade to black on last beat.
- Helpers/post/assets: reuse `AE.trans` iris/blur/glitch, `AE.blocks`, `AE.stack`, `AE.fan`, `AE.focus/defocusIn`, `AE.scramble`, `AE.sparkles`, `AE.impact`; post events: invert 2f only in brk, zoom-blur 2-3f at badge hit, exposure wash out of drop2, grain 0. Assets: 3 avatar images, 2 subject photos + 1 cutout, 3 emoji PNGs, 2 black polaroid cards, DOM for Notes/DM/post/iMessage, corner-credit + waveform chrome.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: only the brk slam stack and the drop2 stretch-in words; one word per kick via `AE.words(tl,el,c.lyricWords(3),c.lyricTimes(3),{style:"slam"})`, held to the next kick, never more than 3 words on screen.
- UI labels: all other sung text lives inside UI and types at vocal speed: Notes bubbles and captions `AMV.type` per char (~.033s), DM rows, iMessage bubbles pop per phrase. Handle names, counts, search/credit labels are fixed template text, set once, never timed.
- Stickers/decorative: outline display text behind the subject, corner credits, waveform strip and the "?" polaroids are decorative; safe only behind/around the subject or on white rests. Never put decorative words centre-frame during drop/drop2 - the eye reads any big word as the lyric.

# k10 — AE "event rules" looping bumper: batik folding-fan iris → ornamental stage with icon + arc-flown text cards (seamless loop)
STYLE-KEY: batik-fan-loop-bumper
CLOSEST-EXISTING: vintage (ornamental/warm) — no real match; nearest motion grammar is keynote (icon + title cards)
NOVELTY: a pure keyflow motion-design loop made in After Effects: a ring of folding fans spins/closes into a single batik fan disc that rotates and opens wings (ornament sprouts), then the stage holds a symmetrical ornament set while 7 rule cards cycle — each icon pops scale-up, and the headline letters fly in individually along a curved arc path (rotating as they travel) like a ribbon; the end mirrors the start exactly so it loops.

(37.8 s, 1440x720 2:1, 30 fps, no beat (ambient gamelan-ish bed), 7 cards × ~4.3 s, ~0.3 changes/s, zero hard cuts)

## Look
- Palette: cream/peach paper #F3DCC4 → #E9C9A8 with soft diagonal light streaks; deep brown #4A2E20 (icons, headlines, ornaments); rust #B4532A (italic sub-line); batik fan: rust/brown floral print + white/grey ribbed fan paper.
- Ornaments: brown filigree flowers left/right (symmetrical), centre diamond (Mataram/kawung-like), faded mandala lace behind text, ghost feather leaves in corners (low opacity, slow drift).
- Type: headline = humanist sans semibold caps (closest "Josefin Sans Bold"/"Cabin Condensed Bold"), sub = italic serif (closest "Crimson Pro Italic"/"Lora Italic") rust. Icons = flat brown pictograms (phone mute, shh face, seated person, no-flash, no-sleep, performer, cheering person).

## Timeline
0.00–0.40 | ring of fans (kaleido, 6 fans radial) | spin CW fast, zoomed in | in from loop end | — | — | fx.motion_blur | —
0.40–0.80 | fans collapse | zoom-out + spin decelerates; fans fly inward and merge to one disc | — | — | — | — | —
0.80–1.50 | single batik fan disc | disc rotates −120° while a wedge "opens" (fan paper unfolds as a sector sweeping 0→180°) | — | — | — | — | —
1.50–2.20 | — | disc keeps slow rotation; batik wing/leaf ornaments grow out from 2 sides (scale 0→1 from disc edge, overshoot) | — | — | ornaments | — | —
2.20–3.60 | hold | disc slow rotate +5°, corner flowers bloom in (scale from 0, stagger) | — | — | — | — | —
3.60–4.30 | transition | camera pushes INTO the disc; fans multiply and swirl past lens (zoom-through) revealing ornament stage | trans.zoom_through | — | — | fx.motion_blur | —
4.30–4.60 | stage | filigree flowers slide in from L/R edges, diamond rises | — | — | — | — | —
4.60–5.40 | card 1 | — | — | icon scales 0→1.1→1 from centre-top; headline letters fly along an arc from left (each letter rotates to tangent, stagger ~2 f), sub italic types along a lower arc simultaneously; both straighten to a flat line | — | — | —
5.40–8.40 | hold | ghost leaves drift, lace breathes (scale 1→1.02) | — | — | — | — | —
8.40–8.90 | card out | icon fades/shrinks, text fades with slight blur | — | — | — | — | —
8.90–9.90 | card 2 | same build (icon pop + arc-flight letters) | — | — | — | — | —
… repeats for cards 3–7 at ~13.1, 17.4, 21.6, 25.8, 30.0 (each 4.2–4.3 s: 0.9 build, 2.8 hold, 0.5 exit) |
33.70–34.40 | → fans | fans fly in from edges swirling (reverse of 3.6 zoom-through) | — | — | — | fx.motion_blur | —
34.40–37.75 | single fan disc | ornaments retract, disc closes wedge, spins up, multiplies into fan ring — final frame == frame 0 (loop) | — | — | — | — | loop

## Techniques
- tag: new.fan_iris_unfold
  what: a circular fan disc where one sector "unfolds" (paper folds rotate open like a real folding fan) while the whole disc rotates; wings sprout from its edge with overshoot.
  build: N wedge slices (SVG paths, 12–16 folds) with `rotation` staggered from 0 to their final angle (`stagger:.03, ease:"power3.out"`), parent `rotation:-120 → 0, ease:"power2.inOut", 1.2`; wings `from(scale:0, transformOrigin: disc edge, ease:"back.out(1.6)")`.
- tag: new.arc_flight_text
  what: headline letters travel along a curved arc (like a thrown ribbon) from off-left into their slot, each letter rotating to the path tangent and then settling to 0°; sub-line follows a lower, flatter arc; ~0.8 s total, per-letter stagger 0.06 s, ease power3.out (decelerating landing, no overshoot).
  build: SplitText chars; MotionPathPlugin per char with a shared bezier offset to the char's final x (`autoRotate:true` then `to(rotation:0)` last 30%); or polar math: angle = lerp(-70°,0,p), radius R.
- tag: new.icon_pop
  what: pictogram scales 0→1.12→1 (back.out 2.0, 0.35 s) from its centre with 0.1 s lead before the text.
- tag: trans.zoom_through (fan swirl) both directions = seamless loop bookend.
- tag: new.ambient_breath
  what: background lace/leaves never stop: leaves drift 10 px/s, lace scale yoyo 1↔1.02 sine 4 s, light streaks pan slowly.
  build: `repeat:-1, yoyo:true, ease:"sine.inOut"`.

## What makes it look premium
- Everything decelerates into place (power3/expo out), nothing pops linearly; secondary motion (rotation, breathing) keeps holds alive.
- Cultural motif (batik fan) used as the transition device, not just decoration.
- Perfect loop: outro is the intro reversed so it can run endlessly on event screens.

## Song
Original sound — Dikbuul (AE bumper loop, "Do's and Don't" event opener); ambient bed, no lyric sync — timing is card-based (≈4.2 s per rule).

## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas 1920x1080 (ref 16:9; crop-safe for 9:16 centre). Palettes: A black/blue sparkle, B golden-hour warm, C white paper + red accent `#E23`. Fonts: Anton/Bebas (hero), Montserrat Light 11px-style subtitle, Impact-like gold for title.

- intro `posterCards(c)`: credits/player cards fly in rot/blur over white dust, centre card page-curl (rotateY + corner skew), typed 1 word.
- build `typeWorldA(c)`: black scene, new type treatment per phrase — `AE.scramble`, behind-subject mask (`C(j)` over hero), `AE.lyric3d` drift-to-camera, polaroid + halo ring; never repeat a treatment twice in a row.
- brk `paperSwitch(c)`: invert to white paper, rotating plate mask, one red hero word slam −8deg, ink-smoke `AE.fx wave` exit.
- drop `roomB(c)`: scenic photo `P(j)` letterboxed (2.35 bars), slow push/orbit, subtitle line bottom-centre only; alternate with `typeWorldA` each scene.
- drop2 `collageStrip(c)`: tilted polaroid parallax collage + strip words; `chromeTitle(c)`: `AE.word3d` chrome/gold spin-in rotateY 90→0.
- outro `endCard(c)`: gold title zoom-blur out, black thanks card glow fade.
- Helpers: AE.lyric3d/word3d, AE.scramble, AE.stack/fan, AE.focus (rack), AE.rays/sweep, AMV.extrude.
- Post FX: `flash+leak` at room entries, `zoomblur` on slams, `rgb` rainbow fringe on white flashes, dust/leaves particles in-scene, grain light.
- Assets: 4 scenic photos, 3 character cutouts, 4 polaroid photos, leaf/dust overlays, flare PNG.

## Lyric/text system
- Two lyric channels: (A) giant kinetic hero words in black/white-paper scenes, new treatment per phrase, each word on its beat; (B) tiny letterboxed subtitle (Montserrat Light, bottom-centre) during 3D/photo rooms — never both at once.
- Hero placement tricks: behind cutout, through eye-strip mask, on reflective floor (lyric3d), tumbling rotateY — placement is the variety, wording stays word-per-beat.
- Title/credit cards (intro) are UI text, typed slowly, not lyric-synced.
- Final chrome title is the song-title moment (outro), spun in once.
- Decorative/safe: dust/embers/leaves, poster credits. Unsafe: subtitle in type scenes or hero words in room scenes — the contrast between worlds is the design.

# a01 — Lyric-mograph AMV "every phrase a new world" (montori.aep, Silent Voice / "Circles")
STYLE-KEY: anime-lyric-mograph-worlds

- Fonts: grunge distressed serif gold caps "LET GO" (≈ Cinzel Black + noise mask); thin wide spaced serif lowercase "feeling" (Playfair Display Italic, letters scattered/rotated); hand-marker caps "FRIENDS?" ## Techniques
- tag: new.phrase_world
  what: every lyric phrase (1.5–3 s) is a self-contained designed scene with own palette, font, texture; the anime clip is one ingredient (often small, masked, behind type). Transitions between worlds: white flash / black 4–6f / blob wipe / zoom-through.
  build: scene array, each scene = bg layer + clip/photo layer + type layer + overlay layer; seams from a pool `["flash_white","black","blob","zoom","spin"]`.
- tag: type.behind_subject (gold grunge)
  what: huge distressed gold serif words sit behind the feet/legs; each word arrives with a 2f overexpose flash + amber bloom.
  build: subject cutout (rembg) on top layer, word div under it; mask-image noise texture on text; GSAP opacity 0→1 1f + filter brightness 3→1 over 4f.
- tag: fx.light_leak (prism orb)
  what: rainbow-prism light orb with radiating rays grows from centre and eats the frame to white (2 s ramp) — the intro "power on".
  build: radial-gradient + conic-gradient rays, blur 30px, mix-blend screen; GSAP scale 0.3→6, opacity up; end with flash.
- tag: ov.scribble (boiling doodles)
  what: hand-drawn line doodles (snake wiggle, arrows, circle around head) on top of clip, re-drawn every 2 frames (boil) at 20 fps.
  build: 3 SVG path variants per doodle swapped every 2f; stroke-dashoffset draw-on 0.3 s.
- tag: trans.slit_bars (paper strips) + type.per_letter marker
  what: vertical pastel paper strips cover frame; marker letters appear one by one with ±5° jitter boil.
  build: 8–10 div strips stagger scaleY 0→1 (0.03 s); letters stagger 0.08 s, rotation random each 2f.
- tag: new.slice_rects
  what: subject face cut into 3 horizontal rect slices with thin white frames, drifting apart over black, then snapping back to full clip.
  build: 3 copies of photo with clip-path inset rects; GSAP x ±40px, outline via box-shadow; works great on real-artist portraits.
- tag: fx.rgb_split + colour strobe on close-up
  what: face close-up holds 1.7 s but its tint cycles neutral/red/green every 2–3f while blurred rainbow light streams bg; micro shake 3px.
  build: post pass: per-frame hue rotation table keyed to 16ths; OpenCV channel shift 4–8px; bg = blurred colour blobs moving.
- tag: type.word_slam chrome + sparks
  what: "SPECIAL" slams syllable by syllable in chrome bevel serif on red smoke, orange particle explosion behind.
  build: CSS background-clip text with metal gradient + text-shadow bevel; canvas particle burst; scale 1.3→1 0.15s expo.out.
- tag: trans.zoom_through + fx.spin_blur (hyperspace→swirl)
  what: particle streaks rush to centre, then hypnotic spiral spins 360° in ~1.5 s, posterized thermal colours.
  build: post fx: zoom blur radial 30→0; spiral = conic-gradient + CSS rotate + swirl warp in OpenCV (polar remap).
- tag: type.3d_space (glyph cloud)
  what: dozens of single letters orbit around boy's head in 3D depth, sizes vary, slow rotation.
  build: spans with translateZ random -400..400, parent rotateY GSAP 0→40° over 3 s, perspective 900px.
- tag: ov.sticker (glow X marks)
  what: big neon X marks (purple/lime/peach) pop around a handwritten glowing lyric line inside an iris vignette.
  build: SVG X strokes w/ glow; pop scale 0→1.2→1 back.out on each beat; vignette radial mask.
- tag: new.letter_decay outro
  what: wide-tracked thin "L E T  I T  G O" builds a letter at a time, then each letter erodes into scratchy ink fragments and fades on pale blue.
  build: per-letter mask-image noise threshold animated (CSS mask-size / SVG turbulence filter displacement 0→40).

## What makes it look premium
- Design density: every 2–3 s a new hand-made world — feels like a music video, not a clip montage.
- Type is the hero, clip is texture: words are integrated (behind subjects, embossed in slabs, orbiting heads).
- Constant micro-life: boiling doodles, grain, light leaks, 2f colour strobes; nothing is ever static.
- Restraint in cuts: few hard cuts; transitions are light events (flash, orb, ink, zoom-through) on phrase boundaries.

## Photo-of-artist adaptability
High: gold type behind cutout, slice rects, doodle boil, X stickers, glyph cloud, strobe close-up all work on stills. Clip-motion parts (walking, hair flow) → replace with push + dir_blur + particle bursts.

## Song
"Circles" — Post Malone (credited as original sound montori.aep). Lyric-driven: each phrase = one world; words land on sung syllables; flashes on phrase downbeats.

## Techniques
- tag: type.word_slam (spin-from-dot)
  what: word starts as a dot, rotates -35° to 0 and scales 0→1 in ~12 frames with 1-2 white frame flashes; then the whole line slides with dir blur when the next word arrives.
  build: GSAP from {scale:0,rotation:-35,filter:blur(8px)} power3.out 0.4 s; slide with x tween + CSS filter blur(10px→0) or SVG feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="12,0".
- tag: ov.arrows + camera pan text train
  what: a black line grows behind each word like a sentence track; new word lands at its head while old text scrolls out left.
  build: one wide flex row container translated by x; arrow = div width tween.
- tag: trans.pixel/mosaic (new.tile_shuffle)
  what: image is split into ~24 rectangles that swap in a random order for 4 frames, then resolve to next clip (10.5–10.8).
  build: canvas / CSS grid of background-position tiles with step-timed random reorder; OpenCV pass can do it frame-accurately.
- tag: new.negative_flash
  what: 2-frame colour invert with high contrast (3.0 and 13.0) as accent beat.
  build: filter: invert(1) contrast(1.4) on scene root for 2 frames.
- tag: new.pixel_sky_words
  what: Silkscreen-like pixel words over a photoreal cloud plate drifting vertically; each word lives 0.7 s.
- tag: ui.chat
  what: black pill bubbles with tails and mini timestamp ("Read 20.34" under "sa coba" style iMessage receipt appears in an earlier alt version) slide up from bottom while subject shrinks.
- tag: new.window_card_cursor
  what: photo in rounded card with coloured border, red close badge and arrow cursor; card tilts 5–8° and swaps colour/border per beat; cursor drifts toward the x.
- tag: fx.lens_flare/streak
  what: 4-frame anamorphic star: bright core + horizontal 1-px streak, scale 0→1.4→0, before each black-bg word swap.
- tag: ph.cutout/shatter
  what: collage → plus shape → blurred heart shards (4.7–5.1) acting as a bridge transition.
## What makes it look premium
Every 1–2 s a new "world" with its own palette and type voice, but one constant badge and one constant rhythm; whips/dir blur on every word hand-off; type is the hero (7 font voices) and photos stay small/low-res on purpose; flares and negatives are used sparingly (3 times).
## Song
"suara asli - MG FanzzLyrics" (original sound, sung Indonesian ballad, ~92 BPM / half-time 46). Scenes change on phrase boundaries (~1.5–3.5 s), words land on the vocal syllables; ends before audio tail. No lyric transcription here.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920; palettes rotate per world: cream #f4f1e6, emerald mat #1f7a5a, cloud blue, crimson/white, black + yellow serif. Persistent badge top-left (pause-circle + 2 chips, CFG title/handle) on every scene except pure-black ones. Fonts: Poppins 600 (lowercase lines), Playfair Display italic (serif words), Cinzel (arc line), Silkscreen (pixel words), Anton (stacked block), Caveat (hand script). Look `{glow:.35,glow_thr:.68,rgb:.6,vignette:.22,grain:.03,grade:"warm"}`.
- Assets: 25+ photos (square crops fine, low-res reads intentional), 1 heart PNG, badge = HTML. Cutouts 0. Every scene is a "world" div - build 8 world builders and rotate them; never repeat a world within 3 scenes.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [wordTrain, catSquares]` - wordTrain: hero word spins from a dot (scale 0/rot -35 -> 1, .4s, 2 white flashes), arrow line grows, line slides left with dirblur as the next word lands at the arrow tip. catSquares: photos pop above/below the word, white rect wipe.
  - `build: [collageFloat, chatShrink]` - 4-photo collage slides in, handheld drift +-3deg, one 2-frame invert accent max; chatShrink: subject shrinks to .7 while black chat bubbles slide up from bottom.
  - `brk: [greenMat]` - emerald mat, polaroid drops in (scale 1.4->.5), script writes under it (mask reveal .6s), second script word mirrored. Slowest world - keep it as the break.
  - `drop: [blackSerif, skyPixel]` - blackSerif: single italic serif words swap per kick on black, each preceded by a 4-frame anamorphic flare (`AE.rays` squashed / streak div). skyPixel: pixel words drift down over a cloud photo, one per .7s.
  - `drop2: [windowCards, heartStack]` - windowCards: photo in bordered OS-window card with red x badge + wandering cursor, border colour swaps per kick, diagonal whip between cards. heartStack: crimson heart pops, Anton words stack top/bottom-right, cursor wanders.
  - `outro: [flareWords]` - black, 3-4 serif word swaps with flare, grey flash, black. Badge OFF here.
- Seams/post: `seams:["flash","whip","cut","blur","whip"]`; tile-shuffle/mosaic seam once in build (`AE.fx("glitch")` + CSS tile grid if available). Post: dirblur on every word hand-off (that is the signature), invert only as `AE.impact(...,{frames:2})` twice per film max, no grain.
- Helpers: `AE.maskReveal, AE.pop, AE.stack, AE.fx`, local arrow-train + flare.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: one sung word (or 2-word fragment) per world-beat, each in that world's font - the font IS the scene change. Land on `c.lyricTimes()`, hold the word still while the world moves.
- Sentence train: in wordTrain the line builds left-to-right and scrolls - only the newest word is full opacity; scrolled-out words fade to 40% so the eye follows the vocal.
- UI labels: badge (title/handle), chat bubbles and window-card chrome are CFG/UI text - chat bubble text must be a 2-3 word CFG hook, not a lyric quote, because bubbles read as messages. Timestamps/receipts are safe micro-decor.
- Decorative text safe zones: arc text over a full-bleed photo (curved, gold, reads as title), pixel words in sky, script under the polaroid. Unsafe: serif swaps on black must be ONLY the sung word - any extra word there reads as a subtitle error; no decorative text in the flare frames.

## Techniques
- tag: ui.cursor
  what: macOS-style arrow cursor glides in an arc, hovers, click = target scale 0.93 + ding. Cursor 24px, drop shadow.
  build: SVG cursor, GSAP motionPath or two-step x/y with power2.inOut over 0.5s; click tween on icon.
- tag: new.icon_to_player_morph
  what: app icon expands into the media player card (same rounded rect continues growing, content cross-fades). ~0.25s.
  build: one div; tween width/height/borderRadius/background; icon inner opacity 1->0, card inner 0->1 with stagger 0.05.
- tag: ui.music_player + type.lyric_word_sync
  what: Apple-Music-like lyric view: active line bright, neighbours blurred+dim; per-word brighten synced to vocal; scroll by one line on phrase end.
  build: lines as spans per word; per-word timeline color/opacity to #fff from 0.35; container y tween -lineHeight; neighbours filter blur(3px) opacity .35.
- tag: type.glow (red highlight)
  what: emphasized word gets red text-shadow glow + emoji; pulse 0.2s scale 1.06.
  build: text-shadow 0 0 16px #ff2d3d; yoyo scale.
- tag: fx.vignette + fx.sparkle/particles
  what: warm sepia radial glow behind lyrics, 30-60 slow dust specks (opacity 0.2-0.5) rising ~10 px/s.
  build: CSS radial-gradient + canvas particles.
## What makes it look premium
Light-to-dark ramp tied to the story (opening the app), physical UI behaviour (cursor, press, morph), blurred neighbour lines for depth, subtle dust + vignette, no hard wipes.
## Song
"Secondhand" (on-screen card; Don Toliver ft. Rema). Karaoke sync follows the vocal; ding SFX at 1.0 and 4.2s.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920. Palette light #d9d9dc -> charcoal #17181c -> near-black #0c0b0a, Spotify green #1ed760 (icon only), punch red #ff2d3d. Fonts: Inter 700/800 (UI + lyrics), Inter 600 small for card title/sub. `AE.film` look `{glow:.35,glow_thr:.7,rgb:.5,vignette:.3,grain:.04,grade:"cool"}`; backdrop is a radial-gradient div whose colour is tweened light->dark at the brk, plus 40 dust specks (canvas or AE.sparkles at low opacity, slow rise).
- Assets: 12 photos (`c.P`) - P(0) is the hero "album art", the rest rotate as mini-thumbs; 0 cutouts; 1 SVG cursor, 1 rounded-square app-icon div, heart glyph for the punch word. No photo ever fills the frame - everything lives on the card/thumbnail, so mid-res photos are fine.
- Scene functions (`AE.film` roles):
  - `intro: [iconIntro, morphCard]` - iconIntro: icon centred at 38% height, cursor glides in on an S-curve (two-step x/y, power2.inOut .5s), click = icon scale .93 + `AE.fx("flash",t,{amt:.15,dur:.08})`; karaoke line under it via `AE.words(style:"blur")` on `c.lyricTimes()`. morphCard: the SAME div tweens w/h/radius/bg to the player card (expo.out .3s), inner content stagger-fades, float yoyo +-8px.
  - `build: [cardLyric, sideScroll]` - cardLyric: card holds, lyric lines cycle under it (words style:"blur"). sideScroll: card shrinks/slides to left-third thumbnail (expo.inOut .7s) while a 3-line lyric stack builds right of it; neighbours `blur(3px) opacity:.35`.
  - `brk: [darken]` - repeat sideScroll but tween the backdrop gradient to charcoal over the last .8s and raise dust opacity; end the scene on the drop with `AE.fx("exposure",drop,{amt:.2,dur:.2})` (engine also fires `AE.drop`).
  - `drop: [lyricScroll]` - the money scene, reused with new lines: stack scrolls up one slot per phrase (`y -= lineH`, power3.out .35s), active line words light via `AE.words(style:"blur")` at `c.lyricTimes(6)`; every scroll lands on a kick in `c.k`.
  - `drop2: [lyricScrollRed]` - same builder, `pass>=2` flag tints one word per line red with `text-shadow:0 0 18px #ff2d3d` + scale pulse 1.06 on its vocal time; alternate which line carries the red word.
  - `outro: [miniEnd]` - stack fades, thumbnail card recentres small, dust keeps rising, fade to black over last 1.2s (engine outro fade + manual opacity).
- Seams/post: `seams:["blur","blur","zoom","blur"]` only - no whips/flashes, the morph and scrolls are the transitions. Post events: `AE.fx("glow",t,{amt:.6,dur:.25})` on each red word, zoomblur .18 on the two card moves. Ding/click SFX on the two cursor clicks if SFX=1.
- Helpers: `AE.words`, `AE.fx`, `AMV.fit` for long lines; cursor/morph/lyric-stack are template-local (port from study Techniques).

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: none as slams. The lyric stack IS the hero - one active line at 100% white, ~90-110px Inter 800, words brighten one by one exactly on `lyrics.js` word times (`c.lyricTimes()`), never ahead of the vocal.
- Punch word: at most ONE word per line may go red+glow, and only on the stressed/chorus pass (drop2). It must be the word actually sung at that instant.
- UI labels: card title/sub, progress bar, transport icons are decorative chrome - set once from CFG (title/sub), never timed to vocals, keep at <=35% opacity so they never compete with the active line.
- Decorative text safe zones: the blurred neighbour lines (prev/next) are safe for any lyric text because blur+dim reads as depth, not content; the top black caption bar is a safe permanent zone for the artist/title credit. Never put decorative words in the active-line slot or over the album thumb.

## Techniques
- tag: ui.app_window (OS as stage)
  what: Finder/Photos/Albums/Pinterest/Maps windows are not overlays — they ARE the scene. Photos live inside windows as thumbnails/cards with badges, sidebars, search bars; lyric text is typed into compose pills/search bars or slammed over maps.
  build: rebuild each chrome in HTML (title bar, sidebar list, badge pill) rather than screenshots: .window{border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}; badge = absolute blue pill with count; GSAP drag/slide/scale the whole window. Swapping the photo inside the same window sells "browsing memories".
- tag: new.os_scatter
  what: folders + thumbnails start clustered centre and drift outward to fixed scattered positions with individual rotation (16.5–18.6), like files spreading on a desktop.
  build: absolutely-positioned .file elements; gsap.to each {x,y,rotation} from centre with stagger 0.05, ease power3.out; keep UI-white bg.
- tag: ph.strobe_montage + ph.bw_high_contrast

- tag: ui.ig_story (floating carousel variant)

- tag: new.map_lyric_stage

## What makes it look premium
- One metaphor executed everywhere: memories as files — browsed (Albums), scattered (desktop), pinned (Pinterest), located (Maps), posted (Story), printed (photostrips). Each app change is a scene change, so no slideshow feel.
- Alternating screen-bright OS scenes with tactile desk/photostrip scenes and B&W archive strobes gives three textures in rotation.
- Text is diegetic (typed into UI, written on cards/maps) instead of floating captions; persistent tiny credit line adds "real edit" authenticity.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: extend `osdream` into a *group-photo* variant — same window builders, but `P(j)` are class/group photos and two new scenes (`mapStage`, `photostripDesk`). Ref 40s → 58s: add a second map/photo cycle in drop2 instead of stretching scenes. Seams: `["zoom","blur","flip","whip","glitch"]`.
- `intro: [albumsWindow, bwStrobe]` — albumsWindow: Photos window, group thumb + blue count badge. bwStrobe: 5-6 B&W halftone group poses, hard cuts 0.3-0.5s (`AE.strobe` with B&W srcs), micro push alternating.
- `build: [scrapCard, photostripDesk, storyFull]` — scrapCard: wavy blue-border card, checker strip, star stickers, title fragment types bottom-left (`AMV.type` script). photostripDesk: green mat, 2 printed photostrips settle into Λ, camera drifts (in-scene pan). storyFull: IG story chrome over group photo, 3-word hook types word-by-word centre.
- `brk: [composeBlue]` — black compose UI, ghost text types in pill, blue album cards rise stagger below; near-still.
- `drop: [storyCarousel, osScatter, mapStage]` — storyCarousel: story photos detach into rounded frames floating/rotating on black (blur on swaps). osScatter: folders+thumbs drift outward from centre on white (`gsap to x/y/rotation stagger`). mapStage (signature): map window zooms 1→1.6, bold fragment slams centre, blue person-dots pop stagger 0.2.
- `drop2: [albumsWindow, pinterestWall, storyClips]` — pinterestWall: dark masonry of tilted group photos, diagonal pan. storyClips: story chrome over 3 colour clips/photos, fragment types bottom-left.
- `outro: [creditScript]` — B&W celebration photo darkens, white script logo writes on (`AE.maskReveal` on script text or SVG), tiny credit block (title/artist/class label) fades right.
- Palette: UI white #f4f4f6, folder blue #2f7df6, story black, map pale green/grey, mat #1e7a55, B&W halftone. Fonts: Inter (UI), Poppins Bold (map words), Caveat (strip captions), brush script (outro logo). `AE.base({glow:.12,rgb:.6,vignette:.22,grain:.015})`; B&W scenes via CSS grayscale+halftone overlay (radial-gradient dots, opacity .18).
- Post FX events: `zoomblur` on map zoom + window pushes, `flash` 1f between colour clips, `rgb` 2f into Finder cascade (drop2 variant), engine drops.
- Assets: 30+ *group* photos (this template fails with solo portraits — need wide class/group shots), photostrip = 4-frame stacks built from crops, map = tinted street-pattern SVG/still.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the 3-word hook is the anchor — typed/slammed identically in story, search pill, and map scenes (repetition is the design). Other hero text = map overlay fragments (bold, centre) at vocal times.
- UI labels: album names, badge counts (857/15/3 — static numbers fine), folder names ("memories", "teachers" — file labels, safe), compose ghost text is lyric-carried (it's a typed message), search pill = hook (lyric). Keep filenames as `IMG_####.jpg` style labels.
- Stickers/decorative: stars, checker strips, pins — wordless. Photostrip captions: handwritten fragment or date label ("2024" style) only.
- Class-memoir caution: photos are group memories; text should stay song lyric + neutral archive labels (dates, album names). No invented nostalgic captions ("best day ever" etc.) — they'd read as fake lyric and fake memory.

## Song
"Ramai Sepi Bersama" — Hindia (per caption; track listed as original sound - hecanbawal). ~105 BPM; scrapbook card changes sit on the 0.57 s grid, B&W strobe runs double-time; hook (3 words) is typed/slammed repeatedly as the recurring anchor (story, search pill, map sections).
