## Techniques
- tag: new.ui.os_chain
  what: each 0.5–1 s scene is a faithful OS screen that carries the colour/word of the lyric. Switching = flash, whip, datamosh or zoom.
  build: HTML replicas (Dynamic Island pill, Notification Center cards, Maps with SVG route + marker, macOS desktop + dock, X post card). Each scene a div with data-start; scene change uses gsap tween + shared glitch overlay.
- tag: trans.glitch (datamosh slice)
  what: 2-5 frames: horizontal bands (20-60 px tall) offset +-40..120 px, with pixel-stretch smear and colour clipping.
  build: OpenCV post pass: random row-bands cv2.roll + vertical stretch; or SVG feTurbulence displacement on strips. Trigger frames list.
- tag: fx.rgb_split + fx.vhs (CRT)
  what: R/B channels offset 4-8 px opposite directions on "Green! Green!" and dark scenes, scanlines 2 px, vignette.
  build: duplicated layer with mix-blend-mode screen tinted R/B, or OpenCV channel shift.
- tag: type.3d_extrude "Green" drop; word echo "Green!/!Green" mirrored copy.
- tag: ph.frame_card with perspective carousel — rounded card rotY ±25deg, next card slides in; cam.orbit3d feel.
- tag: ph.strobe_montage — tilted photo strip cycling 6-8 photos at 4-6 frames each over the green grid.
- tag: type.slide_bars — yellow label tags slide in (offset 40 px, 0.15 s).
- tag: new.ov.pin_drop — red map pin scales 0->1.2 with halo ring pulse (2 rings, 0.5 s).

## What makes it look premium
- Every beat has a different "app", so the eye never sees a template twice; word = colour = UI (Green -> CRT/macOS, Red -> poster/messages).
- Glitch is used as punctuation only at scene boundaries, not continuous.
- Fake-UI details (maps labels, dock icons, notification text) give convincing realism.

## Song
"REDRED" - CORTIS. Header shows "Red - Red / Cortis" on white scenes. Words (Green, RED, jepaw) land on vocal hits; scene changes on beats; photo carousel tracks the chorus.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920; colour-keyed acts: black island, map blue #2f6fd0, mint CRT #a7d68f/#5da05a, red #e11d2c, iOS grey #2c2c2e, yellow tags #f5b335. Header + waveform on light scenes only. Fonts: Inter (UI), Lilita One (rounded 3D word via `AE.word3d`), Anton (red poster), Bangers (bubble tag). Look `{glow:.4,glow_thr:.65,rgb:1,vignette:.25,grain:.03,grade:"cool"}` - rgb lives in the dark scenes.
- Assets: 25+ photos (group/portrait), map = SVG route + plane/pin divs over a blue gradient (or one map-style photo), macOS desktop = HTML (wallpaper photo + window + dock dots), traffic-light/poster = HTML shapes. Cutouts: 1 (poster act).
- Scene functions (each 1 scene = 1 app; rotate builders, never reuse an app within 4 scenes):
  - `intro: [island, mapFlight]` - island: dark, avatar circle drifts up, pill types above, rgb-split slice glitch x2. mapFlight: route line draws (SVG dash), plane icon flies NE, 2 yellow tag labels slide in.
  - `build: [greenCRT]` - rounded 3D word drops + squash, shrinks into a CRT monitor div (scanlines + rgb 6px + doubled echo word), zoom out reveals desktop + dock.
  - `brk: [notifCenter]` - notification banners stack one by one over a blurred desk photo, second lines type in; slow push. The stack completing is the break - end on the drop kick.
  - `drop: [redPoster, photoCarousel]` - redPoster: whip into red arrow poster + cutout + speech bubble pop. photoCarousel: rounded cards rotY +-25deg slide per kick (perspective carousel), sparkle on card corner.
  - `drop2: [mapReturn, keypadPills]` - satellite map returns with pin drop (halo rings pulse x2), datamosh seam; mint grid + rapid photo cycle (6-8 photos, 4-6 frames each, `AE.strobe`-style swaps) then message-bubble word slams + keypad circles float + polaroid flip-in.
  - `outro: [bubbleGlitch]` - cartoon bubble word glitch-smears in (horizontal stretch), settles, smears out to black.
- Seams/post: `seams:["flash","glitch","whip","glitch","flash"]`. Post: datamosh = `AE.fx("glitch",t,{amt:1,dur:.3})` + rgb 18 at app changes ONLY (2-5 frames), scanlines are a CSS overlay in the CRT scene, dirblur on whips. Do not glitch inside the notification stack.
- Helpers: `AE.word3d, AE.pop, AMV.type, AE.fx`; local OS-screen builders (island, maps, desktop, notif, X-post, keypad).

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: colour-keyed - when the sung word is a colour/emotion keyword, the WHOLE app + word take that colour (green CRT, red poster). Hero word lands on the vocal; the app change lands on the kick/phrase boundary just before it, so the word arrives in its world.
- UI labels: map tags, notification lines, post text and dock labels are typed CFG/UI text (2-4 words) that must look like real app content. Typed notification text may echo the current sung fragment (that is the joke), but keep it to the fragment already sung.
- Captions: pink outlined captions orbiting the monitor are decorative - 2-line CFG hook, rotated in 3D, never timed word-by-word.
- Stickers: speech bubbles and the outro bubble carry a 1-word CFG exclamation. Decorative text safe zones: yellow map tags, keypad (numbers/letters are native), header band. Unsafe: no lyric text on the satellite map itself except the place label, and the rapid photo cycle must be text-free except one corner caption.

## What makes it look premium
- Typography treats each word as an object: new font, depth and colour for each phrase (gothic logo → helvetica → 3D red numerals → extended glow → serif curve → condensed grotesk) — a "type specimen" feel, while red/white/black unify.
- Frequent hyper-short glitches/flashes (≥10) mask the low-res anime source; chromatic aberration hides softness.
- Perspective-curved text and dust/particles add 3D.

## Song
Original sound by 6sentani; TTS-like female voice reading Indonesian lines over a ~98 BPM bed (rea says 31% voice). Words on screen follow the voice 1:1 (LET'S GO / SAMPAI MATI / GUA BERISIK / JELAS GUA / NEVER GON FLOW); numerals 6→5 count the spoken numbers. Only 6% of cuts on the beat — sync is to the voice, not the music.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920. Palette #000, #fff, red #e0101e, cool grey-teal #7e8f9a (photo grade), tartan accent only in one build scene. Fonts per phrase (the specimen idea): Pirata One (logo), Inter 800 (clean line), Anton (condensed + numerals via `AE.word3d`), Syne 800 (extended glow lines), Playfair Display 900 italic (curved serif), Abril Fatface (fat serif). Look `{glow:.55,glow_thr:.6,rgb:1.2,vignette:.3,grain:.04,grade:"cool"}`.
- Assets: 20+ photos (portraits - they get teal grade, red-mono and slice glitches, so soft/low-res is fine), 2 cutouts for the tartan scene, starfield = generated canvas dots, film-strip edge = CSS repeating border. Anime source in the ref becomes artist photos; keep faces big.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [logoPull, starGo]` - logoPull: CFG title in Pirata One at 5x blurred -> 1x in .4s, then 3 stepwise shrinks on beats, white->black invert at the first step, rgb fringe. starGo: radial particle streaks (200 dots, speed prop. to radius) while the clean line blur-resolves (`AE.words style:"blur"`), zoom-through seam in.
  - `build: [numeral3d, glowLine]` - numeral3d: `AE.word3d` red extruded digit/word spins rotY 60->0 in 4 frames with zoomblur out. glowLine: extended Syne line, glow pulse + 8 `AE.sparkles` 4-point stars.
  - `brk: [tartanCutout]` - tartan bg (CSS gradient), b/w cutout (`grayscale(1)`), stacked serif fragments, small white-box red label over the eyes; slow push only. Deliberately calm + weird before the drop.
  - `drop: [condensedSlams]` - Anton words slam in opposite corners (top-right black / bottom-left white) with chromatic fringe (`AE.fx("rgb",t,{amt:9})`), glitch-slice seams (8 horizontal slices) between photos every 2-3 kicks.
  - `drop2: [redMono]` - photos mapped red monochrome (CSS `grayscale+sepia+hue` stack or grade swap) inside film-strip borders, scanline overlay, alternating with cool teal shots; eye extreme close-up (face crop via `AE.face` max zoom) as the centrepiece.
  - `outro: [eyeFade]` - slow push on a profile portrait, purple tint settles, fade to black over 1.5s, logo micro-tag last frame.
- Seams/post: `seams:["glitch","zoom","glitch","flash","glitch"]`. Post: glitch is the punctuation - `AE.trans(...,"glitch")` + rgb 12-18 on seams, `AE.impact` ONLY on the numeral slam and first drop word, red-mono is a CSS filter state not a post event. Sync is to VOICE not kicks: use `c.lyricTimes()` for word landings even when they fall between kicks (this ref is 6% on-beat by design).
- Helpers: `AE.word3d/lyric3d` (numeral), `AE.words`, `AE.sparkles`, `AE.face/faceSeq`, `AE.scramble` (optional logo resolve).

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: every sung phrase is a hero, but each gets a DIFFERENT font/depth - the font change itself signals a new line. One phrase (max 3 words) on screen at a time; land the first word on the vocal onset, the rest per syllable.
- Numerals: a spoken number becomes a giant 3D numeral object, not text - only use when the lyric/config actually contains a number word; otherwise the numeral slot takes the scene's loudest word via `AE.word3d`.
- UI labels: none diegetic here except the tiny creator logo - keep it bottom-corner, <=50% opacity, and never during a slam. The white-box red label over the eyes is a sticker: 2-3 word CFG hook maximum, not a lyric line.
- Decorative text safe zones: sparkles/star corners and the tartan margins are safe for single decorative words; the starfield scene can hold a blurred ghost copy of the next word. Unsafe: anywhere over the eye close-up, and stacked fragments must never exceed 3 words or they stop reading as fragments.

original sound (6sentani, Mbak Billie); on-screen lyric words ("CAN'T DO LIKE THIS", "STELAN AKU FRESHH") are sung-line chunks (2-3 words) in sync; a spoken/sung line is typed at 12.4 on silence.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920. Palette navy-black #0b1520, cyan-cast photos, red #e0212b (duotone flashes), blue title #2830f0, yellow #f4b21c. Persistent HUD (act 1/drop2): top 3-field strip + bottom 2-line caption, tiny Inter. Fonts: Anton/Archivo Black (stickers + behind-subject words), Great Vibes (credit script), Inter (typed line + HUD). Look `{glow:.4,glow_thr:.62,rgb:1.1,vignette:.3,grain:.04,grade:"cool"}`.
- Assets: 25+ photos, 3+ cutouts (`c.C` - this style lives on cutouts; check QA scores, reject fuzzy), "666"-style number pattern = CSS repeating text bg, marble flash = gradient blob div. Fast states: pre-build each scene's states as DOM, swap on kicks.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [gridTear]` - tilted photo cards rotY 20, jagged torn edges (zigzag clip-path), vertical hairline noise 4f, 2x2 perspective grid + red duotone flash at 1.2s, chevron arrows spin in, sticker word glitch-slices in and holds.
  - `build: [cutoutWords]` - cutout (6px white outline, `AE.stickerCSS`) over a dark stage photo; words pop per letter beside it with hand-drawn curved arrows (`AE.writeOn` SVG paths) pointing at the subject; ink-splash flashes offset the cutout 4px on kicks.
  - `brk: [blueTitle]` - solid blue title card (stacked words + tiny chips), white skewed panel wipes in from right typing 3 lines per line, cutout stays left. Panel typing is the break's focus - no glitch here.
  - `drop: [behindSubject]` - IG-header scene: big words BEHIND the cutout (text div z-under, cutout clips it), then number-pattern bg with huge yellow letters split left/right of the subject, red/white pattern flips + blue duotone cutout flip on kicks, glitch strip between states.
  - `drop2: [bwBeat]` - b/w high-angle photos with a moving glitch bar + tiny yellow centre caption (changes per phrase), silhouette cutout moonwalk pose (motion blur -> sharp), then a tiny centre typewriter line on near-silence.
  - `outro: [guitarFade]` - b/w close photo, serif italic CFG credit centre, vignette, chromatic flicker once at mid, fade to black from 80%.
- Seams/post: `seams:["glitch","whip","glitch","whip","cut"]`. Post: glitch blocks are the house style - `AE.fx("glitch",t,{amt:1,dur:.2})` + rgb 12 on state changes in intro/drop, but MAX 2 consecutive glitch kicks then a clean hold (the ref breathes: burst -> calm -> burst). Duotone flips are CSS filter states.
- Helpers: `AE.stickerCSS, AE.writeOn, AE.pop, AE.fx, AMV.type`; local HUD strip (build once, toggle per role).

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: sticker slams and behind-subject words carry sung fragments (2-3 words). Behind-subject text must be the CURRENT phrase - because the body occludes it, keep words short and split around the subject (left/right) rather than centre.
- Typed line: the tiny centre typewriter in drop2 is a spoken/sung line typed at vocal speed on a quiet moment - the only small lyric in the film; give it a clean black bg and no HUD.
- UI labels: HUD strip fields and IG header (avatar/handle/song tag) are CFG decor - plausible, static within a scene, tiny. The yellow centre captions in bwBeat are phrase captions: 2-3 sung words, changing only on phrase boundaries.
- Stickers: label stickers (white pill, black text) carry a 1-word hook; arrows point but carry no text. Decorative text safe zones: HUD bands, number-pattern margins, blue card chips. Unsafe: no text over the silhouette (it is a shape beat), and torn/grid scenes may hold only the one sticker word.

STYLE-KEY: 3d-phone-voicemail-glow
CLOSEST-EXISTING: iphone
NOVELTY: a single 3D iPhone (in-call screen, contact "bae♥") floats in a black void and does a slow product turntable (front → edge → back camera → edge → front), then locks 3/4-left while the spoken voicemail is captioned ONE WORD AT A TIME in glowing white beside it, sitting on a live audio waveform line that pulses with the voice; ends on a 3D graveyard tombstone with engraved text and curved floating type.

(32.7 s; content 720x720 inside 720x1280 repost w/ top caption "i haven't edited in 6 months…", 30 fps, spoken-word (no beat grid; word cadence ~2.5 words/s), 1 long take + 2 shots)

## Look
- Palette: pure black void #000 → soft grey studio fog #2A2A2E behind words; phone graphite #1A1A1C, iOS end-call red #E5323B, word glow white #FFFFFF with 20px bloom; payoff: desaturated brown graveyard, grey stone.
- Grade: low-key product render, single soft top light, faint red bounce on floor near phone.
- Fonts: SF Pro Rounded Semibold lowercase (words), iOS UI on screen; payoff serif (Cormorant) curved.
- Texture: none; bloom only.

## Timeline
0.00–1.70 | black | — | fade from black | — | — | — | —
1.70–4.00 | 3D phone tiny far top-right → flies to centre, tilted 20°, screen lit (call UI) | dolly-in + roll settle | — | — | ui.iphone in-call | DOF | —
4.00–5.40 | phone front, slow rotateY 0→90° (edge) →180° (back, camera bump, apple) | turntable | — | — | — | spec highlight sweep | —
5.40–7.60 | back → edge → front again; camera pushes close on edge, frame fills | orbit + push | — | — | — | — | —
7.60–9.00 | close edge-on swing past camera, phone tumbles away into depth flat (top view), returns upright small | cam.orbit3d | — | — | — | motion blur | —
9.00–12.70 | phone small centre, settles; then rotates to back, light ramp-up: grey fog bg appears, phone grows to 3/4 left-of-frame | push | light-up | first word "hey" glows in to right of phone with a horizontal waveform line extending right | new.voice_waveform | glow | on speech
12.70–29.60 | LOCKED composition: phone left 35% (3/4 angle, rotateY ~25°), word centre-right replaces itself per spoken word (cut, no tween, 2-3 frame bloom-on), waveform line under word wiggles with amplitude of the voice | micro drift (1-2%) | word cuts | type.lyric_word_sync (single word swap) | new.voice_waveform | glow_bloom, fog vignette | per syllable
29.60–30.40 | fog fades, phone shrinks back to small centre, black | pull | fade | — | — | — | —
30.40–32.70 | 3D graveyard: tombstone "R.I.P." + flat slab w/ engraved two-line text; camera glides low over slab; curved serif text arc floats in front, words fade in | dolly + slow orbit | hard cut | type.3d_space (arched) + engraved | — | DOF, desat | end

## Techniques
- tag: new.product_turntable (3D object hero)
  what: single hero object rotates full 360° Y while camera dollies; specular sweep travels across glass on each 90°.
  build: HTML: CSS 3D box (front=screen img, back=back img, 4 edge divs 40px), rotateY GSAP 3.5 s sine.inOut, gradient overlay div whose x moves with rotation for spec. Or Three.js phone model.
- tag: type.lyric_word_sync (single-word glow swap)
  what: each word appears instantly on its spoken onset (no slide), same position, white with outer glow (text-shadow 0 0 12px #fff, 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,.6)); 2f scale 1.04→1 pop.
  build: timeline of word onsets (whisper word timestamps); set textContent at t; tiny scale tween.
- tag: new.voice_waveform
  what: thin white horizontal line starting at word's left baseline extending to frame edge; displaced by audio amplitude (oscilloscope), glow.
  build: canvas polyline, y = A(t)·noise; A from precomputed RMS envelope JSON per frame.
- tag: cam.parallax_layers (subtle)
  what: phone and word on different z: phone rotated 25° foreground-left, word floats mid-depth, fog plane behind → depth from fog gradient + glow.
- tag: type.3d_space + engraved (payoff)
  what: words carved into stone slab (inset shadow) + curved arch text floating in air.
  build: CSS text-shadow inset trick on texture; arch via SVG textPath.

## What makes it look premium
- Restraint: one object, one word, one light. Silence and glow do the work.
- Real 3D product turntable before locking gives "rendered" credibility.

## Build recipe
- Port: `iphone` template new scene `voicemailGlow`: CSS 3D phone (front/back screenshots), turntable intro, then locked word-swap + waveform canvas from audio RMS. Outro scene tombstone photo with engraved text overlay.

## Lyric/text system
- Every spoken word = one hero word, swap on onset. No other text.

## Song
Original sound naughtyyjuan — spoken voicemail (apology monologue) over ambient pad; no beat sync, speech sync.

- Every word is diegetic (typed into a real surface), so the edit reads as a screen story, not captions.
- Scale continuity (screen→window→card→full photo) replaces cuts with motivated zooms.
- One blue-bubble motif recurs in 4 scenes as a visual chorus.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: extend `osdream` (closest) — add the lock-screen and blue lyric-wall scenes it lacks. Stage is 9:16 native in our build: phone scenes full-bleed tall, desktop scenes stacked windows vertical. Seams: `["blur","zoom","flip","whip"]`; the ref's lock→window morph is a scale tween inside one scene, not a seam.
- `intro: [lockNotif, windowMorph]` — lockNotif: iOS lock screen (Inter, blue lock glyph), 2 notification bubbles; sender = artist name, preview = vocal fragment typed 0.05s/char (`AMV.type`). windowMorph: lock screen scales to 45% window, dock rises, portrait card `P(0)` grows right — continuous GSAP, no cut.
- `build: [desktopPush, blueWall]` — desktopPush: multi-window stack, portrait card pushes full-bleed, small white caption bottom = next fragment (`AE.words style:"rise"`). blueWall: deep blue #123e6e page, camera pans across stacked white lyric lines (the *upcoming* fragments pre-set at low opacity, active line full) while portrait shrinks to a strip.
- `brk: [searchType]` — Google-style search box on white: the hook fragment types per char with caret; freeze on completion, suggestions list = neutral labels (artist, song title, "lyrics", "official audio").
- `drop: [shareSheet, portraitChain]` — shareSheet: Photos share sheet, portrait travels lock→window→card→full-bleed in one push (scale chain across the scene, `AE.fx("zoomblur")` at full-bleed landing). portraitChain: video-card portraits swap per kick, caption word per kick.
- `drop2: [blueWall, windowMorph, shareSheet]` — second pass, fragments advance; yellow browser window #ffe600 variant of windowMorph for colour change.
- `outro: [lockReturn]` — back to lock screen, final notification = song title + artist, signature script bottom, fade.
- Palette: iOS white/#f2f2f7, bubble blue #0a84ff, wall blue #123e6e, yellow window #ffe600, ink #111. Fonts: Inter (all UI), Inter ExtraBold white (wall), Caveat/Pacifico (signature only). `AE.base({glow:.1,rgb:.5,vignette:.12,grain:.006})`.
- Post FX events: `dirblur` 3f on window zooms, `zoomblur` on shareSheet landing + engine drops, `rgb` small on portrait swaps. SFX clicks on typing if SFX=1.
- Assets: 30+ photos (one hero portrait set that "travels" — pick 3-4 hero shots reused across windows), 1-2 cutouts optional for card pop-outs.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: there are **no overlaid titles by design** — lyric exists only as typed UI text: notification previews, search query, chat bubble, share-sheet caption, blue-wall lines. All from `CFG.lyrics`; type so the fragment completes on the vocal phrase end. Blue wall is the one place a *stack* of fragments shows: inactive lines at 40% are still real (past/next) lyric fragments, never filler.
- UI labels (safe): time/date, "Unlock", app names, dock labels, suggestion rows (song title/artist/"lyrics"), share-sheet target names. Keep them functional-looking and small.
- Stickers/decorative: signature script = artist name; avatar = photo thumb. No decorative words elsewhere — any word in a bubble/search field will be read as the lyric, so decorative text is only safe in chrome (buttons, tabs, timestamps).
- If lyrics unverified: notifications/search carry song title + artist name only, blue wall becomes a photo strip with *no* lines. Do not type plausible fake lines into the search box — it's the most-read surface in the template.

## Song
Original sound by the uploader; mixed Indonesian/English vocal (title phrase is the hook). Lyric is performed by the UI typing; only 2–3 words are quoted per moment here. ~130 BPM; typing bursts, tile pops and line changes sit on the beat.

## Techniques
- tag: ph.strobe_montage — ~9 crops of one b&w selfie, each 3 frames. build: one video/photo clip and 9 pre-cut crops (object-position + scale 1.1–1.6); gsap.set every 0.1 s; filter grayscale(1) contrast(1.6) brightness(1.1).
- tag: trans.glitch — 3-frame slit bars: 4–6 horizontal-or-vertical bars of the image shifted ±20% + black bars. build: CSS clip-path inset() slices of the same img translated; or post OpenCV: random strips (height 8–60 px) offset in x, plus RGB channel shift 4 px.
- tag: type.word_slam + fx.glow_bloom — word enters 1.2–1.3x, 3-frame scale to 1.0 with ease expo.out; text-shadow 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,.7); on slam 1-frame white flash (exposure +30%).
- tag: type.repeat_echo (new) — current word white 100% at centre, previous and next words in #7a0f1a at 55% scale above and below (full-width), so a vertical stack of the chant lines forms; build: 3 stacked divs per beat.
- tag: type.stack_blocks — HOLDING / THAT / BEAN stacked with different colours (white / grey / red grunge); red torn-paper shape behind the cut-out head. build: z-ordered layers + cut-out PNG with white 4 px outline (ph.cutout_sticker).
- tag: ph.cutout_over_text — the guy cut-out overlaps "HOLDING THAT" (depth by z-order; text partly behind head) at 2.0–2.5.
- tag: ui.ig_story (mini) — avatar card in a story-like frame with ✕ + camera icons, red curtain rails; flip3d to a button-card ("SHE LOW"), stacked cards with soft shadows; pink wipe. build: DOM cards in perspective(800px) rotateY tween 0.13 s.
- tag: new.loop — total design is a seamless loop (#loopvember): last frames = first frames' content (strobe) so TikTok replays look continuous; build: make the end 4 frames strobe pre-roll before cutting at the loop point.

## What makes it look premium
- Hard limited palette (black/white/crimson) → instantly cohesive; all type is huge, cropped by frame, glowing.
- Pace: three speeds — 0.1 s strobe, 1 beat word chant, 0.5 s card flips — the audience never sees the same cadence for >1 s.
- Echo layers behind the lead word and cut-out head overlap type give 3-layer depth in an otherwise flat design.

## Song
"schyeah..." (Vallcry VTX edit; trend loop). Voice/lyric words appear as the on-screen words: ~1 word per beat; 4 words per line (HOLDING THAT / LETSGO / TALK ABOUT MONEY / GET YOU COOKED). rea: 140 BPM C major; only 25% of cuts on beat (strobe at 3-frame cadence breaks beat grid by design).
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920 (source is 4:3 - rebuild native 9:16, do not letterbox). Palette ONLY #000000, #ffffff, crimson #c4122b, dark echo red #7a0f1a, mid grey #8a8a8a. Fonts: Anton (kinetic words, `AMV.fit` to edge-to-edge), Oswald 700 for the wider word, Permanent Marker for the graffiti tag. Look `{glow:.5,glow_thr:.6,rgb:.8,vignette:.35,grain:.05,grade:"bw"}` + per-photo `grayscale(1) contrast(1.35)`.
- Assets: 18+ photos (tight crops work - the strobe re-crops them), 2 cutouts (`c.C`, white sticker outline via `AE.stickerCSS`), 1 torn red blob (SVG), 1 chibi/avatar sticker PNG. Photos must survive b/w crush: pick high-contrast shots, reject `fuzzy` cutouts.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [strobeCrops, slitTitle]` - strobeCrops: one photo, 9 pre-set crops (object-position/scale 1.1-1.6) swapped every 3 frames with `AE.strobe(...,{every:3})`, scale jitter +-8%. slitTitle: 3-6 black slit bars slide (clip-path slices offset 20%) for 3 frames, chrome-gradient hero word resolves with glow.
  - `build: [stackWords]` - words stack in 3 voices (white / grey / red brush) via `AE.blocks` custom colours, cutout head overlaps the stack (z above text), red blob pops behind it (`AE.pop`).
  - `brk: [cardFlip]` - avatar sticker shrinks to an app-icon card between red curtain rails, `AE.flipCard` to a red button-card, pink zoom-through out; slow it down - this is the breath before the drop.
  - `drop: [chantEcho]` - one word per kick, centred white at 100%, previous+next words as #7a0f1a ghosts at 55% scale above/below (3 stacked divs, swap on each `c.k`); each landing `scale 1.3->1` in 3 frames + 1-frame exposure pulse.
  - `drop2: [chantEcho, strobeCards]` - chant again with the next lyric words and the graffiti tag sliced vertically down the left edge; strobeCards replays the intro strobe at double density.
  - `outro: [loopStrobe]` - return to the exact intro strobe crops for the last scene so a 58s cut still loops on TikTok; slice-glitch, dim to black.
- Seams/post: `seams:["cut","glitch","cut","flip"]` - bare cuts only inside strobes. Post: `AE.impact(t)` on the first drop word only, `AE.fx("rgb",t,{amt:10})` on slit moments, glow accents on snares (engine). Keep flashes white, never coloured.
- Helpers: `AE.strobe, AE.blocks, AE.pop, AE.flipCard, AE.fx("glitch")` seam, `AE.stickerCSS`.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the chant - ONE word at a time, full-frame width, timed 1 word per vocal syllable/kick from `c.lyricTimes()`. If the vocal is faster than the kicks, halve: land on kicks and let ghosts imply the rest.
- Echo ghosts: previous/next words at 55% in dark red are decorative rhythm, NOT a second lyric line - they are safe because they are dim, smaller and never change mid-word. Only ever show words adjacent to the sung one (no random filler words).
- UI labels: the tiny creator tag bottom-corner and the story-frame icons (x, +, camera) are pure chrome; keep them <40px, 50% opacity, out of the centre third.
- Stickers: avatar/tag stickers carry NO lyric text except the creator name (CFG title). Never put lyric words on the red button-card - it reads as a UI button, so text there must be a 1-2 word hook from CFG, not a sung line. Safe decorative zone: the left-edge vertical tag strip.

# p10 — "NURANI 2026 coming soon" campus-event teaser: ghost-crowd plate + sticker frame + face punches (KOSMIK UNHAS)
STYLE-KEY: event-teaser-ghostcrowd-stickerframe
CLOSEST-EXISTING: scrapbook
NOVELTY: a single 16:9 locked-off clip where the background crowd is time-smeared into translucent ghosts (frame-blend echo) while three hosts stand sharp in front — the separation of sharp foreground vs ghosted background IS the depth; corner blob/starburst stickers frame it, camera punches face-to-face with whip blur, tracked "COMING SOON!!!!" sign + tag stickers, then a bouncy multi-colour logo builds letter by letter above their heads.

(10.2 s, 1280x720 16:9, 30 fps, ~120 BPM est. (beat ~0.5 s), 1 source clip, ~6 reframes, ~0.6 reframes/s)

## Look
- Palette: campus salmon wall #E08A6A + white lattice, sticker cobalt #2A6AC8, sticker vermilion #E0481E, sticker yellow tag #F2C21E w/ blue text, logo multi (red #D8401E, yellow #F2B21E, sky #6AB8E8, cobalt), sign card mint #BFF0F0 w/ black hand-lettering.
- Grade: warm bright, slightly washed; ghosted crowd ~40% opacity.
- Fonts: hand-lettered marker (COMING SOON → "Permanent Marker"), condensed bold tags (WHAT?/HUH? → "Bebas Neue"), logo: chunky playful mixed-colour letters w/ icons inside (heart, mic) → custom/"Lilita One".
- Texture: none.

## Timeline
0.00–1.00 | wide: crowd of students walking across frame, rendered as overlapping translucent ghosts; 3 hosts fade in sharp, standing | static | fade-in of hosts through ghost crowd | — | — | new.ghost_crowd (frame blend) | —
1.00–1.40 | blue flower-blob stickers + red starbursts pop in at 4 corners (scale 0→1 back.out, slight rotate), sign card held by host | — | — | — | ov.sticker frame | — | yes
1.40–2.30 | punch to host 1 (left) face/upper body 1.0→1.8; "COMING SOON!!!!" sign sticker tracks her hand; yellow tag "WHAT?" pops below | cam.punch_face | trans.whip from wide | type sticker tag | ov.sticker | dir_blur | yes
2.30–3.00 | whip right to host 3 (boy) close; blue tag "HUH?" pops; sign sticker now smaller beside host 2 | cam.pan whip | trans.whip | tag pop | ov.sticker | dir_blur | yes
3.00–3.80 | whip to host 2 (hijab) holding sign, sign sticker scales up | cam.pan | trans.whip | — | — | dir_blur | yes
3.80–5.30 | pull back; logo letters N-U-R-A-N-I pop one per 1/8 beat at top with bounce and colour; "2026" big sky-blue numerals with heart/icon counters; then logo zooms huge and settles small at top | cam.pull | — | type.per_letter bounce | — | — | per letter
5.30–8.80 | wide: hosts dance/pose under logo, corner stickers wobble, signs bob | micro shake | — | logo holds with idle bob | ov.sticker | — | yes
8.80–10.20 | hosts + logo dissolve into ghost crowd plate (reverse of intro); ends black | — | crossfade ghost | — | — | echo | end

## Techniques
- tag: new.ghost_crowd (sharp fg vs ghosted bg = depth)
  what: walking crowd smeared into semi-transparent ghosts (5-8 frame accumulation) while main subjects remain crisp — reads as long-exposure depth separation.
  build: OpenCV post: per-frame mask of subjects (rembg/SAM); bg = rolling average of last 8 frames (cv2.addWeighted accumulate), fg composite sharp on top. In HTML: stack 6 video/frame copies offset in time at 15% opacity under a subject cut-out layer.
- tag: ov.sticker frame (corner blobs/starbursts)
  what: 4-6 organic SVG shapes hug the frame corners, pop on beat and gently rotate ±5° idle.
  build: SVG paths absolute at corners, GSAP scale back.out stagger .05, yoyo rotate.
- tag: cam.punch_face + trans.whip
  what: reframes within one 16:9 clip to each host (scale 1.8, x offset) with 4-frame horizontal blur whip.
  build: GSAP on video wrapper scale/x, post dir_blur on seams.
- tag: new.tracked_sign_sticker
  what: "COMING SOON!!!!" card sticker attached to host's raised hand, follows position.
  build: keyframed x/y per 5 frames (manual track or OpenCV template tracking) → GSAP keyframes.
- tag: type.per_letter (logo build) + ov.sticker tags (WHAT?/HUH?).

## What makes it look premium
- Ghost-crowd plate gives instant depth/energy from a single phone clip; sticker frame brands it.

## Build recipe
- Port: `scrapbook` family scene `ghostCrowdTeaser`: OpenCV pre-pass for ghost bg + subject matte, HTML overlays for corner stickers, tags, tracked sign, letter-pop logo. Seams `["whip"]`.

## Lyric/text system
- No lyric; text = event branding (logo, COMING SOON, reaction tags). Tags land on beats.

## Song
"original sound – KOSMIK UNHAS" (upbeat pop/edm bed). ~120 BPM est.

- tag: new.beat_color_cycle
  what: background tint cycles pink->blue->yellow every beat while word changes; text + ring colour matches tint
  build: GSAP timeline set bg/color at each beat time, ring + sparkles recreated each beat.
- tag: trans.shape_iris
  what: stroke ring scales 0.4->1.4 around word and dissolves; used as in/out for every word; plus spiral speed lines for out
- tag: type.word_slam / type.per_letter
  what: bubble letters land per-letter (stagger 2f, scale 1.6->1, overshoot) with drip shapes on bottom edge
- tag: ph.frame_card
  what: cat photos in rounded-square sticker card (14% radius, 6px coloured border, tilt 5deg, shadow); 2x2 zoom-out grid
- tag: ui.music_player
  what: lyric player with transport controls and perspective-tilted scrolling lyric stack, bg colour jumps on beat
  build: CSS perspective(900px) rotateX(35deg) on lyric list, translateY marquee, blur by distance.
- tag: ui.ig_story/ui.chat
  what: dark IG-post card (counts, caption, handle) for cat clips; caption text swap per clip
- tag: new.ink_splash_wipe
  what: white paint-stroke splash reveal at 0.2s (frame-by-frame vector/lottie) over pink start
- tag: trans.whip
  what: horizontal dir blur + 8px glitch strips between cat cards (4-6 frames)
- tag: ph.echo_trail / ph.mirror
  what: 36.6s ghost double exposure (frame blended with mirrored copy 6 frames) before whip
- tag: new.pixel_sprite
  what: low-res yellow emoji w/ stepped hand animation behind text lines; no antialias; scale-up nearest-neighbour
- tag: cam.push
  what: 3-8% scale push on full-bleed cat clips over 2-3s
## What makes it look premium
Constant HUD + per-beat colour/shape changes keep the eye busy; nothing static for more than ~1 beat; consistent sticker/drip/ring vocabulary; contrast of pastel flat word scenes with real photo scenes; clean 60fps motion blur.
## Song
"suara asli - jasa edit" (original sound; Indo meme-song "Lo Gueh End / DIA" lyric displayed in player). 123 BPM; each colour flip and cut on 0.49s grid; END section 15.9–17.9 hits every beat.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas 1080x1080. Palette rooms: pink `#F4B6BD/#E8404F`, blue `#BFE4F3/#3AA7E0`, yellow `#F8EFA6/#F2D21E`, END cyan/red/navy/magenta. Fonts: Baloo 2 ExtraBold (bubble), Oswald (small lines), Pacifico (script), Poppins ExtraBold (player).
- Persistent camcorder HUD layer above `AE.film` (REC blink 1Hz, timecode via onUpdate, brackets) — never inside scenes.
- `roles:{intro:[wordRoom], build:[wordRoom,playerUI], brk:[scriptBreak], drop:[catCards,endSlam], drop2:[igCats,wordRoom], outro:[hudFade]}`; seams `["iris","whip","flash","blur"]`.
- intro/build `wordRoom(c)`: bg tint set per kick (beat colour-cycle), ring `AE.trans iris` in/out, `AE.words slam` per-letter stagger 0.03, sparkle burst `AE.sparkles`.
- brk `scriptBreak(c)`: white, script `AE.writeOn`, one bouncy hero word, flower sparkles — the only calm scene.
- drop `catCards(c)`: sticker cards (radius 14%, 6px tinted border, rot 6deg) slide per kick, cursor tap `scale .85`; `endSlam(c)`: giant drippy word, bg colour per kick, scale pulse 1→1.1, speedline swirl.
- drop2 `igCats(c)`: dark IG-post cards, caption swap per kick, final card zoom 1→1.45; outro: full-bleed photo push 1→1.08, fade white→black, HUD fades last.
- Helpers: AE.pill/pillIn, AE.pop, AE.stack, AE.fan, AE.words, AE.sparkles; player act = perspective lyric list `rotateX(35deg)` + blur-by-row.
- Post FX: `dirblur` on card slides, `spinblur` on ring transitions, `rgb:6` on END exit, `flash` at photo acts; 60fps motion blur from 240fps render.
- Assets: 8–10 meme/pet or subject photos, 4 tinted borders, pixel-emoji sprite sheet, cursor PNG, HUD SVG icons.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words (bubble font): one word/short phrase per beat-room, colour-matched to bg; timing = vocal word onset = kick in this track (0.49s grid).
- Player lines: perspective lyric stack in the player act, active row big/crisp, others blurred; bg flips colour on the beat under them.
- UI labels: HUD (REC/timecode), IG captions, player title — static or per-photo, not synced word-by-word; keep them short.
- Stickers: pixel emoji, cursor, `!?` marks react to (not transcribe) the vocal — pop on the syllable after the hero word.
- Decorative/safe: END colour-cycle word, sparkles/rings — safe as pure rhythm. Unsafe: lyric text over cat faces; HUD zone top/bottom 8%.

## What makes it look premium
Uniform candy material system (soft shadows, bevel pills, glow-borders), constant beat-locked pill adds (never repeated layout twice), cursor/handle UI jokes, transitions that always re-use the circle motif, and white sparkle punctuation.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas 1080x1080. Palette: pink `#F4707F/#F2A0AE`, teal `#1FB7C4`, white, checker pink glow. Font: Baloo 2 everywhere (hero, pills, caps) — one-font discipline.
- `roles:{intro:[irisAvatar], build:[pillStack,livePills], brk:[cursorMorph], drop:[cardCollage,bubbleWords], drop2:[checkerAct,pillStack], outro:[logoGlow]}`; seams `["iris","blur","glitch"]`.
- intro `irisAvatar(c)`: white circle iris from black, avatar card tilt −10deg, confetti dots parallax drift.
- build `pillStack(c)`: one pill per kick added diagonally (`AE.pill`+`AE.pillIn` back.out 2.2), stack nudges up, sparkle per pill; `livePills(c)`: IG-Live chrome (progress/name/viewers) with teal pills as chat bubbles.
- brk `cursorMorph(c)`: pixel cursor clicks, heart bounding-box with 8 handle squares morphs to triangle around `P(j)` — the joke beat, keep type minimal.
- drop `cardCollage(c)`: 3 glow-border cards (radius 14%, pink glow) float at depths, hero words with rotating `!` pivot; `bubbleWords(c)`: speech bubbles pop alternating tails over big portrait push 1.05→1.15.
- drop2 `checkerAct(c)`: checker bg scroll, eye-strip panel + name tags over portrait, segmented iris (pie blades) to second portrait.
- outro `logoGlow(c)`: fade to black, neon name `AE.fx glow` pulse x2.
- Helpers: AE.pill/pillIn, AE.pop, AE.sparkles, AE.stack, AE.flipCard, AE.trans iris/glitch(pixel rows).
- Post FX: `glow` on card borders/logo, `dirblur` on card slides, pixel-row `glitch` wipe into final act; clean, no grain.
- Assets: 5–6 portraits (1 cutout), avatar pair, cursor PNG, checker pattern, sparkle/dot SVGs.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero system = pills: one sung word per pill, one pill per beat (0.44s), stacked diagonally/vertically; stack persists so the phrase accumulates visibly.
- Speech bubbles over portraits: 1–2 word fragments, tail side alternates, bounce overshoot on vocal onset.
- Caps slams: short exclamation phrases in Baloo caps with jittering punctuation — drop moments only.
- UI labels: IG-Live chrome (name/viewers/progress) static; photo-card captions swap per beat under cards (1 word each).
- Decorative/safe: dots/sparkles/checker act tags (name badges). Unsafe: long lines anywhere — this preset only works word-by-word; unknown lyrics → CFG.words single tokens.

## Song

## Build recipe (58s)
- Engine: `AE.film(tl,{roles:{intro:[scPhotoReveal,scIgDive],build:[scCardDay,scTrainWhip,scChatWhy],brk:[scScrollLetters],drop:[scMirrorPhoto,scCardDay2,scChatWhy2],drop2:[scIgDive2,scPillBurstFinale],outro:[scLeakOut]},seams:["flash","whip","blur"],seamAt:(c)=>c.role==="brk"?"blur":"flash",look:{glow:.35,grain:0},cam:{hand:4,velo:.5},bg:"#fff"})`; stage 720x900. Verified vs contact sheet: IG dive, blue pill + burst, train card, chat + vertical letters, mirrored photo, leak-out all present.
- Palette/fonts: white centre to #D8D8D8 vignette, natural warm photos, single accent electric blue #3A45E0, IG dark #0B0B0D. Inter/Roboto Bold lowercase pills, Roboto IG UI, Arial/Inter Regular black for the stacked letters.
- Persistent element: centre chrome logo sticker + 4-point star flare (SVG, drop-shadow glow) pinned over the face in every photo scene; build once, parent to the photo layer so it travels.
- intro: `scPhotoReveal(c)` white exposure fade-in (20f ease-out) on full photo; `scIgDive(c)` pull to 70% revealing dark IG post, then push+pan into caption (scale ->2.6, rotateX 10/rotateY -10 late), caption types per char, zoom-blur first 3f.
- build: `scCardDay(c)` spin/zoom-out from sticker macro into tilted card (-20 -> -5deg, shrink to 55%), blue pill slides from right (6f) and attaches; `scTrainWhip(c)` vertical whip from below (2f dir blur), handheld drift rotate -8->0->3deg, pull into rounded card; `scChatWhy(c)` card defocuses (`AE.focus`), avatar + grey pill pop from dot, pill types and expands.
- brk: `scScrollLetters(c)` one tall column (chat, 3 stacked black letters ~120px, next photo) scrolls up 1.2 screens power2.inOut with vertical dir blur; settle on photo.
- drop: `scMirrorPhoto(c)` ghost copies offset +/-60px crossfade into the mirrored photo (`AE.echo` + scaleX -1 copy), slow push 1->1.04; then repeat `scCardDay2/scChatWhy2` with new photos and the next phrase (same builders, `c.P(1)`, `c.P(2)`).
- drop2: `scIgDive2(c)` second caption dive (different photo/caption), `scPillBurstFinale(c)` card at 25%, ~18 blue pills burst from centre in 3f (random scale .4-1.4, rotation +/-35deg, expo.out) then slow drift - the one big FX moment, place on D2. Outro: `scLeakOut(c)` monochrome light-leak blobs sweep, expand to white, hard cut black.
- Helpers/post/assets: reuse `AE.focus/defocusIn`, `AE.echo`, `AE.pop`, `AE.sparkles` (star flare), `AE.trans` blur/flash; post events: flash-white 2f only at sticker macro + finale entry, dir blur only on whips/scroll, no grain, no rgb. Assets: 5 photos of one subject, 1 avatar crop, IG post DOM, chat DOM, logo/star PNG.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: there is no slam hero in this style; the sung words ARE the UI text. Each word gets exactly one diegetic event: caption char-typing, blue pill, chat pill, or one stacked scroll letter. Time them from `c.lyricWords()/lyricTimes()` in order; do not also overlay them as titles.
- UI labels: IG counts/time/handle and chat timestamps are fixed set dressing (Inter, small, set once). The blue pill word and grey chat words must be consecutive lyric words - never invent filler chat text during a vocal.
- Stickers/decorative: the centre logo sticker is brand chrome (safe always, it is not read as lyric). Pill-burst copies must repeat the current pill word only; decorative words elsewhere are unsafe - white space is this style's decoration.

## Techniques
- tag: type.stack_blocks + type.slide_bars
  what: each word on its own coloured label box (red/cyan/white/black), boxes wipe in (scaleX 0→1, 3 f) then text appears, slight random rotation ±3–8°, overlapped like stickers.
  build: div.label {background; padding; transform: rotate(var(--r))}; GSAP from {scaleX:0, transformOrigin:'left'} 0.1s power3.out, then text from {y:20, opacity:0}.
- tag: trans.zoom_out + trans.match_cut (shape continuity)
  what: whole title shrinks to a dot on black → hard-match to a huge yellow circle which pulls back to reveal it is the toggle knob.
  build: scale group 1→0.05 power3.in 0.25 s; next scene knob starts scale 6→1 power3.out.
- tag: new.ui_toggle (iOS-style switch as a lyric prop)
  what: switch flips Black→Yellow on the lyric; white iris wipe in between.
  build: CSS pill + knob, GSAP x of knob + background colour; trans.shape_iris = clip-path: circle(0%→150%) 4 f.
- tag: fx.speedlines (radial sunburst) + type.per_letter
  what: black wedge rays explode from centre on beat with sticker word whose letters drop in.
  build: SVG of 10 triangles rotating 15°/s; scale 0→1 0.15 s expo.out; letters stagger 0.06 s from {y:-40, rotation:random}.
- tag: trans.glitch / fx.glitch_blocks
  what: 12 frames of slice displacement turning the rays into grey blocky bars.
  build: post OpenCV: horizontal band shift (random 10–60 px) + grey posterize, or CSS clip-path slices.
- tag: new.ov_focus_brackets + cam.rack_focus
  what: camera autofocus corner brackets breathe around "Ready!!" while previous words are blurred in the background.
  build: 4 SVG corners animating inset; BG layer filter: blur(6px).
- tag: type.typewriter (incl. backspace) + type.scramble tracking-in
  what: tiny "// label" captions that swap with lyric, blink off for 2 f between, have a cursor "_", and delete words.
  build: text substring steps every 2 f; letter-spacing 1em→0 with opacity stagger for tracking-in.
- tag: type.word_slam with rotateX squash
  what: giant ASIK arrives from oversized & blurred, squashes flat in Y then pops upright.
  build: from {scale:1.4, filter:'blur(8px)'} then rotateX 70→0 0.2 s back.out.
- tag: fx.glow_bloom neon word (SAMA/SUKA) + ov.sparkle
  what: italic blue word with cyan outer glow and yellow 4-point star, typed letter-by-letter over black cards.
  build: text-shadow 0 0 8px #38b8ff, 0 0 20px #38b8ff; -webkit-text-stroke 1px #bff.
- tag: type.per_letter crossover (TAPI→NUNGGU→APA)
  what: letters of new word fly in from the side, starting grey/semi-transparent and landing black, while previous word's letters fly away; tiny streak lines.
  build: SplitText; in: from {x:-60, opacity:.3, color:'#888'} stagger .03; out: to {x:60,y:-30,opacity:0}.
- tag: ui.app_window (ChatGPT) + cam.orbit3d
  what: lyric typed as a ChatGPT prompt, response is a grid of placeholder images, whole UI tilts in 3D perspective.

- tag: ui.ig_post feed carousel (trans.card_slide), trans.whip, trans.flash_white, cam.pull

Assets: none photographic; DOM for feed + ChatGPT, sunburst/bracket SVGs, halftone dot CSS.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the giant slams (3D block, sticker, glow words) - one per kick via `AE.words(...,{style:"slam"})` or per-letter drop; maximum one hero + one label at any moment.
- UI labels: the tiny "//" captions are lyric sub-text, typed/backspaced at vocal speed (`AMV.type`, 2f/char); feed counts, prompt placeholder and window chrome are fixed, set once. Toggle side labels are single lyric words - time the flip to the word, not the beat grid alone.
- Stickers/decorative: label boxes behind heroes may repeat the current hero word at 40% size; question-mark cards and halftone dots are wordless decoration and safe anywhere. Never place a decorative word in the brk - its emptiness is what makes drop land.

## What makes it look premium
- Strictly typographic; contrast of scale (tiny UI vs huge word) every beat.
- Each scene uses a real, recognisable UI so type "feels typed", not animated.
- Black-white-black rhythm, accents limited to yellow + iOS blue.
## Song
"Gak Karuan" by RYO (unreleased). Typed text follows vocal phrases (2-4 words); loop-back to the first word at the end.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920, white #fcfcfc stage, ink #222222, accents yellow #f2b632, iOS blue #1a7cf5 / bubble grey #e9e9eb, black acts for contrast. Fonts: Anton (huge condensed), Syne 800 (wide word), Caveat Brush (marker), Yellowtail (script accent), Inter (UI). Soft shadows only; faint blue/white glass blobs bg in chat acts. Look `{glow:.25,glow_thr:.72,rgb:.5,vignette:.15,grain:.02,grade:"cool"}` - flat vector, glow almost off.
- Assets: NO photos required (pure type/UI); optional 2 photos for Contacts avatars. All screens = HTML (AI-chat sheet, iMessage, macOS window, Contacts, Notes, dialogs). Crop-mark corners + selection handles = CSS.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [appendWord]` - scribble burst morphs to glyphs (`AE.scramble` .6s), tiny line types, then the hero word APPENDS letter by letter huge (each letter slams, .07s), script accent overlays top-left at -12deg with a "!" pop.
  - `build: [aiChat, bboxType]` - aiChat: bottom sheet slides up, prompt pill types with caret, answer card appears with icon row and rolls up. bboxType: tall condensed lines type inside a thin tilted bounding box (-4 -> -7deg) with corner handles + micro meta labels.
  - `brk: [brushScatter]` - marker hero writes on a sunlit grey wall (diagonal shadow overlay) with drawn underline; black "?" cards slide in tilted with coloured edge pulse then desaturate; wide word blur-reveals per letter (blur 12->0 stagger .05) then letters EXPLODE outward around a "?" square. The explode resolving = break end.
  - `drop: [imessageNotes]` - iMessage thread: grey bubble types in, bg flips to black dark-mode, blue bubble replies, "seen" fades; smear out to black brush word with glow + cursor hand; macOS window slides in (perspective) typing a line, window flips rotY 180 mirrored and shrinks to corner.
  - `drop2: [contactsNotes]` - Contacts: search types a name (doubled-letter smear on one word), Action dialog drops with spring, Notes icon pops open; Notes editor: words slam one by one with zoomblur between, one word spins rotateX 360 with mirrored shadow and gets a yellow selection highlight + drag handles + Cut/Copy/Paste popover.
  - `outro: [loopWord]` - tiny line types, hero word inserts, phrase scales 2x with blur, returns to the INTRO word in its bounding box skewed -6deg (loop callback), greys out, white -> black.
- Seams/post: `seams:["flash","cut","whip","flip","glitch"]` (glitch once only). Post: zoomblur on word inserts, dirblur on smears, everything else is DOM motion - adding post grain/glow kills the flat look.
- Helpers: `AMV.type, AE.scramble, AE.maskReveal, AE.pop, AE.fx`; local bbox + selection-handle builders.

## Lyric/text system
- Everything typed is the lyric, but each app types it in its own voice: prompt pill = the phrase as a question/task, bubbles = the phrase as chat, Notes = the phrase as big slam words. Time all typing to `c.lyricTimes()` per character group (~.05s/char, faster on drops).
- Hero words: the appending giant word and Notes slams - one word at a time, sung at that instant. The bbox lines are the same phrase at poster scale; do not run bbox and a slam in the same scene.
- UI labels: timestamps, "seen", menubars, dialog buttons, meta labels in bbox corners are CFG micro-decor - static and small. Contact name typing is a CFG name, not a lyric word (the doubled-letter smear marks it as a name).
- Decorative text safe zones: crop-mark corners, marquee-free white margins, window title bars. Unsafe: the selection highlight must sit on the currently sung word in Notes (it is a lyric pointer); the brush wall line must be written, not typed - mixing voices in one scene breaks the system. Watermark: none.

## Techniques
- tag: type.handwritten (marker write-on in-scene)
  what: lyric word written onto the notebook page letter by letter like a pen (~4 frames per letter, slight jitter), text sits in the page's perspective (rotated ≈-8°, skewed) and is defocused with the page.
  build: SVG handwriting paths per letter, stroke-dashoffset per letter staggered 0.13 s; parent gets the page transform (rotate/skew via CSS 3D, perspective 900px) and same blur filter as the page.
- tag: type.typewriter (lyric subtitle) + reverse erase
  what: bottom lyric line in small white serif types char-by-char synced to the vocal (each syllable reveals its letters), holds, then erases right→left fast (≈2 frames/char) at phrase end. Constant through the whole video — the "karaoke" spine.
  build: split text into chars; gsap timeline of opacity 0→1 per char at vocal timestamps; reverse with stagger -0.06 s. Font Libre Caslon 500, letter-spacing .08em, text-shadow 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5).
- tag: new.ov.3d_glossy_icon_morph
  what: glossy candy-red 3D heart pops beside the eye (scale 0→1.1→1, 6 frames, back-out), then morphs into a glossy red 3D "X" on "salah" (≈12 frames) — symbol replaces word.
  build: two PNG/SVG icons with bevel (radial gradient highlight + inner shadow + drop shadow). Morph = heart scale .6 + rotate 45° + opacity→0 while X scales 0→1 rotate -20→0 with back.out(2). For a true morph use MorphSVG.
- tag: new.type.chalk_letters_scattered
  what: letters of "HATI" in cream chalk/crayon texture scattered around the face at different angles and sizes (H top-left, A top-right, T on cheek, I bottom-right), appearing with the word.
  build: each letter a separate element, rough font + SVG turbulence displacement filter for chalk edge; random rotate ±25°; pop in stagger 0.05.
- tag: new.fx.tint_flash (cut accent)
  what: on several hard cuts the first 2–3 frames are brighter with a purple/violet top glow, then settle to the grade.
  build: overlay div with linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(140,100,255,.5), transparent) + brightness(1.4) filter on stage; tween opacity 1→0 over 0.1 s at each cut.
- tag: new.trans.dark_rise_wipe
  what: phrase-ending transition: soft-edged black rises from the bottom over ~5 frames until the frame is gone; next scene is revealed by the black retracting downward from the top (or the new image wiping in from the top) and starts slightly overexposed.
  build: black div with a 60px gradient top edge; gsap yPercent 100→0 (0.17 s, power2.in), cut, then yPercent 0→100 on the new scene (0.2 s power2.out) + brightness 1.3→1.
- tag: trans.zoom_out / trans.zoom_through (TV frame)
  what: field image shrinks into a vintage TV/window bezel with leaves (scale 1.35→1, ≈0.4 s, ease out) to start the word "Waktu"; at 15.2 the camera pushes back through the screen (scale 1→1.6 with zoom blur, 0.5 s) to full-frame field.
  build: nested stage: TV frame PNG over the field layer; animate wrapper scale; post zoom blur on the push-through frames.
- tag: type.handwritten (white script on field)
  what: "Bodoh / Pada" then "Waktu" drawn in thin white signature script, stroke-by-stroke ≈1.5 s per word, large (≈30% frame width), soft glow.
  build: SVG path DrawSVG; filter drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.6)).
- tag: ph.frame_card (polaroid) + cam.orbit3d / cam.rack_focus
  what: clothesline of empty polaroids (black with "?"), lamp bokeh behind; camera tilts/pans in 3D, each shot starts very blurred and racks to sharp in ~0.5 s.
  build: polaroid divs in CSS 3D (preserve-3d) at different z, rotated ±10°; camera = perspective wrapper animating rotateX/rotateY ±8° and translate; blur on stage 12px→0.
- tag: new.ov.light_line_void
  what: black void with thin vertical white lines (1–3 px wide, 20–60% height, a few thicker 6 px rounded capsules) flickering and sliding vertically; a single polaroid tumbles in from the top (3D rotation, ~0.4 s, ease out) then drifts rotating slowly.
  build: 30 absolutely-positioned divs, random height/x, gsap repeat with random y/opacity flicker every 2–4 frames; polaroid gsap.from({y:-400, rotationX:60, rotationZ:-60, duration:.4, ease:"power3.out"}) then rotationZ yoyo ±5°.
- tag: new.ph.memory_duotone (recap)
  what: last 5 s re-plays earlier shots in fast cuts, all with heavy blur, posterized and mapped to olive-black → lavender → peach-cream, like a fading memory; ends with fade to black.
  build: CSS filter: blur(6px) grayscale(1) contrast(1.2) then SVG feComponentTransfer table mapping to the 3 colours (or OpenCV LUT post pass); fade stage opacity at 39.4.
- tag: fx.glow_bloom, cam.push (every shot slowly pushes 3–5%), fx.vignette (soft corners on field).

## What makes it look premium
- Each lyric phrase gets its own physical "set" (notebook, field painting, TV frame, clothesline) and the words live INSIDE that set (handwritten on the page, chalk letters on the face, script over the sky) instead of floating captions.
- Symbol substitution: heart → X on "salah" turns lyric meaning into an object.
- Continuous karaoke typewriter subtitle ties all scenes together.
- Restrained, slow camera + rack focus = cinematic; hard grade changes per world; black-void interludes give breathing room; duotone recap gives a narrative ending.

## Song
"suara asli - r_withmusic" (original sound; Indonesian ballad). Lyrics on screen: "kendati, kau ku suka / kita dua hati yang salah / bodoh pada waktu / itulah kenapa jatuh cinta dikatakan jatuh / karena s'bagaimana kita jatuh / kita tidak punya kuasa". Every word is typed in sync with the vocal; key words become visuals ("hati" → chalk HATI + heart, "salah" → red X, "bodoh pada waktu" → script, "jatuh" → falling polaroid in the void).
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920, four graded worlds: (1) notebook teal #3b4650 / crimson fg #5a0d14, (2) field gold #e8d84a / cream #f7f0d0, (3) clothesline amber #2a1a10 / lamp #e89a3a, (4) black void + white lines, recap duotone olive #2a2c22 -> lavender #8a90b8 -> peach #f3e0d0. Fonts: Gochi Hand (notebook), Mrs Saint Delafield (field script), Libre Caslon Text 500 (karaoke subtitle, letterspacing .08em). Look `{glow:.4,glow_thr:.65,rgb:.5,vignette:.3,grain:.03,grade:"warm"}` (grade swapped per world via scene bg, not post).
- Assets: 28+ photos, 1 glossy heart SVG + 1 glossy X SVG (radial highlight + drop shadow), chalk letters = text with SVG turbulence filter, TV frame PNG (or CSS bezel), rope/pegs = CSS. Polaroids are `.pol` cards; "?" empties for the clothesline.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [notebookEye]` - tilted page photo + notebook layer in one perspective wrapper (rotate -8deg); word writes per letter (~4f/letter, SVG paths or per-char mask) starting on the vocal; blurred crimson foreground shape at parallax k=2; bottom karaoke subtitle types in sync (see text system).
  - `build: [fieldScript, tvField]` - fieldScript: golden photo, white script writes stroke-by-stroke 1.5s top-left. tvField: the field shrinks into a TV bezel (scale 1.35->1, .4s) for one scene, then pushes THROUGH the screen (scale ->1.6 + zoomblur) back to full field.
  - `brk: [clotheslineCalm]` - blank "?" polaroids on rope, rack focus in (`AE.focus` / defocusIn .5s), slow drift, subtitle only. Ends with the dark-rise wipe: black soft-edge div yPercent 100->0 in 5 frames.
  - `drop: [voidFall, lineWide]` - voidFall: black, 30 thin white vertical lines flickering (random y/opacity every 2-4f), one polaroid tumbles in from top (rotX/rotZ, power3.out .4s) then slow-rotates - trigger on the "falling" word. lineWide: wide clothesline, push per kick.
  - `drop2: [heartX, lineClose]` - heartX: chalk letters of the key word scatter around a face photo (pop stagger .05, rotate +-25deg), glossy heart pops (back.out), and on the contrast word the heart morphs to the X (heart scale .6/rot45/fade while X scales in, 12 frames). 
  - `outro: [duotoneRecap]` - replay 6-8 earlier scene snapshots at .4-.8s each under `blur(6px) grayscale(1) contrast(1.2)` + an SVG feComponentTransfer 3-tone LUT div overlay; fade to black.
- Seams/post: `seams:["cut","blur","cut","zoom"]` + the dark-rise wipe as a manual brk seam. Post: `AE.fx("exposure",t,{amt:.35})` + violet gradient flash for 2-3 frames on hard cuts (the tint-flash), zoomblur only on the TV through-move. No glitch/rgb anywhere else.
- Helpers: `AE.maskReveal/writeOn` (write-ons), `AE.focus/defocusIn`, `AE.pop`, `AE.parallax`, `AMV.type` (subtitle), template `line` scene from scrapbook as the clothesline base.

## Lyric/text system
- Karaoke spine: a small serif subtitle at bottom-centre types char-by-char WITH the vocal for the WHOLE film and erases right-to-left at phrase ends (`AMV.type` + reverse stagger). This is the only literal lyric line - keep it <=6 words, 40-48px, shadowed, in the bottom safe band (y 1620-1760).
- Hero words: the in-world writing (notebook word, field script) mirrors the CURRENT subtitle phrase only, larger and slower; it starts when the subtitle starts. Never write a word the subtitle is not currently saying.
- Symbol substitution: heart/X and chalk letters replace ONE key word per drop - they carry meaning, not text, so the word itself stays only in the subtitle. Safe because the subtitle still tells the viewer the word.
- UI labels: watermark top-centre 40% is the only label. Decorative text safe zones: notebook page margins, sky area of the field, void (subtitle only). Unsafe: subtitles over the clothesline lamps (busy) - add a soft dark gradient behind the subtitle band in amber scenes.

type is always written on a surface (pill, page, sky) never floating. - Slow 5–7 s acts contrast with per-beat typing/sticker pops inside them. ## Build recipe (58s) - Port (4:3 ref → 1080x1920 9:16): keep the *room* logic, restage vertically — phone-on-desk becomes a tilted phone card centre-stage (lock screen tall), notebook page becomes a full-height lined sheet, filmstrip runs vertical (native in ref), sky/space becomes a tall sticker field. New template or scrapbook extension: `scrapbook` + `AE.film` roles below. Seam list: `["blur","zoom","whip","flash","zoomout","glitch"]`; chapter changes that were light leaks are `AE.trans(...,"blur")` + post `flash`/`exposure` events (fxpost has no leak — fake it with an orange radial `.burn` div, mix-blend screen, + `AE.fx("flash",K,{amt:.6})` + `AE.fx("exposure",K,{amt:.3})`). - `intro: [lockDesk, notebookCover]` — lockDesk: desk photo bg (`P(0)` blurred, handheld), phone frame rotate -6° centre, big time text, 2 notification pills stack; pill name = CFG.title (artist), preview = `AMV.type` of the *current vocal fragment* only if `CFG.lyrics` verified, else a neutral "new memory ✿" label. notebookCover: checker notebook card slides in `AE.stack(...,{from:"side"})` rotate -4°, `AE.pop` sticker. - `build: [notePage1, filmstrip, skyType]` — notePage1: lined sheet (repeating-linear-gradient), polaroid `P(j)` slides in `AE.stack`, handwritten line via `AE.maskReveal`/`AMV.type` in Caveat on the *next* lyric fragment (`ctx.W(j)` / `ctx.lyricWords()`), stamp `AE.pop`. filmstrip: black strip, sprocket dots via radial-gradient, `P(j)` frames, GSAP y loop + `AE.sparkles`. skyType: cyan glow typed line (vocal fragment), paper-plane cursor = `AE.pop` + GSAP arc (MotionPath not loaded — keyframe x/y pairs), stickers `AE.stickerCSS`. - `brk: [spaceType]` — dark starfield, silver caps fragment `AE.words(...,{style:"rise"})`, moon/rocket stickers; freeze last 0.8s (no velo cam — engine already hands calm scenes handheld), leak-bloom out. - `drop: [flatlay, notePage1, filmstrip]` — flatlay: 3 polaroids `AE.fan` over desk props, `AE.fx("glow",kick)` per kick via engine snare accents; reuse notePage1/filmstrip with `photoStep` offset so faces rotate. - `drop2: [notePage2, skyType, flatlay]` — notePage2 = notePage1 variant: second polaroid first, two short lines, red leak pulse (`exposure` event) on final kick of scene. drop2 gets engine velo cam ×1.1 automatically. - `outro: [thanksCard]` — dark teal #0e2a2e card, small white 2-line text (song title + artist only), burn pulses L/R, engine fade handles exit. - Palette: desk #b07a4f, paper #f4f1ea, lined blue #9db8d9 / margin #e88, sky #37b6e8, leak orange #ff8c3a→#ffd23a, stamp red #d23b2e. Fonts: Caveat (hand), Anton (stamp word), Inter (phone UI). `AE.base({glow:.18,glow_thr:.7,rgb:.6,vignette:.35,grain:.03,grade:"warm"})`. - Post FX events: `flash`+`exposure` at every room change (on the kick, via seam type "flash"/"blur"), `glow` on sticker pops in drop, constant grain/vignette. No shake except engine `AE.drop` at real drops. - Assets: 30+ photos (same face set recycled — continuity is the point), 2-3 cutouts optional (not used in ref; skip), desk/notebook/sky are CSS/photo bg plates (1 desk flat-lay photo or CSS wood gradient), sticker PNGs (moon, rocket, gamepad, camera stamp) or emoji spans with `AE.stickerCSS`. ## Lyric/text system - Hero words: **none floating** — the vocal line is *written on surfaces*: notification preview (phone), handwritten line on the notebook page, glowing line in sky, silver caps in space. Feed all from `CFG.lyrics=[[t,"word"],...]` via `ctx.lyricWords(4)` / `ctx.W(j)`; type with `AMV.type` at ~0.06s/char, phrase (2-4 words) must *finish* on a kick — start it `len*0.06` before the target kick. - UI labels (safe anywhere, not lyric): clock time, sender name (= artist name), "Notebook / name / subject" notebook fields, filmstrip frame numbers, "Thank you" outro. These can be static or typed for texture. - Stickers/decorative: ransom-letter sticker, stamps, plane/moon/rocket — wordless or 1 neutral word ("memories"). Never put invented words in Caveat on the page — viewers read handwriting as lyric. If lyrics unverified: page lines = song title split across pages, or leave page blank with polaroids only. ## Song Original sound by the uploader (couple/"memories" theme, Indonesian vocal). Text follows the vocal line-by-line; only 2–3 words are ever legible per moment. Beat ~102 BPM; leak crests and sticker pops sit on beats, cuts themselves are rare.

# t17 — Lyric-scroll intro + macOS desktop collage + B&W mirror recap (preset "Mistletoe", Alight Motion)  (16.8 s, 960x720 4:3, 30 fps, ~100 BPM est. (beat 0.6 s), ~35 scenes, avg 0.45 s early / 1.0 s mid, 2.1 cuts/s peak)
## Look
- Act A (0.1–2.5): deep red gradient (#4a0a0f -> #8f1a1f), tiny player bar at bottom, lyric in Helvetica/Inter Black white.
- Act B (2.5–10.6): saturated photo clips + a green locker scene (teal #1f6b5c) with pink heart stickers; macOS desktop over Spider-Man wallpaper (red/brown), white macOS windows, blue Finder folders, dock.
- Act C (10.7–12.6): black card, bold wide black-on-white type "under the mistletoe", tilted photo cards in black frames.
- Act D (12.7–16.8): same as A but black/grey (monochrome), then B&W replay of act B scenes fading to black. Grain none; slight blur on out-of-focus lyric lines.
- Fonts: Inter/Helvetica Black (lyrics), Dela Gothic / Archivo Black expanded for "under the mistletoe", Playfair Italic for the macOS quote card "Shawty with you!" (Times/Playfair Display italic, big opening quote mark).
## Timeline
0.0 | black | | | |
0.1–2.5 | lyric scroll: 3 lines visible, the sung line huge (~38% frame height), line above small 40% opacity, line below blurred 4 px; words appear one by one as the first letter of each word pops at 15 px offset ("B u t" letters rise + fade 3 frames) | vertical scroll up 80 px per line + scale 0.8->1 | fade from black | type.lyric_word_sync, per-letter rise | red gradient
2.5–3.0 | cut: girl pointing finger at camera, blurred first frame then sharpens (rack focus 2 frames) | | hard_cut | | 
3.0–3.9 | model in leather jacket standing, flanked by red side bars (pillar bars slide in from edges 40 px) | | hard_cut | |
3.9–5.6 | locker scene: green lockers, polaroid pinned, white card, bunny/skull stickers, pink hearts; slow push 5% ; at 4.3–4.4 glitch: block-pixel blur 2 frames; at 4.5 tiny handwriting "Shawty..." card appears ; | cam.push | glitch | | 
5.6–6.5 | match-cut zoom: closeup of a pinned polaroid with cat sticker, entering via blur 3 frames; sharpens ; paper curls | cam.push 8% | trans.crossblur | |
6.6–7.5 | whole locker image becomes a small macOS window (rounded, traffic lights) on Spider-Man wallpaper, finder sidebar right, dock bottom | window scales 1 -> 0.35 around centre in 0.25 s, ease-out | trans.zoom_out (UI frame) | ui.app_window |
7.5–8.2 | white quote card appears bottom-centre: opening quote mark, serif italic "Shawty with you!" types by letter (5 chars/0.1 s) | | | type.typewriter | ov. dock icons bounce
8.2–10.4 | desktop live: 4–5 windows (finder folders, photo window with record button, quote card, locker window) drag/slide around with motion blur (3 frames dir_blur) ; one window flips; Dock magnifies | window drags 150–300 px, 0.25 s power3.out | whip (window slide) | ui.app_window + ui.cursor | fx.dir_blur

12.0–12.7 | 3 tilted frames stacked (girl portrait, close-ups), each 0.2 s ; blur at 12.5 | | | ph.grid_multi |
12.7–14.4 | monochrome lyric scroll again on black (same animation as 0.1–2.5), now each new line starts with a brighter white flash | | | type.lyric_word_sync | desaturated
14.4–15.0 | mono cut to finger-point clip, then standing model | | hard_cut | | ph.bw_high_contrast
15.0–16.1 | locker scene B&W, fades to near-black ; pushes 4% | cam.push | fade | | vignette
16.1–16.8 | fade to black; | | | | 
## Techniques
- tag: type.lyric_word_sync (Spotify-style)
  what: stacked lyric lines, active one is ~2.5x bigger and bright, neighbours dimmed + blurred; each word's first letter drops in 15 px with 40 ms stagger; line scrolls up 80 px as sung.
  build: container translateY tween per line (0.25 s power2.out); active line scale 1; others opacity .35 + filter blur(3px); words as spans gsap.from y:15 opacity 0 stagger .04.
- tag: ui.app_window — mac window (rounded 10 px, shadow 0 20px 60px #0006, 3 traffic-light dots), sizes 20–45% of frame, content = scene image; Dock with 12 icons bottom (magnify on hover not needed).
- tag: new.ui.desktop_collage — scene shrinks into a window on a busy wallpaper; windows get dragged with cursor + dir_blur; text card is another window.
- tag: type.typewriter — Playfair italic with big quote glyph, per-letter 0.05 s.
- tag: trans.crossblur / trans.zoom_out — scene scale 1->0.35 into window frame in 6 frames.
- tag: ph.frame_card — tilted photo in black frame; vertical film-strip scroll.
- tag: new.recap_desaturate — second half replays the opening in B&W (saturate 0) to give structure from a few assets.
- tag: ov.hearts (pink hearts) / ov.sticker (bunny skull) pinned to locker; cam.push.
## What makes it look premium
- The lyric scroll is a real UI-grade animation (focus + blur + scroll) rather than kinetic noise.
- macOS metaphors make the "slideshow" feel like a person's screen.
- Colour -> mono callback in the last quarter.
## Song
original sound (naastar); the track is a seasonal pop song (preset named "Mistletoe"); lyric lines are word-synced to vocals (not transcribed here); hard cuts ~every 0.6 s on beat in act B.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920. Acts: lyric red gradient #4a0a0f->#8f1a1f; saturated photo acts + locker teal #1f6b5c; desktop over a busy wallpaper photo; black card act; mono replay. Fonts: Inter 900 (lyrics), Archivo Black expanded (black-card slam), Playfair Display italic (quote card). Look `{glow:.35,glow_thr:.68,rgb:.6,vignette:.25,grain:.03,grade:"cool"}`; mono acts = scene-level `saturate(0)`.
- Assets: 20+ photos, locker scene = one composed photo collage (photo + polaroid + stickers as layers), macOS desktop = HTML (wallpaper photo, windows with traffic-light dots, dock of icon dots). Cutouts 0. The SAME locker/hero photos must return in the mono replay - reuse scene snapshots (clone the scene div, add B/W class).
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [lyricScroll]` - 3-line scroll on red: active line huge (~38% frame height), above 40% opacity, below blur 4px; words enter with first-letter pop (y 15, fade, stagger .04); container scrolls up per phrase. Player bar bottom.
  - `build: [photoActs, locker]` - photoActs: hard-cut portraits, red side bars slide in, rack focus 2f. locker: composed scene push 5%, heart/sticker pops, one 2f block-glitch, tiny handwriting card appears.
  - `brk: [desktopShrink]` - the locker image scales 1->.35 into a macOS window on the wallpaper (zoom-out seam, 6f); quote card types below (Playfair italic, per letter .05s); windows then drag 150-300px with dirblur, dock dots bounce. The shrink is the break's reveal - hold the desktop 1 beat before dragging.
  - `drop: [desktopDrag, blackCard]` - desktopDrag continues (window flips, cursor drags); blackCard: black, expanded words slam per word with 1f jitter, tilted photo cards in black frames stack, film-strip scrolls vertically with perspective skew.
  - `drop2: [monoReplay]` - lyricScroll + photoActs + locker REPLAYED in B/W (clone builders with a mono flag), each new lyric line entry gets a brighter white flash (`AE.fx("flash",t,{amt:.4,dur:.15})`).
  - `outro: [monoFade]` - mono locker push 4%, vignette closes, fade to black.
- Seams/post: `seams:["cut","blur","zoom","flash","cut"]`. Post: zoomblur on the desktop exit, dirblur on window drags, no glitch except the single locker block-glitch (`AE.fx("glitch",t,{dur:.12})`).
- Helpers: `AE.words, AMV.type, AE.pop, AE.fx`; local lyric-scroll + desktop builders. Implement replay by calling the same builder with `{mono:true}` - do not duplicate code.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero lines: the scroll's active line is the lyric, word-synced; its scale (2.5x neighbours) is the hierarchy. In photo acts there are NO lyrics on screen - the contrast is intentional.
- Quote card: the serif italic card on the desktop is a CFG quote (3-4 words), typed like a note. It must not be a sung line - it reads as the person's own note.
- UI labels: window titles, dock, player bar are CFG decor. The black-card slam words ARE a sung phrase (expanded black on white card inverted: white bg/black text in source - keep high contrast), one word per vocal hit.
- Decorative text safe zones: desktop wallpaper margins, locker handwriting card (CFG, tiny), film-strip borders. Unsafe: mono replay must show the SAME words as the colour pass (it is an echo, not new lyrics); no text during window drags except the dragged window's own title bar.

# t02 — "Ekspektasi" perspective-warped meme photo + blue label loop, with dark IG-feed interlude   (16.0 s, 952x720 ~4:3, 30 fps, rea 112 BPM (autocorr hints 130), 14 shots, avg 1.1 s, 0.9 cuts/s; structure = intro 0–1 / act A 1.1–4.5 / IG feed 4.6–9.5 / act A repeat 9.6–13.0 / lava-cat outro 13.1–16)
STYLE-KEY: Warped-quad label loop
CLOSEST-EXISTING: scrapbook
NOVELTY: photos are perspective-skewed quads that wobble in 3D while a blue label bar orbits them; plus a fake Instagram feed (search bar typing, 3D-tilted post cards, carousel dots, scroll-away) – scrapbook has neither.
## Look

- Act A: pure white bg, 4-point yellow sparkle sticker (#f7e66a), photos with hard edges, sky-blue label #29a9f1 with white Arial-Bold-like "hoo -" text, tilted -6°..+8°.

- Top-left badge (pause circle + "Ekspektasi - Ocan Siagian / @jarfvy") from 1.2 s on, absent in dark intro/outro tail.
- Fonts: Playfair-like lowercase serif "wadaw" (intro, letter-spaced), Arial/Inter Bold for label, Instagram-style SF for UI.
## Timeline
0.0–0.3 | black | | | | | | 
0.3–1.0 | serif "wadaw" appears tiny at centre, then 3 stacked copies: crisp small centre + 2 translucent giant copies (scale 2.2x, opacity .25) widening left/right, bg lightens to grey with specks | slow cam.push | – | type.repeat_echo + fx.vignette | – | fx.film_grain (dust) | 0.4, 0.8

6.6–7.2 | carousel swipe: photo slides left to next (white cat in yellow suit), dots update 3 dots | – | trans.card_slide | – | – | fx.dir_blur | –

## Techniques
- tag: ph.frame_card (new.warp_quad_photo)
  what: photo is a 4-corner perspective quad; corners animate independently so it looks like a card swinging in space (0.2–0.5 s ease-out), 10–15% horizontal taper.
  build: CSS 3D (perspective:700px; rotateY(±20deg) rotateZ(-6deg)) or OpenCV warpPerspective with animated corner points; do in post pass for crisp edges.
- tag: new.label_orbit
  what: bold blue label ("hoo -") scales up past the photo then re-enters at the opposite corner; tilt flips sign each time (-6°/+6°).
  build: GSAP timeline per beat: set x/y/scale/rotation with ease expo.out, 0.5 s per hop.
- tag: ui.ig_story (feed)
  what: dark IG post: header avatar+music line, square photo, likes/comments/share row, caption, "1 jam yang lalu"; whole card tilted 3–5° and pushed in.
  build: HTML card with perspective transform + slow scale; scroll = translateY with motion blur filter.
- tag: type.typewriter in search bar (rounded dark bar with magnifier, blur bokeh circles behind)
- tag: fx.light_leak
  what: warm orange gradient sweeps in over 0.3 s then whites out; hides cut to IG card.
  build: radial gradient layer, mix-blend-mode: screen, opacity 0→1→0.
- tag: trans.shape_iris
  what: black circle blur-edged collapses to a dot revealing white.
- tag: new.loop_repeat – act A reused verbatim (9.6–13.0) to pad length.
## What makes it look premium
Hard white scenes alternate with a moody dark feed, so contrast resets the eye; label/photo hop each half-beat; light leak + tilt on the IG card sells realism; repetition makes the loop feel intentional.
## Song
"Ekspektasi - Okin ft. Ocan Siagian" (shown in IG header). ~112 BPM per rea (31% cuts on beat). Intro "wadaw" is the spoken drop; label hops follow the vocal ad-lib "hoo".
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920. Palettes: intro charcoal #0c0d10, act A pure white + label blue #29a9f1 + sparkle yellow #f7e66a, IG dark #14100f with warm leak #c0503a, outro dark #0c0f13 + lava orange. Fonts: Playfair Display (intro serif), Inter 800 (label), Inter (IG UI). Badge top-left (title/handle chips) in white acts only. Look `{glow:.3,glow_thr:.7,rgb:.6,vignette:.3,grain:.04,grade:"cool"}`.
- Assets: 20+ photos (they get perspective-warped - straight-on shots warp best), IG UI = HTML replica (header, likes row, dots), lava texture = CSS pixel gradient or one photo. Cutouts 0.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [echoSerif]` - tiny serif word centre + 2 giant translucent copies (scale 2.2, opacity .25) widening; dust specks; black iris collapses to a dot revealing white.
  - `build: [quadLabel]` - photo as animated perspective quad (perspective 700px, rotateY +-20deg/rotateZ -6, corners feel independent), yellow sparkle pops, blue label bar slams in at 120% width tilted -6deg; label hops corner-to-corner every half-beat (x/y/rot sign flips, expo.out .5s), photo wobbles +-4deg.
  - `brk: [igSearch]` - dark IG: search pill types char-by-char (`AMV.type`, caret), bokeh dots behind; warm leak sweeps to white. This search is the break - keep it ~3s.
  - `drop: [igFeed]` - IG post card tilted -4deg, photo swaps per kick (card_slide + dirblur), carousel dots update, card scrolls up (vertical dirblur) to the next post, push into the photo 20% by scene end.
  - `drop2: [quadLabel]` - act A verbatim with new photos/words (the loop is the point), label orbit faster (every kick).
  - `outro: [lavaFloat]` - dark: textured photo zooms OUT from full-bleed blur to a small tilted square, floats +-3deg, pink tint pulses on kicks (`AE.fx("exposure",t,{amt:.25})` tinted overlay), shrinks to a dot.
- Seams/post: `seams:["iris","cut","flash","whip","cut"]`; zoom-through into the cup/detail photo at the build->brk seam (zoomblur .45). Post: light-leak is a screen-blend radial div (not a post event) - animate opacity 0->1->0 over .3s; dirblur on carousel swaps.
- Helpers: `AMV.type, AE.pop, AE.fx`, local warp-quad (CSS 3D) + label-orbit timeline.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the blue label is the hero carrier - it holds ONE sung fragment (1-2 words) at a time, white bold on #29a9f1, and the hop lands on the vocal. The label's motion, not the word change, marks the beat when the same fragment repeats.
- Intro serif: a single spoken/hook word with echo copies - decorative echoes must be the SAME word (translucent giants), never different words.
- UI labels: IG search text is typed as if searching the song's hook (CFG, 2-3 words); captions/like counts/usernames are micro-decor that must stay plausible-UI small. The caption line under a post may carry the current sung fragment ONLY if it is <=3 words and changes on the phrase, otherwise keep CFG caption.
- Decorative text safe zones: badge chips, carousel dots area, outro (no text except badge off). Unsafe: text over the warped photo's face - the label must orbit AROUND the quad, overlapping edges only; no hero text during the leak flash.

# q06 — "mirrors" Instagram-story/ UI-card kinetic-lyric loop (Alight Motion preset)  (14.9s, 720x902 portrait, 30fps, 140 BPM, 8 shots, ~0.55 cuts/s)
## Look
- Phone-screen UI chrome kept on all frames (status bar "AT&T 2:30 PM", timecode top-left, "mirrors" label top-right, home-indicator bar bottom): the whole video is a fake screen recording.
- Palette changes per scene: charcoal black + grey type; white flash scenes (IG logo); orange radial-glow (emoji); hot crimson/pink sunburst (photo scene); grey blurred "music-player lyrics" scene; plain white end card "jepaw vortek" (small Roboto-like text).
