- No grain; clean vector flats, heavy motion blur on movers.
## Timeline
0.00–2.77 | black UI scene: huge grey caps words ("CAUSE / LET / YOU") motion-blur slam in behind; white speech bubble falls in rotated, lands on IG-story avatar ring (cat photo, gradient ring, "jepaw" name) | bubble drops from top w/ dir-blur + rotate, settles with overshoot | grey concentric rings expand (0.7–1.2s) | bubble text swaps to "cause let you" typed | beats @0.53/1.03/1.53 (every 15f = 1 beat @ ~120-140)
2.0–2.7 | scene re-types: BG word switches to "KNOW" repeated 3x (top blurred, middle sharp, bottom mirrored/flipped), bubble text "know."

## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920. Two worlds: white player chrome (periwinkle extrude #8fa3db, navy band #12284a, orange script #f0a030, sky UI #3aa0e8) and near-black iOS (#0b0b10, green toggle #34c759, frame blue #6b7cff). Look `{glow:.35,glow_thr:.68,rgb:.6,vignette:.22,grain:.02,grade:"cool"}`.
- Assets: 25+ photos, 1 cat/party sticker PNG (the recap anchor - any CFG mascot sticker), emoji row = text. Blob card = photo in animated border-radius squircle over its own blurred copy - no special asset.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [spinWord, bandScript]` - spinWord: `AE.word3d` hero spins rotY 180->0 while shrinking to 50%, second copy stacks below offset .15s. bandScript: navy band wipes in (mask), script hero mask-reveals L->R with a pen dot; group scales +8%; exit rotY to a sliver.
  - `build: [polaroidQ, islandType]` - polaroidQ: black "?" polaroid swings in rotY/rotZ, small sky line at right + big blurred ghost copy bottom-left scaling 1->1.15 (echo). islandType: dark Dynamic-Island scene, cat avatar circle, grey pill types above it (`AMV.type`), icon buttons below, slow scale to 1.1.
  - `brk: [alarms]` - iOS Alarms list: rows with time + tiny sublabel, scroll up with rotateX -20 perspective and motion blur, end macro-zoom into a green toggle (zoomblur). Functional calm = break.
  - `drop: [blobCards]` - photo pops as blob card (scale .2->1.05->1 spring) on its blurred backdrop, swaps every ~.7s/kick with 2-frame blur slide, card radius morphs between swaps; caption + emoji under card; radial tick burst once per scene.
  - `drop2: [recapSticker]` - mascot sticker fixed bottom-centre bobbing while the BACKGROUND replays earlier scenes at speed (hard cuts + 2f blur); then a .1-.2s blurred strobe recap.
  - `outro: [alarmFade]` - alarms scene returns blurred, fades to black over 1.5s, waveform stops.
- Seams/post: `seams:["flip","iris","zoom","blur","flash"]`. Post: zoomblur on the "22"-style number/word pop and toggle macro (`AE.fx("zoomblur",t,{amt:.45})`), dirblur on blob swaps, glow on script only. Waveform is canvas bars driven by a sine/noise envelope.
- Helpers: `AE.word3d, AE.flipCard, AE.pop, AMV.type, AE.fx`; local blob-card + player chrome.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the spinning extruded word and the script word - both carry the sung hook word of the phrase, timed to vocal onsets, one at a time. The script is written, not typed: start it on the phrase start so it completes on the last syllable.
- Small lines: sky-blue small text beside the polaroid (and its blurred ghost) is a lyric fragment at reading size - the ghost copy is decorative echo and must repeat the SAME fragment, blurred 8px+, never a different line.
- UI labels: alarm sublabels, player header and IG-style counts are plausible-UI decor from CFG; keep them 1-3 words and static within a scene. A caption under a blob card may be the CFG hook (<=3 words) - not a rotating lyric.
- Stickers: the recap mascot carries no text except a ransom-letter CFG title on its own card. Decorative text safe zones: header/waveform bands, alarm rows, polaroid white border. Unsafe: lyric text on the dark island pill must be typed like a notification (short), and no text during the toggle macro zoom.

STYLE-KEY: polaroid-story-chat-loop
CLOSEST-EXISTING: scrapbook
NOVELTY: one green cutting-mat desk with 3 polaroids + a sticky note is shot inside a fake IG-story editor, then literally sent as a chat photo in a dark messenger; the same desk is re-typed with a new sticky note each loop cycle, interleaved with a hanging-photo library wall and a 3x3 contact-sheet grid that warp-pulses on the beat.

(21.7 s, 720x720 1:1, 24 fps, ~100 BPM est. beat ~0.60 s, 6 long shots, ~0.28 cuts/s; structure = cycle A story+chat 0–~7, library wall ~7–10.5, grid warp ~10.5–13, cycle A′ 13–21.7 loop)

## Look
- Palette: dark teal-green cutting mat #1E4D46 with white grid, warm white polaroid borders, navy-black messenger UI #0B0B1A, purple-blue chat bubbles #6C6CE5, desaturated brown library shelves.
- Grade: muted, slightly faded film look on photos (lifted blacks), desk scene soft top light + vignette; grid portraits keep colour hero in centre, greyscale clones around.
- Fonts: sticky note = clean humanist sans (Inter/Poppins Light) 4 short lines left-aligned; chat = system sans white on purple; album labels = SF-like "Recents / My Honest" small caps.
- Texture: mat grid, polaroid drop shadows, slight blur/ghost on grid clones, creator chibi watermark top-left on black acts.

## Timeline

1.0–4.6 | IG-story editor replica: green cutting mat fills frame, 3 polaroids scattered rotated -8°/+5°/+12°, sticky note centre types its 4-line message per character; story chrome top (Aa, stickers) and bottom ("Your story / Close Friends" + send arrow); slight handheld drift | cam.handheld_shake tiny + push 2% | hard cut | type.typewriter on sticky note (0.05 s/char) | ui.ig_story chrome, ph.frame_card polaroids | soft vignette | typing = vocal line
4.6–6.2 | story shrinks into a chat thumbnail inside dark messenger; purple bubbles send one by one right side below it (3 short bubbles), "Seen just now" appears | cam.pull (story→thumbnail) | trans.zoom_out into ui.chat | ui.chat bubbles pop | — | — | bubble per beat
6.2–7.0 | bubbles glitch-smear horizontally and whip away | — | trans.glitch + trans.whip (4f) | — | — | fx.glitch_blocks, fx.dir_blur | —
7.0–10.3 | library wall: bookshelf photo bg; polaroid-style portraits hang from top clips, a horizontal filmstrip of 5–6 portraits pans left continuously; foreground portrait swaps (chin-rest → hair-touch → glasses B/W) growing larger each swap | cam.pan left on strip + push on hero | hard cut | — | ph.frame_card hanging prints | fx.motion_blur on pan | swap per 2 beats
10.3–13.0 | black bg: 3x3 contact-sheet grid assembles tile by tile (white placeholder squares fill), centre tile colour hero, surrounding tiles greyscale clones at 60% opacity + blur 2px; whole grid does 2 warp pulses (scale/skew bulge) then tiles scatter slightly | grid pulse | tiles pop stagger 0.06 s | — | ph.grid_multi | fx.wave_warp pulse | pulse on beat

## Techniques
- tag: new.polaroid_desk_story
  what: a cutting-mat desk with 3 rotated polaroids is framed inside IG-story editor chrome; the lyric lives on a paper sticky note typed per character on top of the pile.
  build: mat = CSS repeating-linear-gradient grid on #1E4D46; polaroid = white padding card + shadow, GSAP scatter rotation; note = cream card, TextPlugin char stagger 0.05 s; story chrome = absolute HTML top/bottom bars.
- tag: new.story_to_chat_shrink
  what: the whole story scene scales down into a rounded chat thumbnail inside a messenger, then lyric continues as purple bubbles — the edit "sends" its own previous scene.
  build: wrap scene in container, GSAP scale 1→0.42 + border-radius 18px + y into chat column .6s expo.inOut; bubbles pop after landing.
- tag: ui.chat (dark messenger)
  what: navy bg, right purple bubbles (radius 16px) pop stagger ~0.35 s, input bar with mic/image/sticker icons fixed bottom, "Seen just now" microcopy fades in.
  build: HTML replica; bubbles GSAP from scale .8 opacity 0 back.out.
- tag: ph.grid_multi (contact-sheet warp)
  what: 3x3 grid of the same portrait set; centre colour/sharp, clones grey+blurred; grid bulges twice (perspective warp) on beats, tiles pop in staggered with white placeholder flashes.
  build: CSS grid of imgs, filter grayscale(1) blur(2px) opacity .6 on clones; GSAP scale 1→1.06 skewX ±3° pulse; post fx.wave_warp for the bulge frames.
- tag: new.hanging_library_wall
  what: bookshelf backdrop, portraits as clipped prints hanging at top, plus a mid-frame filmstrip that pans left while hero portrait swaps and grows.
  build: bg img + print cards with clip pseudo-element; strip = flex row GSAP x linear repeat; hero swaps via crossfade + scale step +6% each.
- tag: trans.glitch (bubble smear exit)
  what: chat bubbles stretch horizontally into white streaks and whip off — exit for the chat act.
  build: GSAP scaleX 1→3 + opacity, or post glitch_blocks slices 4 frames + dir_blur.

## What makes it look premium
- A single physical desk setup is recontextualised by UI (story → chat → albums), so repetition feels like a story being posted, sent, and saved.
- Restrained palette + faded photo grade keeps it melancholic vs. the usual saturated AMV.
- Grid warp pulse and hanging-print wall give chorus-scale motion without leaving the photo-album concept; loop is invisible.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Port: extend `scrapbook` with `polaroidDeskStory`, `storyToChat`, `hangingWall`, `gridWarp` scenes. Ref loops A/A′ in 21.7s; at 58s do A (intro/build), wall+grid (drop), A′ (drop2, new note text/photos), outro = grid warp held + fade. Seams: `["zoom","blur","glitch","whip"]`; story→chat is an in-scene shrink, not a seam.
- `intro: [polaroidDeskStory]` — cutting mat (#1e4d46, CSS grid lines), 3 polaroids scatter rotate -8/+5/+12 (`AE.stack`), sticky note centre; story chrome top/bottom (Aa, Your Story/Close Friends pills). Handheld via engine + push 2%.
- `build: [storyToChat, hangingWall]` — storyToChat: whole desk comp scales 1→0.42 into a rounded chat thumbnail inside dark messenger (#0b0b1a), purple bubbles (#6c6ce5) pop below, "Seen just now" fades. hangingWall: bookshelf bg, prints hang from clips top, filmstrip of 5-6 portraits pans left, hero portrait swaps growing +6% per swap.
- `brk: [gridWarp]` — 3x3 grid assembles tile by tile (white placeholder flashes), centre colour hero, clones grayscale+blur; 2 warp pulses on kicks (`AE.fx("wave",K,{amt:6})`). The pulse *is* the break hit; keep tiles otherwise still.
- `drop: [polaroidDeskStory, storyToChat, hangingWall]` — second cycle, sticky note carries next fragment, polaroids re-scatter with new photos.
- `drop2: [gridWarp, albumsList, polaroidDeskStory]` — albumsList: iOS Photos Albums rows ("Recents" + album named after song title), grid thumbnail enlarges, pan right; then desk returns.
- `outro: [gridWarp]` — grid re-assembles, final warp pulse, fade (loops conceptually).
- Palette: mat #1e4d46, polaroid white, messenger #0b0b1a, bubble #6c6ce5, library brown. Fonts: Inter/Poppins Light (sticky note), Inter (chat/albums). `AE.base({glow:.12,rgb:.5,vignette:.38,grain:.025})` + photos lifted blacks (CSS filter brightness/contrast tweak).
- Post FX events: `wave` on grid pulses, `glitch`+`dirblur` on bubble smear exit, engine drops; no flash spam — ref is muted.
- Assets: 20+ photos (3 desk polaroids + strip of 6 + grid set of 9 — can reuse crops), bookshelf bg photo or CSS shelves, chibi watermark optional (use artist avatar).

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the sticky note is the hero — 3-4 short lines typed per char (0.05s) synced so the note *completes* as the vocal phrase ends. Feed from `CFG.lyrics` grouped into note-sized chunks via `ctx.lyricWords()`. Second cycle note = next chunk. Never write a "dear diary" invention on the note.
- UI labels: story chrome ("Your story", "Close Friends"), "Seen just now", album names (song title as album name is safe + diegetic), chat input icons. Chat bubbles = reply fragments of the lyric (call/response split of one line across note→bubbles works well).
- Stickers/decorative: chibi watermark (artist avatar, wordless), clips/tape on prints. Grid tiles and hanging prints carry no text — photos only, so decorative freedom there is total.
- Safe rule for this template: any handwriting-font or note-surface text = lyric; anything in system font inside chrome = label.

## Song
"a little more honest" — Joon (original sound via @zalfndk). Sticky-note typing carries the verse line, chat bubbles the reply line; grid pulses on chorus beats.

## What makes it look premium
A consistent 3-color system, perspective text on a ground plane, staggered everything (0.3s grid), no static frame longer than ~1s, cheap-looking-to-expensive via paper cream background + poster photos + hairline details.
## Song
Original sound, 92 BPM F major; SFX: click 5.3s, pop 6.6s (on "POSE"-like text pop), click 7.2s. Lyric fragments are the on-screen words (COMIN' FROM THE WEST SIDE, WOH/UH/OH).

## Build recipe (58s)
- Build canvas only (ignore monitor framing). Canvas 1080x1080. Palette: cream `#F3EEE2`, magenta `#FF2E93`, plum `#3A1F46`, black. Fonts: Anton (condensed), Archivo Black Italic (extended hero), outline keyline for giant bg word, Space Mono micro-caption.
- Double-pass structure: pass2 = same scene functions, new photos/words (engine `pass` param).
- `roles:{intro:[phonePoster,roadSign], build:[roadType,polaroidScatter], brk:[ovalBadge], drop:[wantedStars,bandSlats], drop2:[roadType,wantedStars], outro:[cityPoster]}`; seams `["whip","spin","iris","flash"]`.
- intro `phonePoster(c)`: phone mockup with poster photo on cream, slow push; whip-smear out. `roadSign(c)`: freeway photo push, pink hairline sweeps, sign boxes `AE.pop` back.out per word.
- build `roadType(c)`: dashed road strip bottom, words slide on `rotateX(55deg)` plane one per ~0.35s with blur; `polaroidScatter(c)`: 3 cards tumble rot −8..6deg `AE.stack`, leaf confetti drift.
- brk `ovalBadge(c)`: black blob iris grows elastic, B&W map + cursor inside, hero words tilt in.
- drop `wantedStars(c)`: plum bg, giant outline word behind, 5 stars fill pink one per half-beat (scale pop 1.4→1), 3 poster cards slide up stagger .3; `bandSlats(c)`: 3 diagonal bands (pink/black/lilac) `AE.trans slit` stagger .35, each with photo strip + hero word.
- outro `cityPoster(c)`: dusk city poster 3D tilt, date/rating micro-line, slow push, fade cream.
- Helpers: AE.stack/pop/sparkles, AE.trans slit/spin/whip, AE.words, AMV.fit.
- Post FX: `dirblur` 20–40px whips, `spinblur` spiral joins, prism echo smear 1f before band acts, warm-pink grade on photos.
- Assets: 8–10 photos (freeway/city + portraits), 3 polaroid crops, map graphic, star/leaf SVGs, phone mockup PNG.

## Lyric/text system
- Road-plane words: sung words slide in on the perspective road one per ~0.35s, alternating condensed/italic/outline treatments — placement + font change marks each word.
- Sign pops: 1 word per road-sign box over the freeway photo (intro hook).
- Band words: one hero word per diagonal photo band (drop), staggered .35s.
- Micro text: poster captions, date/rating lines, map labels — static decorative, mono tiny.
- Double pass: same word positions, new photos; if lyrics differ per pass, swap CFG.words per pass only. Unsafe: text off the road plane in road scenes; stars act keeps text to the giant outline word only.

  - `intro: [ribbonWords]` - tiny pink word lands big->small (reverse slam), ink dot rises, 4-6 ribbon shards swirl out (rotate 120deg, grow/fade .6s) and the word swaps UNDER the swirl at midpoint; word grows 10% on push.
  - `build: [stretchWords]` - same swap system + width-slam: word hits at scaleX 2.2 (extended) or scaleY 2.5/scaleX .5 (condensed), relaxes elastic .3s. One word per vocal phrase; learn the system here.
  - `brk: [pinkPoster]` - 3 pink slit bars wipe to full hot-pink panel; avatar in starburst circle pops, bold crimson word slides up, script wipes L->R, black "?" cards pop with overshoot, doodle sun rotates slowly behind. Bigger/slower = break payoff.
  - `drop: [strip916]` - central 9:16 photo column in black pillars; pink pill stickers stack one per kick (gradient fill, white outline), photo swaps by 3-frame vertical slide+blur per phrase.
  - `drop2: [polaroidFly]` - white again: "?" polaroids fly in tilted from corners, pink ribbon shape sweeps, polaroids shrink/orbit; then a white-band iris to tiny grey captions swapping with stretch pops.
  - `outro: [tinyEnd]` - 3-4 tiny grey caption swaps (.35s each), hold, cut to black. No logo needed.
- Seams/post: `seams:["cut","iris","cut","whip"]` + ribbon swirl as the in-scene seam. Post: dirblur only on the ribbon sweep and chevron ticker, no rgb/glitch - cleanliness is the grade. Chevron ticker = repeating SVG pattern bands with a scrolling caps line (motion blur via dirblur 60).
- Helpers: `AE.pop, AE.fx`, local ribbon-swirl (SVG dash + rotation), stretch tween (`gsap.fromTo scaleX/scaleY elastic.out(1,.5)`).

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: single sung words, SMALL (6-8% of frame height) in acts 1-2 - the restraint is the style. Swap on the vocal, swirl on phrase ends. Never stack two hero words; the poster act may stack a bold word + script echo of the SAME phrase.
- Poster caps: the horizontal ticker in the pink act repeats the current phrase as a marquee - repetition is decorative and safe because it is the phrase already sung; do not ticker future words.
- Stickers/pills: pills on the photo strip carry 1-word CFG hooks, one per kick, and stay stacked (they accumulate like stickers, not subtitles). They must not spell out the lyric in order - shuffle hook words from CFG.
- UI labels: none. Decorative text safe zones: chevron bands, polaroid borders, tiny outro captions (CFG words). Unsafe: any text over the strip photo's face - pills anchor to the pillar edges/bottom; script in the poster act must not cross the avatar circle.

Literal prop-per-word staging (camera for "PARADISE", envelopes for "CHANGE", cube for "WE") + material changes per word + no flat transitions; tail is a clean 2.5s black with watermark.
## Song
Original/stock bed 110 BPM A minor; lyric fragments phrase-synced; section change at 6.5 and 22.5s.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Engine: `AE.film(tl,{roles:{intro:[scChromeSpin,scHeartIris],build:[scSunOutline,scCameraProp,scVoidTumble],brk:[scEnvelopeChange],drop:[scVortexChrome,scFireCards,scShatterWord],drop2:[scNeonFrames,scGoldCorridor,scBokehTumble],outro:[scBlackTail]},seams:["spin","whip","zoom","flash","glitch"],look:{glow:.7,grain:.15},cam:{hand:6,velo:.8},bg:"#000"})`; stage 1080x1440. Verified vs contact sheet: chrome spin-in, heart iris, camera prop, green vortex, gold corridor, bokeh finale all present.
- Palette/fonts: high-contrast saturated plates; chrome white, cyan neon, green glow, gold/bronze, red accents; dark vignette. Bebas/Montserrat ExtraBold extruded (`AE.word3d` per-word `pal`: chrome/neon/gold), spiky display for one word, rounded lowercase (Baloo) for soft words, marker (Caveat) for handwritten inserts.
- intro: `scChromeSpin(c)` white chrome word rotates 3x->1x with glints + red specks on black plate; `scHeartIris(c)` heart mask opens over sunset plate, small word inside heart, laser lines radiate.
- build: `scSunOutline(c)` outline-only words slide past a close-up push; `scCameraProp(c)` credit bar types top (mono caps), 3D camera sprite swoops lower-left and exits, lavender chrome word rises behind it with flare; `scVoidTumble(c)` black void, white letters tumble per-letter, green spark trails, dutch camera.
- brk: `scEnvelopeChange(c)` white world, pink shards radiate (speedlines), cutout over white, envelope icons fly, grey-chrome word with yellow edge slams; last shard freeze .4s.
- drop: `scVortexChrome(c)` green vortex bg, letters spiral in/settle/spiral out (`AE.lyric3d` rx/rz stops); `scFireCards(c)` ember bg + teal diagonal stripes, stacked words bottom-right with parallax card; `scShatterWord(c)` sky card cracks, glass-shard ring bursts around the hero word (`trans.shatter` custom: 40 shards outward).
- drop2: `scNeonFrames(c)` dotted-wave floor, 3 perspective frames, cyan neon glow word (`pal` neon + bloom), zoom into letters until they fill frame; `scGoldCorridor(c)` gold 3D words one per .5s along a dolly; `scBokehTumble(c)` cyan-bokeh plate, word tumbles, ring glyph rolls across, right-aligned stack fades lower-right. Outro: `scBlackTail(c)` glitch-streak blur to black, hold watermark 2.5s - keep the tail, it is the signature.
- Helpers/post/assets: reuse `AE.word3d/lyric3d` (material = pal triple per word), `AE.sparkles` (specks/leaves/bokeh), `AE.echo` on tumbles, `AE.impact`; post events: spin/radial blur on every swap, flash-white only at brk entry and gold corridor, rgb split only on neon words, shatter once per drop max. Assets: 9 photo plates, 2 cutouts, camera/envelope/cube sprites (PNG), heart mask SVG, shard set, flare PNG.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: strictly one sung word per stop, sized 20-35% frame width, from `c.W(j)`/`c.lyricTimes()`; material changes are allowed per word but the word itself is always the vocal word at that kick.
- UI labels: only the top credit bar (build, mono caps, typewriter) and the bottom watermark; both fixed template text, never synced, removed in drop2.
- Stickers/decorative: handwritten marker words ARE lyric words here (place them on clothing/plates, timed like heroes, smaller). Envelope/cube/camera props and "?" glyphs are decorative and safe mid-frame only when the hero word is also present; never float a decorative word alone on a kick.

## Techniques
- tag: new.ph.magnifier_portal — a magnifier is a movable mask: (a) circle mask (r≈70 px) showing a sharp ransom-note title over a blurred scene, (b) then the glass scales up to fill ~75% of the frame, acting as a portal into a new "inside" scene (board). build: HTML: .lens {border-radius:50%; overflow:hidden} containing the board layer scaled inversely (board scale = 1/lensScale) so contents are magnified; ring = PNG of chrome ring with transparent middle; outside blurred duplicate (filter blur 12px) behind. Tween lens scale 1→8 with transform-origin at the glass centre, ease expo.out 0.8 s; add feDisplacementMap bulge or radial gradient highlight.
- tag: type.per_letter (ransom note) — letters pop in one by one (0.1 s) each on its own chip with random rotation ±6° and different font/colour; build: spans with random classes and gsap.from scale .6 / rotation / opacity, stagger 0.1.

- tag: ph.grid_multi → new.ph.panel_collage — behind the main beach photo 3 vertical-strip panels with other photos slide in/out around it (60 px, 0.3 s) while typing; collapse before hold.
- tag: type.typewriter lyric — two lines (3–4 words each), white extra-bold italic with 20–40% skew; each letter fades-in 0.1 s; final held 1.5 s.
- tag: trans.whip — 3-frame directional blur with skew on the text matching motion (13.0).
- tag: new.loop_structure — whole piece = 2× (lens act → lyric act) + end card; same assets reused with only lyric text changed (cheap, rhythmic).

## What makes it look premium
- The magnifier is a diegetic transition: no wipes/flash needed; it also holds the title text so it doubles as a "logo reveal".
- Shallow-depth-of-field desk + refraction + chromatic ring edge = macro realism.
- Warm beach reward after a cool green act gives a colour contrast and emotional release.
- Repetition with variation (act A'): same scene faster, different lyric.

## Song
"Foto kita blur" (Vallcry VTX; trending sound; 142 BPM A minor). Lyrics shown = 2 lines of 3–4 words ("Kita pernah begitu" / "Kini memori yang ku dekap"), typed per letter so the last letter lands on a beat. SFX: single click at 12.1 s when the 2nd "Kini memori" label appears. 33% of cuts on beat.
## Build recipe (58s)
- Canvas/look: 1080x1920. Palette emerald mat #1f7a5a, string red #d8323a, chrome lens (PNG), sunset #e89050 / rock #3a2418 / teal sea, paper white. Fonts: ransom chips = per-letter rotation of Special Elite / Playfair Display / Anton on white chips; red scribble word = Rock Salt; beach lyric = Syne 800 italic, skew -6deg, white with soft shadow. Look `{glow:.35,glow_thr:.68,rgb:.7,vignette:.26,grain:.03,grade:"warm"}`. This IS the `detective` template - extend its scenes to 58s pools.
- Assets: 30+ photos (desk props can be CSS/photo crops; beach/hero photos P(0..5) carry act B), magnifier ring PNG with transparent centre, newspaper texture, red string = SVG lines. Cutouts: 0 required, 1 optional for the beach hero.
- Scene functions:
  - `intro: [lensType]` - blurred desk (blur 12px duplicate), lens circle mask (r~340px in 9:16) shows the SHARP layer; ransom title types per letter (.1s/letter, chips rotate +-6deg) inside the glass; lens drifts 120px.
  - `build: [lensPortal]` - pin dot + 4-5 red strings stroke-draw out (.2s), lens scales 1->8 (expo.out .8s) into the board: "?" polaroids pinned by the strings, red scribble word; hold with dolly +3% and one glare sweep (`AE.sweep`).
  - `brk: [boardHold]` - the board at rest, slow rotate +2deg, glare only; last .5s the lens ring fills the frame (scale up) to portal out. Quiet = the break.
  - `drop: [beachPanels]` - warm hero photo + 3 strip panels slide in behind it (+-60px, .3s); lyric types per letter (see text system); panels collapse (scale 0, .2s) before the hold; slow push 6%.
  - `drop2: [lensTypeFast, beachPanels]` - act A repeated ~15% faster with the second lyric, then beach again; add the whip at the panel collapse (`AE.fx("dirblur",t,{amt:140,ang:0})` + text skew with the motion).
  - `outro: [endCard]` - black, thin serif creator watermark centred, fade last .2s (engine fade covers).
- Seams/post: `seams:["zoom","blur","zoom","whip"]` - the lens scale IS the main transition (zoom-through at portal moments with `AE.fx("zoomblur",t,{amt:.4})` + chromatic ring = rgb 6 on the lens edge only). Post otherwise clean: no glitch, no grain beyond template base.
- Helpers: template detective scenes, `AE.sweep` (glare), `AE.maskReveal` (scribble), per-letter chip builder (local), SVG stroke draw for strings.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: the ransom title inside the lens is a TITLE, not a lyric - it is set from CFG (2-3 words), typed per letter, and repeats identically each act. Because it never changes, viewers read it as a logo; do not put changing lyrics in the lens.
- Lyric lines: beach act only - 2 lines of 3-4 words, typed per letter at .1s so the last letter lands on a beat/kick; white Syne italic over the lower third of the photo. Time from `c.lyricTimes()`: type the line across its phrase, hold 1.5s, collapse panels, hold photo clean.
- UI labels: tiny printed words on the newspaper/board ("?" polaroids, small print) are decorative texture - keep them illegible-small (<=28px) or as "?" so they never read as lyrics. The red scribble is ONE CFG hook word, written once per board scene.
- Decorative text safe zones: inside the lens (title only), board newspaper margins, end card. Unsafe: lyric text over the desk act (competes with the ransom title), and no text at all during the .8s portal scale - the eye is on the lens edge.

## What makes it look premium (vs. a flat slideshow)
- every section is a distinct "designed poster" with its own palette and graphic device (planet, sunburst, rings, label bars, calendar), all on a clean white/editorial base — reads like a design portfolio.
- real UI (IG post, iOS calendar) used as a set with camera moves (pull-out, pan) instead of static screenshots.
- the lyric is always on screen as typography that syncs per word; label-bar captions build per syllable.
- transitions are short (1–2 frame) bridges: zoom-blur, white flash, mosaic, spin, glitch slice — never fades.

## Song
"suara asli - Nabel Nabel" (original sound). Lyrics (hip-hop): "I hit it fast … I hit it slow … gotta get ready, tonight is my show … if you okay, you might open my show … got the big pointers right under nose, cause these guys mad, I got all the dough". rea: 123 BPM, A# major, music 3.5–13.0 s. Words appear exactly on their syllables (word-level lyric sync); label bars add per syllable (~0.12–0.25 s apart).

## Build recipe (58s)
- Build square canvas only (ignore monitor/phone framing). Palettes per poster: violet `#5B2BE0`, pink/rainbow, calendar red `#FF3B30`, sunburst orange `#F7941D` + blue `#1E8BFF`, red bars `#E8213A`, B&W. Font: Inter ExtraBold/Archivo Black Italic (labels).
- `roles:{intro:[spaceCard], build:[igPull,calendarHop], brk:[frostedLyric], drop:[labelBars,drosteCard], drop2:[labelBarsBW,spaceCard], outro:[doughEnd]}`; seams `["zoom","flash","glitch","spin"]` 1–2f only.
- intro `spaceCard(c)`: violet starfield card rotateY −25deg push, `AE.words slam` per syllable, sphere + curved bands.
- build `igPull(c)`: photo scale 4→1 pull-out reveals IG post chrome, heart pop red, camera pans caption with dir blur; `calendarHop(c)`: numeral row, red circle hops per 16th (steps), pull to month grid, cutout flies across.
- brk `frostedLyric(c)`: blurred bokeh bg (blur60 saturate1.4 copy), words fade+deblur per syllable, lines scroll up — slowest scene.
- drop `labelBars(c)`: fanned phone photo cards drop in, `AE.blocks`-style red bars stack per syllable rot ±4deg; `drosteCard(c)`: poster shrinks scale→.45 rotateY15 onto blurred copy of itself.
- drop2 B&W grade version of labelBars; outro `doughEnd(c)`: embossed white hero (`AMV.extrude` white/grey) over B&W photo, exposure drop to black.
- Helpers: AE.words/blocks, AE.pop, AE.flipCard, AE.trans zoom/glitch/spin, AE.fx wave+rgb for psychedelic variant scene.
- Post FX: `zoomblur` bursts, mosaic `glitch` 1f bridges, `spinblur` swirl, wave-warp on one photo; clean, no grain.
- Assets: 4–5 photos + 2 cutouts, planet/starburst/ring SVGs, calendar/IG chrome HTML.

## Lyric/text system
- Frosted karaoke (brk): full lines word-by-word blur-in on syllables, lines scroll up; key phrase returns huge as slam at section end.
- Label bars (drop/drop2): heavy caps on red/black bars, one bar per syllable (~0.12–0.25s), stacked poster-style over photos.
- UI-carried lyric: IG caption pan follows the sung line; calendar hops visualise time words without text.
- Poster hero words: single loud words on space/sunburst cards, slam per syllable.
- Decorative/safe: small poster labels, like-counts, month numerals. Unsafe: karaoke + label bars in same scene; text over the psychedelic face (warp carries it).

## What makes it look premium (vs. a flat slideshow)
- strict 3-colour system (black + one accent per segment) with accent alternation every ~0.5 s.
- every word is a lit 3D object in a space with a floor, reflection and fog; camera always moving.
- nothing ever cuts "clean": every cut is a 1–3 frame speedline / flare / zoom-blur bridge, so the whole thing reads as one continuous flight.
- bloom is HUGE and animated (exposure falls into readability), giving the "light" quality.
- micro-typography layer (mono index labels, brackets, tiny echo words) adds designed density.

Underlying audio is a lyric-edit track with lyrics "they can't do like this … huh … hup! young javanese … aku stelan fresh … smooth like Michael Jackson / man in the mirror" (an Indonesian rap/hip-hop track, probably "Young Javanese"-style lyric, not identified). Each on-screen word = the sung word, landing on its syllable (type.lyric_word_sync); segment cuts sit on a 0.5 s grid (rea keyframes 2.433, 2.933, 3.433, 4.2, 5.2, 6.03, 7.03, 8.03, 9.13, 10.2, 11.67). rea: TTS-like voice detected 12% (likely the rap vocal), music hard-cut at end.

## Build recipe (58s)
- Build the square canvas only (ignore phone/monitor framing). Canvas 1080x1080, black. Accents (one per segment): lime `#B6FF1A`, red `#FF1E3C`, white. Fonts: Archivo Black/Anton (hero 3D), Space Mono (index labels), Archivo Black Italic (small accents), Pacifico (neon signature).
- Segment grid = kicks (ref 0.5s): scenes are short; map roles onto AE.film but allow 2 scenes per role-slot.
- `roles:{intro:[logoRing], build:[heroStack], brk:[shatterFly], drop:[heroStack,gaugeWord], drop2:[heroStack,mirrorStack], outro:[neonSign]}`; seams all speedline bridge (see post).
- intro `logoRing(c)`: extruded monogram centre, dashed double ring rotates (SVG dash-offset), outline giant word drifts behind, floor reflection (scaleY−1 + gradient mask + blur2), coloured orb pulses on kicks.
- build/drop `heroStack(c)`: `AE.lyric3d` stop per word — hero `AE.word3d` exposure-down reveal (brightness4 blur12→1/0 expo.out), stacked small words added per kick, mono label top-right, dutch 5–15deg + slow roll.
- brk `shatterFly(c)`: hero splits to ~40 shard divs, translateZ 0→1500 random rotation, exposure to near-white.
- drop `gaugeWord(c)`: word inside rotating dashed gauge ring, flare centre; `mirrorStack(c)`: word + scaleX(−1) twin with 1px divider.
- outro `neonSign(c)`: mono header types, script signature stroke-draw led by spark point, underline swoosh, handle types; flicker glow.
- Helpers: AE.lyric3d/word3d, AE.fx speedline canvas (300 radial lines 2f at every seam), AE.sparkles, AMV.extrude fallback.
- Post FX: `zoomblur` on every push-through, `dirblur` on whip words, coloured `flash` 1–2f, huge `glow` constant; no grain.
- Assets: none photographic (pure type) — ring/gauge SVGs, flare sprite; optional 1 cutout for drop2 variant. CFG.words drives everything.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: every sung word gets a 3D segment (~0.5s), exposure-down glow reveal; stacked phrases build word-by-word within a segment (small words first, hero last).
- Mono index labels: tracklist-style micro labels (number + short tag) top/bottom-right per segment — decorative metadata, static or typed, never lyric-timed.
- Outline giant word behind hero: same word hollow — echo, not new text.
- Accent italics: 1–2 small words in contrasting colour/italic added after the stack lands (the "reply" voice).
- Signature outro: neon script name write-on + typed mono header/handle. Unsafe: subtitles or mixed accents in one segment — one accent colour per segment is law.

## Techniques
- tag: type.typewriter (serif hook) — italic serif phrase letter-by-letter is the title card; black bar scaleX wipes it for punchline word. build: Playfair Italic spans stagger; bar = absolute div scaleX 0→1→out.
- tag: new.dots_to_waveform — typing dots (1→5) morph into audio bars: same row of elements, border-radius/dot → bars with scaleY pulse. build: 7 divs, gsap to height variance repeat yoyo; reads as "voice note playing".
- tag: trans.shape_iris (shrink-to-avatar) — full photo circle-crops down into profile avatar with ring draw. build: clip-path circle tween or border-radius+scale wrapper; SVG ring stroke draw after landing.
- tag: ph.grid_multi (profile build) — profile grid assembles thumb-by-thumb under avatar, some thumbs B&W. build: grid divs scale .5→1 back.out stagger 0.1; filter grayscale on 2 cells.
- tag: ui.chat (blue vs dark) — iMessage-style argument: blue right bubbles (self, boastful short lines) vs dark left replies (dismissive short lines); typing dots precede replies. build: bubble rows, pop + inner typewriter; dots 3-dot pulse 0.4 s before each reply.
- tag: ph.split_screen + new.ghost_ampersand — final dual tilted portraits over 400px grey script "&" ghost with serif caption. build: ghost char absolute Playfair 400px #e3e3e8; photos rotate ±5°, shadow, gsap push.
- tag: new.matte_window_frame — whole video inside black rounded-corner border (screen-capture framing). build: body padding black, stage radius 18px overflow hidden.

## Lyric/text system
- Hero words: serif hook (intro) and finale serif word are the hero — both sung fragments (hook + hook reprise). Serif italic at large size anywhere = lyric, reserve it for those two moments.
- UI labels: date labels, "Today 07.24", handle/URL micro-line, credit line — metadata, safe. Waveform/dots carry no text (pulse on instrumental beats — that's their job in gaps).
- Chat bubbles: blue = sung fragments, dark replies = *response* fragments (next line) — the "argument" is call/response within the lyric. Typing dots before replies = vocal breath. Don't write roast jokes that aren't in the song; if the song has no call/response, both sides take alternating fragments in order.
- Decorative: giant "&" ghost is punctuation (safe, it's a symbol not a word), grid, matte frame. Micro paragraph under finale photo types a fragment per-word — lyric, keep short.

## Techniques
- tag: new.ui.screen_recording_camera
  what: Each scene is a full UI screenshot; "camera" is scale/translate of the screen (zoom to one element: 3x in 0.3 s with ease expo.out) so one UI can host many text beats without cuts. Zoom is also the transition (zoom-through into pill -> next app).
  build: HTML UI scene wrapper `transform-origin` on the target element; gsap.to(scene,{scale:3.2,x,y}) ; zoom blur via filter blur(4px) 3 frames.
- tag: type.typewriter in context — caret blink 2 Hz, 2-3 chars/2 frames, optional letter-spacing starts 0.6 em and tightens to 0 as characters settle.
- tag: ui.notification / ui.lock_screen / ui.app_window / ui.chat / ui.music_player: lock-screen clock + Instagram pill; Discord call + channel list; Spotify-lyric white card with selection bar per word; Google dark home + search; iOS Notes; iMessage bubbles; DM input bar.
- tag: type.lyric_word_sync (black highlight bar) — selection rect (black) grows per word width over 3 frames while text turns white.
- tag: type.wave (arc baseline) — letters follow a quadratic arc (y = k*(x-c)^2), each drops in 1 frame stagger, arc then relaxes to straight.
- tag: new.trans.crt_off — scaleY to 1.5% in 3 frames + brightness boost, then scaleX to 0 + fade; used to cut into silence.
- tag: new.pause_black — 1.7 s black hold before next verse to create contrast; sell the drop.
- tag: type.word_slam / type.slide_bars (wide bold words from right with dir blur) and type.glow/rgb_split orange flicker.
- tag: type.handwritten morph — scribble stroke at the typing caret becomes the letter.

## What makes it look premium
- Real-UI fidelity + text that "belongs" in each app: a notification typed in the notification, a search typed in the search bar.
- Camera never cuts, it zooms along the interface (continuous move) — feels like one screen recording.
- Pacing contrast: dense typing, then CRT-off + 1.7 s black, then a bold wide typographic hit.
- Restrained palette, accents only from app brand colours.

## Lyric/text system
- Golden rule: lyrics are ONLY ever typed/selected inside an app element (notification, search field, lyric card selection bar, Notes, bubbles, DM input). There are no floating titles except the ONE wide slam at the drop, which Notes immediately "captures" into its window.
- Hero words: the wide slam (2 lines) and the arc line - arc letters are the sung line landing on a curve; it flattens when the phrase ends. Selection-bar highlighting must move word-by-word WITH the vocal (`c.lyricTimes()`), black bar grows per word width.
- UI labels: clock, channel names, headers, "11m ago" are CFG plausibility decor - static, small, never timed. Search/notification typing may carry the sung fragment because the app context makes it diegetic; keep fragments <=5 words per element.
- Decorative text safe zones: channel list rows, window title bars, photo viewer header. Unsafe: the black pause must contain ZERO text (even a watermark breaks it - hide badge/watermark for that scene), and the power-icon line must stay tiny until it grows at the spinner.
